1.1.1.b.m: It is prescribed by three Vedas:

1.1.1.c.m: by the Ṛgveda, the Yajurveda, [and] the Sāmaveda—the Jyotiṣṭoma by all [three];

1.1.1.d.m: the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices by the Ṛgveda and the Yajurveda;

1.1.1.g.m: The name "Veda" applies to mantra and Brāhmaṇa.

1.1.1.h.m: The Brāhmaṇas are the injunction of rites.

1.1.1.k.m: the practice of another, and ancient tradition.

1.1.1.m.m: Everyday [sounds] that are employed are non-mantras,

1.1.1.n.m: such as the name of a son and the sound of a drum.

1.1.1.p.m: because their form is barred from everyday [contexts],

1.1.1.q.s: yathā gṛhṇāmi te suprajāstvāya hastam \ imāṃ khanāmy oṣadhīm \\ vaha vapāṃ jātavedaḥ pitṛbhyas \\ iti /
1.1.1.q.d: यथा गृह्णामि ते सुप्रजास्त्वाय हस्तम् \ इमां खनाम्य् ओषधीम् \\ वह वपां जातवेदः पितृभ्यस् \\ इति ।
1.1.1.q.m: such as: "I take thy hand for good offspring"; "I dig this herb"; "Carry the omentum, O Jātavedas, to the fathers."

1.1.1.r.m: Those having a Brāhmaṇa [apply] as taught; the others according to their form.

1.1.1.t.m: The verses of the Ṛgveda serve for the cyclical narrative.

1.1.1.u.m: The chants serve for the repetition of the stoma in the two subsequent pavamāna [lauds].

1.1.1.v.m: In the case of silent archetype [rites], the formula [of the archetype applies].

1.1.1.w.m: A Veda mentioned by the name of a rite serves for that purpose,

1.1.1.x.m: as the Vājapeya, and the offering and introductory verses.

1.1.1.y.m: With the Yajurveda, [a rite] is performed inaudibly,

1.1.1.z.m: except for ancestral invocations, dialogues, callings for attention, and ritual directions.

1.1.2.a.m: in the Jyotiṣṭoma before the Agnīṣomīya [rite].

1.1.2.b.m: As far as the sense is completed, that is a single mantra.

1.1.2.c.m: Mantras are indicated by their beginning.

1.1.2.d.m: One should know the end of the previous by the beginning of the subsequent [mantra].

1.1.2.e.m: One should make the rite coincide with the end of the mantra.

1.1.2.f.m: While [the action] is being performed, the recitations of the hotṛ are spoken.

1.1.2.h.m: The recitations of the hotṛ should be accumulated,

1.1.2.i.m: except for the offering and introductory verses.

1.1.2.j.s: yatraikasmin dravye viceṣṭāpṛthaktvenārtho niṣpadyate sakṛd eva tatra mantraṃ brūyāt /
1.1.2.j.d: यत्रैकस्मिन् द्रव्ये विचेष्टापृथक्त्वेनार्थो निष्पद्यते सकृद् एव तत्र मन्त्रं ब्रूयात् ।
1.1.2.j.m: Where the purpose is accomplished on a single substance through distinct movements, one should utter the mantra only once there,

1.1.2.k.m: as in sprinkling and cutting the sacrificial post.

1.1.2.l.m: When the substance is distinct, it is repeated,

1.1.2.m.m: as in taking the clarified butter, cutting [grass], and strewing [it].

1.1.2.n.m: Because of the distinctness of purpose, the scratching mantra is repeated.

1.1.2.o.m: [Actions] serving for another should be performed with a single [item],

1.1.2.p.s: yathā kapālenopavapati yajamānena saṃmitaudumbarī bhavati \\ iti /
1.1.2.p.d: यथा कपालेनोपवपति यजमानेन संमितौदुम्बरी भवति \\ इति ।
1.1.2.p.m: as: "He pours out with a potsherd"; "The udumbara post is commensurate with the sacrificer."

1.1.2.q.m: With the Yajurveda, the adhvaryu acts;

1.1.2.w.m: as in the animal rites at the horse sacrifice.

1.1.2.x.m: Oblations are offered in the āhavanīya fire with the juhū ladle.

1.1.2.y.m: The sacrificial area is approached from the north.

1.1.3.a.s: prāṅnyāyāny udaṅnyāyāni vā pradakṣiṇaṃ yajñe karmāṇi karoti /
1.1.3.a.d: प्राङ्न्यायान्य् उदङ्न्यायानि वा प्रदक्षिणं यज्ञे कर्माणि करोति ।
1.1.3.a.m: In the sacrifice, one performs rites tending towards the east or tending towards the north, moving clockwise.

1.1.3.b.m: One does not pass around oneself or another with an implement of the sacrifice.

1.1.3.c.m: One does not turn away from the sacrificial area.

1.1.3.d.m: The implements of the sacrifice are inside; the performers are outside.

1.1.3.e.m: Wearing the sacred cord over the right shoulder, one performs rites for the ancestors.

1.1.3.f.m: Wearing the sacred cord over the left shoulder, [one acts] in the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices and in the Agnihotra.

1.1.3.h.m: Because of their connection with the injunction, the primary rites occur at one and the same time.

1.1.3.i.s: teṣāṃ vibhavanti tantram aṅgāny avibhavanty āvartante /
1.1.3.i.d: तेषां विभवन्ति तन्त्रम् अङ्गान्य् अविभवन्त्य् आवर्तन्ते ।
1.1.3.i.m: The subsidiary rites that suffice serve as a common framework for them; those that do not suffice are repeated.

1.1.3.k.s: yaḥ pradhānasya kālaḥ so 'ṅgānām̐ sa deśaḥ sa kartā so 'gniḥ /
1.1.3.k.d: यः प्रधानस्य कालः सो ऽङ्गानाम्̐ स देशः स कर्ता सो ऽग्निः ।
1.1.3.k.m: Whatever is the time of the primary rite is that of the subsidiary rites; whatever is its place, its agent, its fire [is theirs].

1.1.3.l.m: From the setting up of the fires onward, the utensils are kept for life.

1.1.3.m.m: Their consecration is repeated with each sacrificial framework.

1.1.3.n.m: The New- and Full-Moon sacrifices fulfill all desires.

1.1.3.p.m: They are distinguished on account of specific designation.

1.1.3.q.s: tābhyāṃ yāvajjīvaṃ yajate trim̐śataṃ vā varṣāṇi /
1.1.3.q.d: ताभ्यां यावज्जीवं यजते त्रिम्̐शतं वा वर्षाणि ।
1.1.3.q.m: With the two one sacrifices throughout life, or for thirty years.

1.1.3.r.s: ekasmin prayoge sarvān kāmān kāmayeta prayogapṛthaktve vaikaikam /
1.1.3.r.d: एकस्मिन् प्रयोगे सर्वान् कामान् कामयेत प्रयोगपृथक्त्वे वैकैकम् ।
1.1.3.r.m: One may desire all desires in a single performance, or one by one in separate performances.

1.1.3.s.m: The Full Moon rite is first; the New Moon rite is subsequent.

1.1.3.t.m: At full moon one sacrifices with the Full Moon rite; at new moon with the New Moon rite.

1.1.3.u.s: āgneyo 'ṣṭākapāla upām̐śuyājaś cāgnīṣomīyo vaiṣṇavaḥ prājāpatyo vāgnīṣomīyaś caikādaśakapālaḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ pradhānāni /
1.1.3.u.d: आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपाल उपाम्̐शुयाजश् चाग्नीषोमीयो वैष्णवः प्राजापत्यो वाग्नीषोमीयश् चैकादशकपालः पौर्णमास्यां प्रधानानि ।
1.1.3.u.m: The primary rites on the full moon are: [the sacrificial cake] for Agni on eight potsherds, the inaudible offering to Agni-Soma, Viṣṇu, or Prajāpati, and [the cake] for Agni-Soma on eleven potsherds.

1.1.3.v.s: nāsomāyājino brāhmaṇasyāgnīṣomīyaḥ puroḍāśo vidyata ity ekeṣām āgneyo 'ṣṭākapāla aindrāgna ekādaśakapālo dvādaśakapālo vāmāvāsyāyām asaṃnayata āgneyaḥ saṃnāyyaṃ ca saṃnayataḥ /
1.1.3.v.d: नासोमायाजिनो ब्राह्मणस्याग्नीषोमीयः पुरोडाशो विद्यत इत्य् एकेषाम् आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपाल ऐन्द्राग्न एकादशकपालो द्वादशकपालो वामावास्यायाम् असंनयत आग्नेयः संनाय्यं च संनयतः ।
1.1.3.v.m: According to some, the sacrificial cake for Agni-Soma is not prescribed for a brāhmaṇa who has not performed a soma sacrifice; on the new moon, for one who does not offer curd-and-milk, [the primary rites are the cake] for Agni on eight potsherds and [the cake] for Indra-Agni on eleven or twelve potsherds; for one who offers curd-and-milk, [the cake] for Agni and the curd-and-milk oblation.

1.1.3.x.m: One should fast on the first full-moon day,

1.2.4.a.s: prātar agnihotram̐ hutvānugamayitvāgnihotrikam apoddhṛtya vodita āditye gārhapatyād āhavanīyam uddhṛtya mamāgne varcas \\ ity anvādadhāty uttarayā gārhapatyam uttarayā dakṣiṇāgnim /
1.2.4.a.d: प्रातर् अग्निहोत्रम्̐ हुत्वानुगमयित्वाग्निहोत्रिकम् अपोद्धृत्य वोदित आदित्ये गार्हपत्याद् आहवनीयम् उद्धृत्य ममाग्ने वर्चस् \\ इत्य् अन्वादधात्य् उत्तरया गार्हपत्यम् उत्तरया दक्षिणाग्निम् ।
1.2.4.a.m: Having offered the morning Agnihotra, and having let the Agnihotra fire go out or having set it aside, after the sun has risen, having drawn out the āhavanīya fire from the gārhapatya fire, he fuels it with 'My luster, O Agni...'; with the next [verse] the gārhapatya fire; with the next the dakṣiṇāgni fire.

1.2.4.b.m: Or [he fuels] the āhavanīya fire with all [the verses].

1.2.4.d.m: According to some, he fuels [them] with the sacred utterances.

1.2.4.e.s: agniṃ gṛhṇāmi surathaṃ yo mayobhūs \\ ya udyantam ārohati sūryam ahne / \ ādityaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotir uttamam \\ śvo yajñāya ramatāṃ devatābhyaḥ / \ vasūn rudrān ādityān \ indreṇa saha devatāḥ / \ tāḥ pūrvaḥ parigṛhṇāmi \ sva āyatane manīṣayā / \ imām ūrjaṃ pañcadaśīṃ ye praviṣṭās \ tān devān parigṛhṇāmi pūrvaḥ / \ agnir havyavāḍ iha tān āvahatu \ paurṇamāsam̐ havir idam eṣāṃ mayi \\ iti paurṇamāsyām āmāvāsyam̐ havir idam eṣāṃ mayi \\ ity amāvāsyāyām iti tisṛbhir āhavanīyam antarāgnī paśavas \\ devasam̐sadam āgaman / \ tān pūrvaḥ parigṛhṇāmi \ sva āyatane manīṣayā \\ ity antarāgnī tiṣṭhañ japati \\ iha prajā viśvarūpā ramantām \ agniṃ gṛhapatim abhi saṃvasānāḥ / \ tāḥ pūrvaḥ parigṛhṇāmi \ sva āyatane manīṣayā / \ iha paśavo viśvarūpā ramantām \ agniṃ gṛhapatim abhi saṃvasānāḥ / \ tān pūrvaḥ parigṛhṇāmi \ sva āyatane manīṣayā \\ iti dvābhyāṃ gārhapatyam ayaṃ pitṛṇām agnis \\ avāḍ ḍhavyā pitṛbhya ā / \ taṃ pūrvaḥ parigṛhṇāmi \\ aviṣaṃ naḥ pituṃ karat \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnim ajasraṃ tvām̐ sabhāpālās \\ vijayabhāgam̐ samindhatām / \ agne dīdāya me sabhya \ vijityai śaradaḥ śatam iti sabhyam annam āvasathīyam \ abhiharāṇi śaradaḥ śatam / \ āvasathe śriyaṃ mantram \ ahir budhniyo niyacchatu \\ ity āvasathyam /
1.2.4.e.d: अग्निं गृह्णामि सुरथं यो मयोभूस् \\ य उद्यन्तम् आरोहति सूर्यम् अह्ने । \ आदित्यं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिर् उत्तमम् \\ श्वो यज्ञाय रमतां देवताभ्यः । \ वसून् रुद्रान् आदित्यान् \ इन्द्रेण सह देवताः । \ ताः पूर्वः परिगृह्णामि \ स्व आयतने मनीषया । \ इमाम् ऊर्जं पञ्चदशीं ये प्रविष्टास् \ तान् देवान् परिगृह्णामि पूर्वः । \ अग्निर् हव्यवाड् इह तान् आवहतु \ पौर्णमासम्̐ हविर् इदम् एषां मयि \\ इति पौर्णमास्याम् आमावास्यम्̐ हविर् इदम् एषां मयि \\ इत्य् अमावास्यायाम् इति तिसृभिर् आहवनीयम् अन्तराग्नी पशवस् \\ देवसम्̐सदम् आगमन् । \ तान् पूर्वः परिगृह्णामि \ स्व आयतने मनीषया \\ इत्य् अन्तराग्नी तिष्ठञ् जपति \\ इह प्रजा विश्वरूपा रमन्ताम् \ अग्निं गृहपतिम् अभि संवसानाः । \ ताः पूर्वः परिगृह्णामि \ स्व आयतने मनीषया । \ इह पशवो विश्वरूपा रमन्ताम् \ अग्निं गृहपतिम् अभि संवसानाः । \ तान् पूर्वः परिगृह्णामि \ स्व आयतने मनीषया \\ इति द्वाभ्यां गार्हपत्यम् अयं पितृणाम् अग्निस् \\ अवाड् ढव्या पितृभ्य आ । \ तं पूर्वः परिगृह्णामि \\ अविषं नः पितुं करत् \\ इति दक्षिणाग्निम् अजस्रं त्वाम्̐ सभापालास् \\ विजयभागम्̐ समिन्धताम् । \ अग्ने दीदाय मे सभ्य \ विजित्यै शरदः शतम् इति सभ्यम् अन्नम् आवसथीयम् \ अभिहराणि शरदः शतम् । \ आवसथे श्रियं मन्त्रम् \ अहिर् बुध्नियो नियच्छतु \\ इत्य् आवसथ्यम् ।
1.2.4.e.m: With three verses: 'I seize the fire having a good chariot, who is wholesome, / who ascends to the rising sun for the day; / the sun, the highest light of lights, / let him rest tomorrow for the sacrifice to the deities. / The Vasus, the Rudras, the Ādityas, / the deities together with Indra, / them I, coming first, grasp / in my own abode with devotion. / Those gods who have entered into this fifteenth nourishment, / them I, coming first, grasp; / may Agni the bearer of oblations bring them hither; / this full-moon oblation of theirs is in me'—at the full moon; 'this new-moon oblation of theirs is in me'—at the new moon, [he fuels] the āhavanīya fire. Standing between the fires, he murmurs: 'The cattle have come between the fires / to the assembly of the gods; / them I, coming first, grasp / in my own abode with devotion.' With two [verses]: 'May multi-formed offspring take delight here, / dwelling together around Agni the lord of the house; / them I, coming first, grasp / in my own abode with devotion. / May multi-formed cattle take delight here, / dwelling together around Agni the lord of the house; / them I, coming first, grasp / in my own abode with devotion'—[he fuels] the gārhapatya fire. With: 'This fire of the Fathers / has carried the oblations to the Fathers; / it I, coming first, grasp; / may it make our food free from poison'—[he fuels] the dakṣiṇāgni fire. With: 'The guardians of the assembly, may they kindle thee, the imperishable, / to share in victory; / shine for me, O sabhya fire, / for victory for a hundred autumns'—[he fuels] the sabhya fire. With: 'May I bring food belonging to the dwelling / for a hundred autumns; / prosperity and mantra in the dwelling / may Ahi Budhnya bestow'—[he fuels] the āvasathya fire.

1.2.4.g.m: He fetches a palāśa branch or a śamī branch.

1.2.4.h.s: prācīm udīcīṃ prāgudīcīṃ vāhīnāṃ bahuparṇām aśuṣkāgrām /
1.2.4.h.d: प्राचीम् उदीचीं प्रागुदीचीं वाहीनां बहुपर्णाम् अशुष्काग्राम् ।
1.2.4.h.m: [It should be] pointing eastward, northward, or northeastward, unbroken, having many leaves, and having an un-withered tip.

1.2.4.i.s: yaṃ kāmayetāpaśuḥ syād ity aparṇāṃ tasmai śuṣkāgrām /
1.2.4.i.d: यं कामयेतापशुः स्याद् इत्य् अपर्णां तस्मै शुष्काग्राम् ।
1.2.4.i.m: For one whom he desires to be devoid of cattle, [he fetches one] without leaves and with a withered tip.

1.2.4.j.s: yaṃ kāmayeta paśumān syād iti bahuparṇāṃ tasmai bahuśākhām aśuṣkāgrām /
1.2.4.j.d: यं कामयेत पशुमान् स्याद् इति बहुपर्णां तस्मै बहुशाखाम् अशुष्काग्राम् ।
1.2.4.j.m: For one whom he desires to be rich in cattle, [he fetches one] having many leaves, many twigs, and an un-withered tip.

1.2.4.k.s: iṣe tvā \\ iti śākhām ācchinati \\ ūrje tvā \\ iti saṃnamayaty anumārṣṭi vā /
1.2.4.k.d: इषे त्वा \\ इति शाखाम् आच्छिनति \\ ऊर्जे त्वा \\ इति संनमयत्य् अनुमार्ष्टि वा ।
1.2.4.k.m: With 'For food thee!' he cuts off the branch; with 'For strength thee!' he bends it down or strokes it along.

1.2.4.l.s: imāṃ prācīm udīcīm \ iṣam ūrjam abhisam̐skṛtām / \ bahuparṇām aśuṣkāgrām \\ harāmi paśupām aham ity āharati /
1.2.4.l.d: इमां प्राचीम् उदीचीम् \ इषम् ऊर्जम् अभिसम्̐स्कृताम् । \ बहुपर्णाम् अशुष्काग्राम् \\ हरामि पशुपाम् अहम् इत्य् आहरति ।
1.2.4.l.m: He brings it with: 'This [branch] pointing east, pointing north, / consecrated for food and strength, / having many leaves, with an un-withered tip, / I bring, as a protector of cattle.'

1.2.4.m.s: vāyavaḥ stha \\ iti tayā ṣaḍ vatsān apākaroti //
1.2.4.m.d: वायवः स्थ \\ इति तया षड् वत्सान् अपाकरोति ॥
1.2.4.m.m: With 'Ye are the winds' he drives away six calves with it.

1.2.5.a.m: Or with darbha grass, or [with the branch] accompanied by darbha grass, according to some.

1.2.5.b.m: He touches one of those driven away with the branch.

1.2.5.c.s: devo vas \\ iti gocaram abhi mātṝḥ prasthāpayati /
1.2.5.c.d: देवो वस् \\ इति गोचरम् अभि मातॄः प्रस्थापयति ।
1.2.5.c.m: With 'May the god [Savitṛ]...' he sends the mothers toward the pasture.

1.2.5.d.m: He should mention Indra in the inserts for one who sacrifices to Indra, Mahendra for one who sacrifices to Mahendra.

1.2.5.e.m: He touches one of those that have set out with the branch.

1.2.5.f.s: śuddhā apaḥ suprapāṇe pibantīḥ \ śatam indrāya śarado duhānāḥ / \ rudrasya hetiḥ pari vo vṛṇaktu \\ iti prasthitā anumantrayate /
1.2.5.f.d: शुद्धा अपः सुप्रपाणे पिबन्तीः \ शतम् इन्द्राय शरदो दुहानाः । \ रुद्रस्य हेतिः परि वो वृणक्तु \\ इति प्रस्थिता अनुमन्त्रयते ।
1.2.5.f.m: He follows those that have set out with the mantra: 'Drinking pure waters at a good drinking place, / yielding milk for Indra for a hundred autumns, / may the missile of Rudra avoid you.'

1.2.5.g.s: dhruvā asmin \\ iti yajamānasya gṛhān abhi paryāvartate /
1.2.5.g.d: ध्रुवा अस्मिन् \\ इति यजमानस्य गृहान् अभि पर्यावर्तते ।
1.2.5.g.m: With 'Be firm in this [abode]...' he turns back toward the house of the sacrificer.

1.2.5.h.s: yajamānasya paśūn pāhi \\ ity agniṣṭhe 'nasy agnyagāre vā purastāt pratīcīm̐ śākhām upagūhati paścāt prācīm ity ekeṣām /
1.2.5.h.d: यजमानस्य पशून् पाहि \\ इत्य् अग्निष्ठे ऽनस्य् अग्न्यगारे वा पुरस्तात् प्रतीचीम्̐ शाखाम् उपगूहति पश्चात् प्राचीम् इत्य् एकेषाम् ।
1.2.5.h.m: With 'Protect the cattle of the sacrificer' he tucks the branch into the cart standing near the fire or in the fire-hall from the east pointing westward; according to some, from the west pointing eastward.

1.2.5.i.s: devasya tvā \\ ity aśvaparśum asidaṃ vādatte /
1.2.5.i.d: देवस्य त्वा \\ इत्य् अश्वपर्शुम् असिदं वादत्ते ।
1.2.5.i.m: With 'At the impulse of the divine...' he takes up a horse's rib or a sickle.

1.2.5.j.s: yajñasya ghoṣad asi \\ iti gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate /
1.2.5.j.d: यज्ञस्य घोषद् असि \\ इति गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते ।
1.2.5.j.m: With 'Thou art the proclaimer of the sacrifice' he pays reverence to the gārhapatya fire.

1.2.5.k.s: pratyuṣṭam ity āhavanīye gārhapatye vā niṣṭapati /
1.2.5.k.d: प्रत्युष्टम् इत्य् आहवनीये गार्हपत्ये वा निष्टपति ।
1.2.5.k.m: With 'Scorched...' he heats it over the āhavanīya or gārhapatya fire.

1.2.5.l.s: preyam agāt \\ urv antarikṣam \\ prehi \\ ity anyatareṇa prācīnam udīcīnaṃ vābhipravrajya yataḥ kutaścid darbhamayaṃ barhir āharati /
1.2.5.l.d: प्रेयम् अगात् \\ उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम् \\ प्रेहि \\ इत्य् अन्यतरेण प्राचीनम् उदीचीनं वाभिप्रव्रज्य यतः कुतश्चिद् दर्भमयं बर्हिर् आहरति ।
1.2.5.l.m: Having walked forth toward the east or north with either 'This one has gone forth...', 'The wide intermediate space...', or 'Go forth!', he fetches sacrificial grass consisting of darbha from wherever [it may be found].

1.2.5.m.s: viṣṇo stūpo 'si \\ ity abhipretānām ekam̐ stambam utsṛjati \\ indrasya pariṣūtam asi \\ ity anyaṃ pariṣauti devānām iti vā /
1.2.5.m.d: विष्णो स्तूपो ऽसि \\ इत्य् अभिप्रेतानाम् एकम्̐ स्तम्बम् उत्सृजति \\ इन्द्रस्य परिषूतम् असि \\ इत्य् अन्यं परिषौति देवानाम् इति वा ।
1.2.5.m.m: With 'Thou art the tuft of Viṣṇu' he lets go of one clump among those selected; with 'Thou art enclosed for Indra' or '...for the gods' he encloses another.

1.2.5.o.s: api vā paśūnāṃ tvā bhāgam utsṛjāmi \\ iti pariṣūtasyaikām dve vā darbhanāḍyāv utsṛjati /
1.2.5.o.d: अपि वा पशूनां त्वा भागम् उत्सृजामि \\ इति परिषूतस्यैकाम् द्वे वा दर्भनाड्याव् उत्सृजति ।
1.2.5.o.m: Or with 'I release thee as the share of the cattle' he sets aside one or two darbha blades of that which was enclosed.

1.2.5.p.s: idaṃ devānām iti pariṣūtam abhimṛśati \\ idaṃ paśūnām ity utsṛṣṭam avasṛṣṭo gavāṃ bhāgas \\ iti vā /
1.2.5.p.d: इदं देवानाम् इति परिषूतम् अभिमृशति \\ इदं पशूनाम् इत्य् उत्सृष्टम् अवसृष्टो गवां भागस् \\ इति वा ।
1.2.5.p.m: With 'This belongs to the gods' he touches the enclosed [grass]; with 'This belongs to the cattle' or 'Released is the share of the cows' [he touches] that which was set aside.

1.2.5.q.s: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ barhir devasadanam ārabhe \\ iti viśākheṣv abhipadyate /
1.2.5.q.d: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यां बर्हिर् देवसदनम् आरभे \\ इति विशाखेष्व् अभिपद्यते ।
1.2.5.q.m: With 'At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I take hold of the sacrificial grass, the seat of the gods' he grasps [it] at the forks.

1.2.5.r.m: With 'For the gods who have their sacrificial grass upright, thee' he strokes upward.

1.2.5.s.s: devabarhir mā tvānvaṅ mā tiryak \\ ity asidaṃ nidadhāti mādho mopari parus ta ṛdhyāsam iti vā //
1.2.5.s.d: देवबर्हिर् मा त्वान्वङ् मा तिर्यक् \\ इत्य् असिदं निदधाति माधो मोपरि परुस् त ऋध्यासम् इति वा ॥
1.2.5.s.m: With 'O divine sacrificial grass, may I not cut thee downwards nor crosswise' or 'May I succeed at thy joint, not below, not above' he places the sickle.

1.2.6.a.s: yā jātā oṣadhayas \\ devebhyas triyugaṃ purā / \ tāsāṃ parva rādhyāsam \\ paristaram āharan \\ ity abhimantrya /
1.2.6.a.d: या जाता ओषधयस् \\ देवेभ्यस् त्रियुगं पुरा । \ तासां पर्व राध्यासम् \\ परिस्तरम् आहरन् \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य ।
1.2.6.a.m: Having addressed [it] with: 'Those plants which were born / for the gods three ages ago, / may I succeed at their joint, / bringing the strewn grass,'

1.2.6.b.s: ācchettā te mā riṣam ity ācchinatti /
1.2.6.b.d: आच्छेत्ता ते मा रिषम् इत्य् आच्छिनत्ति ।
1.2.6.b.m: he cuts it with 'May I, the cutter, not suffer harm.'

1.2.6.e.m: [The prastara] is of the length of the handle of a ladle, or the length of a thigh bone.

1.2.6.f.m: He cuts the others according to the very same procedure.

1.2.6.g.m: Except for the [portions cut during] moving around and discarding.

1.2.6.h.m: Having cut all according to requirement,

1.2.6.i.s: devabarhiḥ śatavalśaṃ viroha \\ ity ālavān abhimṛśati /
1.2.6.i.d: देवबर्हिः शतवल्शं विरोह \\ इत्य् आलवान् अभिमृशति ।
1.2.6.i.m: He touches the cut stalks with: 'O divine sacrificial grass, sprout with a hundred shoots!'

1.2.6.j.s: sahasravalśā vi vayam̐ ruhema \\ ity ātmānaṃ pratyabhimṛśati /
1.2.6.j.d: सहस्रवल्शा वि वयम्̐ रुहेम \\ इत्य् आत्मानं प्रत्यभिमृशति ।
1.2.6.j.m: He touches himself with: 'May we sprout with a thousand shoots!'

1.2.6.k.s: ayujo yujo vā muṣṭīn nidhanāni vā lunoti /
1.2.6.k.d: अयुजो युजो वा मुष्टीन् निधनानि वा लुनोति ।
1.2.6.k.m: He cuts odd or even numbers of handfuls or layers.

1.2.6.l.s: adityai rāsnāsi \\ iti pradakṣiṇam̐ śulvam āveṣṭayati /
1.2.6.l.d: अदित्यै रास्नासि \\ इति प्रदक्षिणम्̐ शुल्वम् आवेष्टयति ।
1.2.6.l.m: With: 'You are the girdle for Aditi,' he winds the cord clockwise.

1.2.6.m.s: ayupitā yonis \\ iti pratinidadhāti tridhātu pañcadhātu vā dhātaudhātau mantram āvartayati /
1.2.6.m.d: अयुपिता योनिस् \\ इति प्रतिनिदधाति त्रिधातु पञ्चधातु वा धातौधातौ मन्त्रम् आवर्तयति ।
1.2.6.m.m: With: 'An undisturbable womb [are you],' he places it down; having three strands or five strands, he repeats the mantra with each strand.

1.2.6.n.s: pṛthivyāḥ saṃpṛcaḥ pāhi \\ iti prāgagram udagagraṃ vā śulbaṃ nidadhāti /
1.2.6.n.d: पृथिव्याः संपृचः पाहि \\ इति प्रागग्रम् उदगग्रं वा शुल्बं निदधाति ।
1.2.6.n.m: With: 'Protect from contact with the earth,' he places the cord with its tips pointed eastward or northward.

1.2.6.o.s: aparimitānāṃ parimitāḥ \ saṃnahye sukṛtāya kam / \ eno mā nigāṃ katamac canāham \\ punar utthāya bahulā bhavantu \\ ity abhimantrya susaṃbhṛtā tvāsaṃbhārami \\ iti śulbe nidhanāni saṃbharati /
1.2.6.o.d: अपरिमितानां परिमिताः \ संनह्ये सुकृताय कम् । \ एनो मा निगां कतमच् चनाहम् \\ पुनर् उत्थाय बहुला भवन्तु \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य सुसंभृता त्वासंभारमि \\ इति शुल्बे निधनानि संभरति ।
1.2.6.o.m: Having addressed [them] with: 'Of the unlimited, [you are] limited, / bound together for good action; / may I not incur any sin whatever; / having risen again, may they become manifold,' he gathers the layers onto the cord with: 'Well-gathered, I gather you.'

1.2.6.p.s: alubhitā yonis \\ ity uttame nidhane prastaram ādadhāti /
1.2.6.p.d: अलुभिता योनिस् \\ इत्य् उत्तमे निधने प्रस्तरम् आदधाति ।
1.2.6.p.m: With: 'An unentangled womb [are you],' he places the prastara on the topmost layer.

1.2.6.q.s: indrāṇyai saṃnahanam iti saṃnahyati pūṣā te \\ iti pradakṣiṇaṃ granthim āveṣṭya /
1.2.6.q.d: इन्द्राण्यै संनहनम् इति संनह्यति पूषा ते \\ इति प्रदक्षिणं ग्रन्थिम् आवेष्ट्य ।
1.2.6.q.m: He binds [the grass] with: '[You are] the binding for Indrāṇī'; having wound the knot clockwise with: 'May Pūṣan [tie] your [knot],'

1.2.6.r.s: sa te \\ iti purastāt pratyañcam upakarṣati paścād vā prāñcam /
1.2.6.r.d: स ते \\ इति पुरस्तात् प्रत्यञ्चम् उपकर्षति पश्चाद् वा प्राञ्चम् ।
1.2.6.r.m: With: 'May he [tie] your [knot],' he tucks it from the front toward the west, or from the back toward the east.

1.2.6.s.s: āpas tvām aśvinau tvām \ ṛṣayaḥ sapta māmṛjuḥ / \ barhiḥ sūryasya raśmibhis \\ uṣasāṃ ketum ārabhe \\ ity ārabhate /
1.2.6.s.d: आपस् त्वाम् अश्विनौ त्वाम् \ ऋषयः सप्त मामृजुः । \ बर्हिः सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिस् \\ उषसां केतुम् आरभे \\ इत्य् आरभते ।
1.2.6.s.m: He takes hold of it with: 'The waters have cleansed you, the Aśvins have cleansed you, / the seven seers have cleansed you; / with the rays of the sun, / I take hold of the sacrificial grass, the beacon of the dawns.'

1.2.6.t.s: indrasya tvā bāhubhyām udyacche \\ ity udyacchate /
1.2.6.t.d: इन्द्रस्य त्वा बाहुभ्याम् उद्यच्छे \\ इत्य् उद्यच्छते ।
1.2.6.t.m: He lifts it up with: 'With the arms of Indra I lift you up.'

1.2.6.u.m: Having placed it upon his head with: '[With the head] of Bṛhaspati,' he carries it.

1.2.6.v.m: The two [mantras] for going are the two for returning.

1.2.6.w.s: adityāḥ sada āsīda \\ iti paridhideśe 'ntarvedy anadhaḥ sādayati /
1.2.6.w.d: अदित्याः सद आसीद \\ इति परिधिदेशे ऽन्तर्वेद्य् अनधः सादयति ।
1.2.6.w.m: With: 'Sit upon the seat of Aditi,' he sets it down within the altar, in the area of the enclosing-sticks, not on the bare ground.

1.2.6.x.m: He addresses it when set down with: 'You are reaching the gods.'

1.2.6.y.s: adityās tvā pṛṣṭhe sādayāmi \\ iti gārhapatyadeśa upari nidadhāti //
1.2.6.y.d: अदित्यास् त्वा पृष्ठे सादयामि \\ इति गार्हपत्यदेश उपरि निदधाति ॥
1.2.6.y.m: With: 'I place you on the back of Aditi,' he sets it down above in the area of the gārhapatya fire.

1.2.7.a.m: He binds together a fuel bundle of twenty-one pieces of wood, made of palāśa or of khadira.

1.2.7.b.m: Fifteen are for the purpose of the kindling verses.

1.2.7.c.m: Three enclosing-sticks are from any tree [suitable for sacrifice], with bark.

1.2.7.d.s: ārdrā bhavanti te hi sarasās \\ iti vijñāyate śuṣkā bhavanti medhyatvāya \\ iti vijñāyate /
1.2.7.d.d: आर्द्रा भवन्ति ते हि सरसास् \\ इति विज्ञायते शुष्का भवन्ति मेध्यत्वाय \\ इति विज्ञायते ।
1.2.7.d.m: 'They are wet, for they are full of sap,' thus it is known in the Brāhmaṇa; 'They are dry, for the sake of sacrificial fitness,' thus it is known in the Brāhmaṇa.

1.2.7.e.s: sthaviṣṭho madhyamo 'ṇīyān drāghīyān dakṣiṇārdhyo 'ṇiṣṭho hrasiṣṭha uttarārdhyaḥ /
1.2.7.e.d: स्थविष्ठो मध्यमो ऽणीयान् द्राघीयान् दक्षिणार्ध्यो ऽणिष्ठो ह्रसिष्ठ उत्तरार्ध्यः ।
1.2.7.e.m: The middle one is the thickest; the southern one is thinner and longer; the northern one is the thinnest and shortest.

1.2.7.g.m: The kindling-stick for the after-offerings is the twenty-first.

1.2.7.h.s: samūlānām amūlānāṃ vā darbhāṇām ayugdhātu śulbaṃ kṛtvā prāgagram udagagraṃ vā nidadhāti /
1.2.7.h.d: समूलानाम् अमूलानां वा दर्भाणाम् अयुग्धातु शुल्बं कृत्वा प्रागग्रम् उदगग्रं वा निदधाति ।
1.2.7.h.m: Having made an odd-stranded cord of darbha grasses, with roots or without roots, he lays it down with its tips pointed eastward or northward.

1.2.7.i.s: yat kṛṣṇo rūpaṃ kṛtvā \ prāviśas tvaṃ vanaspatīn / \ tatas tvām ekavim̐śatidhā \ saṃbharāmi susaṃbhṛtā / \ trīn paridhīm̐s tisraḥ samidhas \\ yajñāyur anusaṃcarān / \ upaveṣaṃ mekṣaṇaṃ dhṛṣṭim \\ saṃbharāmi susaṃbhṛtā \\ iti śulba idhmam̐ saṃbharati /
1.2.7.i.d: यत् कृष्णो रूपं कृत्वा \ प्राविशस् त्वं वनस्पतीन् । \ ततस् त्वाम् एकविम्̐शतिधा \ संभरामि सुसंभृता । \ त्रीन् परिधीम्̐स् तिस्रः समिधस् \\ यज्ञायुर् अनुसंचरान् । \ उपवेषं मेक्षणं धृष्टिम् \\ संभरामि सुसंभृता \\ इति शुल्ब इध्मम्̐ संभरति ।
1.2.7.i.m: He gathers the fuel on the cord with: 'When taking the form of a black antelope / you entered the trees of the forest, / from there I gather you in twenty-one parts, / well-gathered; / the three enclosing-sticks, the three kindling-sticks / that accompany the life of the sacrifice, / the fire-stirrer, the stirring stick, the poking stick, / I gather, well-gathered.'

1.2.7.j.s: kṛṣṇo 'sy ākhareṣṭhas \\ deva puraścara saghyāsaṃ tvā \\ iti saṃnahyati /
1.2.7.j.d: कृष्णो ऽस्य् आखरेष्ठस् \\ देव पुरश्चर सघ्यासं त्वा \\ इति संनह्यति ।
1.2.7.j.m: He ties it with: 'You are the black deer resting in the lair; / O god, move in front; may I be capable of you.'

1.2.7.k.s: pūṣā te \\ iti pradakṣiṇaṃ granthim āveṣṭya tenaiva kalpena yathā barhiṣi /
1.2.7.k.d: पूषा ते \\ इति प्रदक्षिणं ग्रन्थिम् आवेष्ट्य तेनैव कल्पेन यथा बर्हिषि ।
1.2.7.k.m: Having wound the knot clockwise with: 'May Pūṣan [tie] your [knot],' [he proceeds] according to the very same procedure as for the sacrificial grass,

1.2.7.n.m: He sets it down together with the sacrificial grass.

1.2.7.o.s: vedo 'si \ yena tvaṃ deva veda devebhyo vedo 'bhavas tena mahyaṃ vedo bhūyās \\ iti darbhāṇāṃ vedaṃ karoti /
1.2.7.o.d: वेदो ऽसि \ येन त्वं देव वेद देवेभ्यो वेदो ऽभवस् तेन मह्यं वेदो भूयास् \\ इति दर्भाणां वेदं करोति ।
1.2.7.o.m: With: 'You are the veda; by means of which, O divine veda, you became wealth for the gods, by that may you become wealth for me,' he makes the veda of darbha grasses,

1.2.7.p.m: Shaped like a calf's knee, shaped like a woven basket, shaped like a five-fold [braid], or three-stranded.

1.2.7.q.s: vatsajñuṃ paśukāmasya mūtakāryam annādyakāmasya paṅktikāryaṃ prajākāmasya trivṛtaṃ brahmavarcasakāmasya trivṛcchirasaṃ bruvate /
1.2.7.q.d: वत्सज्ञुं पशुकामस्य मूतकार्यम् अन्नाद्यकामस्य पङ्क्तिकार्यं प्रजाकामस्य त्रिवृतं ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्य त्रिवृच्छिरसं ब्रुवते ।
1.2.7.q.m: They say: [the veda shaped like] a calf's knee is for one desiring cattle; shaped like a woven basket is for one desiring food; shaped like a five-fold [braid] is for one desiring offspring; three-stranded is for one desiring spiritual luster; [and some say it should be] three-stranded at the top.

1.2.7.r.m: He trims it at a notched spot.

1.2.7.s.m: He puts the wood-cuttings and the clippings of the veda together.

1.3.8.a.s: antarvedi śākhāyāḥ palāśāni praśātya sarvāṇi mūlataḥ parivāsya /
1.3.8.a.d: अन्तर्वेदि शाखायाः पलाशानि प्रशात्य सर्वाणि मूलतः परिवास्य ।
1.3.8.a.m: Within the altar, having stripped off all the palāśa leaves of the branch and cut it off from the base,

1.3.8.b.s: upaveṣo 'si yajñāya tvām \\ pariveṣam adhārayan / \ indrāya haviḥ kṛṇvantaḥ \ śivaḥ śagmo bhavāsi nas \\ iti tam upaveṣaṃ karoti /
1.3.8.b.d: उपवेषो ऽसि यज्ञाय त्वाम् \\ परिवेषम् अधारयन् । \ इन्द्राय हविः कृण्वन्तः \ शिवः शग्मो भवासि नस् \\ इति तम् उपवेषं करोति ।
1.3.8.b.m: He makes it into the fire-stirrer with: 'You are the fire-stirrer; for the sacrifice / they took you as an attendant; / preparing the sacrificial oblation for Indra, / be auspicious and benevolent to us.'

1.3.8.c.m: Upon it he makes a three-stranded strainer made of darbha grass, without a split.

1.3.8.d.s: trivṛtpalāśe darbha iyān prādeśasaṃmitaḥ / yajñe pavitraṃ potṛtamam \\ payo havyaṃ karotu me \\ iti mūle mūlam upasṛjaty agre 'graṃ na granthiṃ karoti /
1.3.8.d.d: त्रिवृत्पलाशे दर्भ इयान् प्रादेशसंमितः । यज्ञे पवित्रं पोतृतमम् \\ पयो हव्यं करोतु मे \\ इति मूले मूलम् उपसृजत्य् अग्रे ऽग्रं न ग्रन्थिं करोति ।
1.3.8.d.m: With: 'Darbha grass of this size, measuring a span, on the three-leaved palāśa branch; / may the most purifying strainer at the sacrifice / make the milk into a sacrificial offering for me,' he joins root to root and tip to tip; he does not make a knot.

1.3.8.e.s: vasūnāṃ pavitram asi śatadhāram iti vā /
1.3.8.e.d: वसूनां पवित्रम् असि शतधारम् इति वा ।
1.3.8.e.m: Or with: 'You are the strainer of the Vasus, having a hundred streams.'

1.3.8.g.m: Having rinsed the utensils for the curd-and-milk oblation in pairs, he arranges them face down:

1.3.8.h.s: agnihotrahavaṇīm ukhām upaveṣam̐ śākhāpavitram abhidhānīṃ nidāne dohanam ayaspātraṃ dārupātraṃ vāpidhānārtham /
1.3.8.h.d: अग्निहोत्रहवणीम् उखाम् उपवेषम्̐ शाखापवित्रम् अभिधानीं निदाने दोहनम् अयस्पात्रं दारुपात्रं वापिधानार्थम् ।
1.3.8.h.m: The Agnihotra-ladle, the pot, the fire-stirrer, the branch-strainer, the halter, the two tethers, the milking-vessel, and a metal pot or a wooden vessel for covering.

1.3.8.i.s: samāv apracchinnāgrau darbhau prādeśamātrau pavitre karoti /
1.3.8.i.d: समाव् अप्रच्छिन्नाग्रौ दर्भौ प्रादेशमात्रौ पवित्रे करोति ।
1.3.8.i.m: He makes two strainers out of two equal darbha blades of a span's length, whose tips are not broken off.

1.3.8.j.s: pavitre stho vaiṣṇavī \ vāyur vāṃ manasā punātu \\ iti tṛṇaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ vāntardhāya chinatti /
1.3.8.j.d: पवित्रे स्थो वैष्णवी \ वायुर् वां मनसा पुनातु \\ इति तृणं काष्ठं वान्तर्धाय छिनत्ति ।
1.3.8.j.m: With: 'You two are strainers sacred to Viṣṇu; may Vāyu purify you with the mind,' he cuts them, placing a blade of grass or a piece of wood between.

1.3.8.k.s: na nakhena \\ imau prāṇāpānau \ yajñasyāṅgāni sarvaśaḥ / \ āpyāyayantau saṃcaratām \\ pavitre havyaśodhane \\ ity abhimantrya /
1.3.8.k.d: न नखेन \\ इमौ प्राणापानौ \ यज्ञस्याङ्गानि सर्वशः । \ आप्याययन्तौ संचरताम् \\ पवित्रे हव्यशोधने \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य ।
1.3.8.k.m: Not with the fingernail; having addressed them with: 'May these two, the in-breath and the out-breath, / invigorating all the limbs of the sacrifice, / move about, / two strainers that cleanse the sacrificial offering,'

1.3.8.l.s: viṣṇor manasā pūte sthas \\ ity adbhir unmārṣṭi /
1.3.8.l.d: विष्णोर् मनसा पूते स्थस् \\ इत्य् अद्भिर् उन्मार्ष्टि ।
1.3.8.l.m: He wipes them upward with water, with: 'You two are purified by the mind of Viṣṇu.'

1.3.8.m.m: Having poured water into the Agnihotra-ladle in which the two strainers have been placed,

1.3.8.n.s: devo vas \\ iti paccho gāyatryodagagrābhyāṃ pavitrābhyāṃ trir utpunāti /
1.3.8.n.d: देवो वस् \\ इति पच्छो गायत्र्योदगग्राभ्यां पवित्राभ्यां त्रिर् उत्पुनाति ।
1.3.8.n.m: With: 'May the god [Savitṛ purify] you,' he purifies [the water] three times, quarter by quarter with the Gāyatrī verse, using the two strainers pointed northward.

1.3.8.o.m: He follows with the mantra: 'O divine waters...'

1.3.9.a.s: āpo devīḥ śuddhāḥ stha \\ imā pātrāṇi śundhata / \ upātaṅkyāya devānām \\ parṇavalkam uta śundhata \\ iti vā /
1.3.9.a.d: आपो देवीः शुद्धाः स्थ \\ इमा पात्राणि शुन्धत । \ उपातङ्क्याय देवानाम् \\ पर्णवल्कम् उत शुन्धत \\ इति वा ।
1.3.9.a.m: Or with: 'O divine waters, you are pure; / purify these utensils; / and purify the palāśa bark / for the curds of the gods.'

1.3.9.b.s: śundhadhvam iti triḥ sarvābhir uttānāni pātrāṇi prokṣati śundhantāṃ viśvakarmāṇi devayajyāyai \ daivyāya karmaṇe śundhadhvam \\ yad vo 'śuddhāḥ parājagmus tad va etena śundhatām iti vā /
1.3.9.b.d: शुन्धध्वम् इति त्रिः सर्वाभिर् उत्तानानि पात्राणि प्रोक्षति शुन्धन्तां विश्वकर्माणि देवयज्यायै \ दैव्याय कर्मणे शुन्धध्वम् \\ यद् वो ऽशुद्धाः पराजग्मुस् तद् व एतेन शुन्धताम् इति वा ।
1.3.9.b.m: With: 'Be purified,' he sprinkles the upright vessels three times with all [the waters], or with: 'May the actions of all be purified for the worship of the gods; be purified for divine work; whatever impurity has overcome you, may it be purified from you by this.'

1.3.9.c.s: etā ācaranti madhumad duhānāḥ \ prajāvatīr yaśaso viśvarūpāḥ / \ bahvīr bhavantīr upajāyamānās \\ iha va indro ramayatu gāvas \\ iti gā āyatīḥ pratīkṣate /
1.3.9.c.d: एता आचरन्ति मधुमद् दुहानाः \ प्रजावतीर् यशसो विश्वरूपाः । \ बह्वीर् भवन्तीर् उपजायमानास् \\ इह व इन्द्रो रमयतु गावस् \\ इति गा आयतीः प्रतीक्षते ।
1.3.9.c.m: With: 'These cows approach, yielding sweet milk, / having abundant offspring, glorious, omniform; / becoming many, being born here, / may Indra cause you to delight here, O cows,' he looks at the cows as they arrive.

1.3.9.d.m: Having taken up the fire-stirrer with: 'You are the poker,'

1.3.9.e.s: nirūḍhaṃ janyaṃ bhayam \\ saha tena yaṃ dviṣmas \\ subhūtāya śrayadhvam iti tena gārhapatyād udīco 'ṅgārān nirūhya /
1.3.9.e.d: निरूढं जन्यं भयम् \\ सह तेन यं द्विष्मस् \\ सुभूताय श्रयध्वम् इति तेन गार्हपत्याद् उदीचो ऽङ्गारान् निरूह्य ।
1.3.9.e.m: Having pushed out the embers toward the north from the gārhapatya fire with it, with: 'Banished is foreign danger / along with him whom we hate; / rest for welfare,'

1.3.9.f.m: With [the words,] 'Of Mātariśvan…' he places the pot over [the coals].

1.3.9.g.s: aprasram̐sāya yajñasya \\ ukhe upadadhāmy aham / \ paśubhiḥ saṃnītaṃ bibhṛtām \ indrāya śṛtaṃ dadhi \\ iti vā /
1.3.9.g.d: अप्रस्रम्̐साय यज्ञस्य \\ उखे उपदधाम्य् अहम् । \ पशुभिः संनीतं बिभृताम् \ इन्द्राय शृतं दधि \\ इति वा ।
1.3.9.g.m: Or with: 'For the non-slipping of the sacrifice / I set down the two cooking-pots; / let them hold what has been brought together through cattle, / the boiled [milk and] curd for Indra.'

1.3.9.h.s: bhṛgūṇām aṅgirasāṃ tapasā tapyasva \\ ity aṅgāraiḥ parīndhe /
1.3.9.h.d: भृगूणाम् अङ्गिरसां तपसा तप्यस्व \\ इत्य् अङ्गारैः परीन्धे ।
1.3.9.h.m: With [the words,] 'Heat up through the heat of the Bhṛgus, of the Aṅgirases,' he surrounds [it] with coals.

1.3.9.i.m: He gives the ritual direction: 'Announce to me [the cow] that has been let loose [to the calf]!'

1.3.9.j.s: vasūnāṃ pavitram asi sahasradhāram iti kumbhyāṃ prāgagram̐ śākhāpavitram ādadhāti /
1.3.9.j.d: वसूनां पवित्रम् असि सहस्रधारम् इति कुम्भ्यां प्रागग्रम्̐ शाखापवित्रम् आदधाति ।
1.3.9.j.m: With [the words,] 'You are the strainer of the Vasus, thousand-streamed,' he places the branch-strainer in the pot with its tip pointing eastward.

1.3.9.k.m: Having taken hold [of it], he restrains his speech and sits holding [it].

1.3.9.l.m: With [the words,] 'You are Aditi's girdle,' he takes the tethering-rope.

1.3.10.a.s: trayastrim̐śo 'si tantūnām \\ pavitreṇa sahāgahi / \ śiveyam̐ rajjur abhidhānī \\ aghniyām upasevatām iti vā /
1.3.10.a.d: त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शो ऽसि तन्तूनाम् \\ पवित्रेण सहागहि । \ शिवेयम्̐ रज्जुर् अभिधानी \\ अघ्नियाम् उपसेवताम् इति वा ।
1.3.10.a.m: Or with: 'You are the thirty-third of the threads; / come along with the strainer; / may this rope, the tethering-rope, auspicious, / attend upon the inviolable cow.'

1.3.10.b.m: With [the words,] 'You are Pūṣan,' he lets loose the calf.

1.3.10.c.m: Or he recites over it as it runs.

1.3.10.d.s: vihāraṃ gāṃ copasṛṣṭām \ antareṇa mā saṃcāriṣṭa \\ iti saṃpreṣyati na duhyamānām antareṇa yanti vihāraṃ gāṃ ca /
1.3.10.d.d: विहारं गां चोपसृष्टाम् \ अन्तरेण मा संचारिष्ट \\ इति संप्रेष्यति न दुह्यमानाम् अन्तरेण यन्ति विहारं गां च ।
1.3.10.d.m: He gives the ritual direction: 'Do not pass between the sacrificial area and the cow that has been let loose!' They do not pass between the sacrificial area and the cow while she is being milked.

1.3.10.e.s: yadi vyaveyāt sāṃnāyyaṃ mā vilopi \\ iti brūyāt /
1.3.10.e.d: यदि व्यवेयात् सांनाय्यं मा विलोपि \\ इति ब्रूयात् ।
1.3.10.e.m: If someone should step between, he should say: 'May the curd-and-milk oblation not be destroyed!'

1.3.10.f.s: ūrjaṃ payaḥ pinvamānā ghṛtaṃ ca \ jīvo jīvantīr upa vaḥ sadeyam ity upasannām /
1.3.10.f.d: ऊर्जं पयः पिन्वमाना घृतं च \ जीवो जीवन्तीर् उप वः सदेयम् इत्य् उपसन्नाम् ।
1.3.10.f.m: With [the words,] 'Swelling with refreshment, milk, and clarified butter, / may I, living, sit beside you who are living,' [he recites over the cow] when she has approached.

1.3.10.g.s: dyauś cemaṃ yajñaṃ pṛthivī ca saṃduhātām \\ dhātā somena saha vātena vāyuḥ / \ yajamānāya draviṇaṃ dadhātu \\ iti duhyamānām utsaṃ duhanti kalaśaṃ caturbilam iḍāṃ devīṃ madhumatīm̐ suvarvidam / \ tad indrāgnī jinvatam̐ sūnṛtāvat \ tad yajamānam amṛtatve dadhātu \\ iti dhārāghoṣam anumantrayate /
1.3.10.g.d: द्यौश् चेमं यज्ञं पृथिवी च संदुहाताम् \\ धाता सोमेन सह वातेन वायुः । \ यजमानाय द्रविणं दधातु \\ इति दुह्यमानाम् उत्सं दुहन्ति कलशं चतुर्बिलम् इडां देवीं मधुमतीम्̐ सुवर्विदम् । \ तद् इन्द्राग्नी जिन्वतम्̐ सूनृतावत् \ तद् यजमानम् अमृतत्वे दधातु \\ इति धाराघोषम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
1.3.10.g.m: With [the words,] 'May both heaven and earth milk this sacrifice together; / may Dhātṛ, [and] Vāyu with Soma and the wind, / grant wealth to the sacrificer,' [he recites over her] while she is being milked; with [the verse,] 'They milk the well, the four-spouted jar, / the divine Iḍā, honey-rich, finding the sun; / let Indra and Agni, full of truth, quicken that; / let that place the sacrificer in immortality,' he recites over the sound of the milk-stream.

1.3.10.i.s: taṃ pṛcchati kāmadhukṣaḥ pra ṇo brūhi /
1.3.10.i.d: तं पृच्छति कामधुक्षः प्र णो ब्रूहि ।
1.3.10.i.m: He asks him: 'Which [cow] have you milked? Announce to us!'

1.3.10.j.s: amūm \\ yasyāṃ devānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ payo hitam iti \\ asau \\ iti godhug ācaṣṭe /
1.3.10.j.d: अमूम् \\ यस्यां देवानां मनुष्याणां पयो हितम् इति \\ असौ \\ इति गोधुग् आचष्टे ।
1.3.10.j.m: The cow-milker declares: 'That one, in whom the milk of gods and men is deposited—that one.'

1.3.10.l.s: devas tvā savitā punātu vasoḥ pavitreṇa śatadhāreṇa supuvā \\ iti kumbhyām ānayati /
1.3.10.l.d: देवस् त्वा सविता पुनातु वसोः पवित्रेण शतधारेण सुपुवा \\ इति कुम्भ्याम् आनयति ।
1.3.10.l.m: he pours [the milk] into the pot with: 'May the divine Savitṛ purify you with the Vasu's strainer of a hundred streams, well-cleansing.'

1.3.10.m.m: With whatever [mantras are used] other than the ritual direction, he causes the subsequent [cows] to be milked.

1.3.10.n.s: sā viśvavyacās \\ iti dvitīyām \\ sā viśvakarmā \\ iti tṛtīyām /
1.3.10.n.d: सा विश्वव्यचास् \\ इति द्वितीयाम् \\ सा विश्वकर्मा \\ इति तृतीयाम् ।
1.3.10.n.m: With 'She is all-encompassing,' [he responds] for the second; with 'She is all-working,' for the third.

1.3.10.o.s: tisro dohayitvā bahu dugdhīndrāya devebhyas \\ havyam āpyāyatāṃ punar \ vatsebhyo manuṣyebhyas \\ punar dohāya kalpatām iti triḥ saṃpreṣyati /
1.3.10.o.d: तिस्रो दोहयित्वा बहु दुग्धीन्द्राय देवेभ्यस् \\ हव्यम् आप्यायतां पुनर् \ वत्सेभ्यो मनुष्येभ्यस् \\ पुनर् दोहाय कल्पताम् इति त्रिः संप्रेष्यति ।
1.3.10.o.m: Having caused three [cows] to be milked, he gives the ritual direction three times: 'Milk much for Indra, for the gods! / Let the oblation swell again; / for the calves, for men, / let it be fit for milking again!'

1.3.10.p.m: Having released his speech, without holding on,

1.3.11.a.m: he causes the remaining [cows] to be milked, or silently.

1.3.11.b.s: sarvāsu dugdhāsu hutaḥ stokas \\ iti vipruṣo 'numantrayate /
1.3.11.b.d: सर्वासु दुग्धासु हुतः स्तोकस् \\ इति विप्रुषो ऽनुमन्त्रयते ।
1.3.11.b.m: When all have been milked, he recites over the drops with: 'Offered is the drop…'

1.3.11.c.m: With 'May both heaven and earth… [milk] this sacrifice…' [he recites over] the curd-and-milk oblation.

1.3.11.d.m: Having rinsed the milking vessel, he pours [the water] into the pot with: 'Mix together!'

1.3.11.e.m: Having boiled [it], having poured over [it] clarified butter silently,

1.3.11.f.s: dṛm̐ha gās \\ dṛm̐ha gopatim \\ mā vo yajñapatī riṣat \\ iti prācīnam udīcīnaṃ prāgudag vā karṣann ivodvāsayati /
1.3.11.f.d: दृम्̐ह गास् \\ दृम्̐ह गोपतिम् \\ मा वो यज्ञपती रिषत् \\ इति प्राचीनम् उदीचीनं प्रागुदग् वा कर्षन्न् इवोद्वासयति ।
1.3.11.f.m: with [the words,] 'Strengthen the cows, strengthen the lord of cows, / may the lord of the sacrifice not harm you,' he removes [it from the fire], as if dragging it toward the east, toward the north, or toward the northeast.

1.3.11.g.s: pūrvedyurdugdhaṃ dadhi havirātañcanam ekasyā dvayos tisṛṇāṃ vaikāhe dvyahe tryahe vā saṃtatam abhidugdham aupavasathād bhavati /
1.3.11.g.d: पूर्वेद्युर्दुग्धं दधि हविरातञ्चनम् एकस्या द्वयोस् तिसृणां वैकाहे द्व्यहे त्र्यहे वा संततम् अभिदुग्धम् औपवसथाद् भवति ।
1.3.11.g.m: The sacrificial curd curdled on the previous day, which serves as the coagulant, is from one, from two, or from three [cows], continuously milked over one day, two days, or three days, up to the fast-day.

1.3.11.h.s: somena tvātanacmi \\ iti tena śītaṃ budhnaṃ kṛtvātanakti \\ indrasya tvā bhāgam̐ somenātanacmi \\ iti vā /
1.3.11.h.d: सोमेन त्वातनच्मि \\ इति तेन शीतं बुध्नं कृत्वातनक्ति \\ इन्द्रस्य त्वा भागम्̐ सोमेनातनच्मि \\ इति वा ।
1.3.11.h.m: With [the words,] 'With Soma I curdle you,' having made its bottom cool, he curdles [it] with that; or with: 'With Soma I curdle you as the portion of Indra.'

1.3.11.i.s: taṇḍulaiḥ parṇavalkaiḥ kvalair badaraiḥ pūtīkair vā /
1.3.11.i.d: तण्डुलैः पर्णवल्कैः क्वलैर् बदरैः पूतीकैर् वा ।
1.3.11.i.m: [He curdles it] with rice grains, with bark of the parṇa tree, with jujubes, with badara fruits, or with pūtīka plants.

1.3.11.j.s: yajñasya saṃtatir asi \ yajñasya tvā saṃtatim anusaṃtanomi \\ ity agnihotroccheṣaṇam ānayati tūṣṇīṃ vā /
1.3.11.j.d: यज्ञस्य संततिर् असि \ यज्ञस्य त्वा संततिम् अनुसंतनोमि \\ इत्य् अग्निहोत्रोच्छेषणम् आनयति तूष्णीं वा ।
1.3.11.j.m: With [the words,] 'You are the continuity of the sacrifice; I continue you following the continuity of the sacrifice,' he pours in the residue of the Agnihotra, or silently.

1.3.11.k.s: āpo haviḥṣu jāgṛta \ yathā deveṣu jāgratha / \ evam asmin yajñe yajamānāya jāgṛta \\ ity apidhānārthe pātre 'pa ānayati \\ adastam asi viṣṇave tvā \ yajñāyāpidadhāmy aham / \ adbhir ariktena pātreṇa \ yāḥ pūtāḥ pariśerate \\ ity apidadhāti /
1.3.11.k.d: आपो हविःषु जागृत \ यथा देवेषु जाग्रथ । \ एवम् अस्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानाय जागृत \\ इत्य् अपिधानार्थे पात्रे ऽप आनयति \\ अदस्तम् असि विष्णवे त्वा \ यज्ञायापिदधाम्य् अहम् । \ अद्भिर् अरिक्तेन पात्रेण \ याः पूताः परिशेरते \\ इत्य् अपिदधाति ।
1.3.11.k.m: With [the words,] 'O waters, be watchful over the oblations, as you are watchful among the gods; / thus in this sacrifice be watchful for the sacrificer,' he pours water into a vessel meant for covering; with [the verse,] 'You are unbroken; I cover you for Viṣṇu, for the sacrifice, / with a vessel not empty of water, / which [waters] lie around purified,' he covers [it].

1.3.11.l.s: yadi mṛnmayam̐ syāt tṛṇaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ vānupravidhyet /
1.3.11.l.d: यदि मृन्मयम्̐ स्यात् तृणं काष्ठं वानुप्रविध्येत् ।
1.3.11.l.m: If it should be made of clay, he should throw in a blade of grass or a piece of wood.

1.3.11.m.s: imau parṇaṃ ca darbhaṃ ca \ devānām̐ havyaśodhanau / \ prātar veṣāya gopāya \ viṣṇo havyam̐ hi rakṣasi \\ ity unmucya śākhāpavitraṃ prajñātaṃ nidadhāti /
1.3.11.m.d: इमौ पर्णं च दर्भं च \ देवानाम्̐ हव्यशोधनौ । \ प्रातर् वेषाय गोपाय \ विष्णो हव्यम्̐ हि रक्षसि \\ इत्य् उन्मुच्य शाखापवित्रं प्रज्ञातं निदधाति ।
1.3.11.m.m: With [the verse,] 'These two, the parṇa and the darbha grass, / the purifiers of the oblation of the gods— / guard them for the morning service; / for, O Viṣṇu, you protect the oblation,' having untied the branch-strainer, he puts it down in a known place.

1.3.11.n.s: viṣṇo havyam̐ rakṣasva \\ iti sāṃnāyyaṃ gārhapatyadeśa upari nidadhāti //
1.3.11.n.d: विष्णो हव्यम्̐ रक्षस्व \\ इति सांनाय्यं गार्हपत्यदेश उपरि निदधाति ॥
1.3.11.n.m: With [the words,] 'O Viṣṇu, protect the oblation,' he puts down the curd-and-milk oblation in the area of the gārhapatya fire, above [the ground].

1.4.12.a.s: anyām̐ śākhām āhṛtya tenaiva kalpena tayā darbhair vā prātardohāya vatsān apākaroti yathā sāyaṃdohāya /
1.4.12.a.d: अन्याम्̐ शाखाम् आहृत्य तेनैव कल्पेन तया दर्भैर् वा प्रातर्दोहाय वत्सान् अपाकरोति यथा सायंदोहाय ।
1.4.12.a.m: Having fetched another branch, according to that very procedure, with it or with darbha blades, he drives away the calves for the morning milking just as for the evening milking.

1.4.12.b.s: upadhāya kapālāni prātardohaṃ dohayati tasya sāyaṃdohena kalpo vyākhyātaḥ /
1.4.12.b.d: उपधाय कपालानि प्रातर्दोहं दोहयति तस्य सायंदोहेन कल्पो व्याख्यातः ।
1.4.12.b.m: Having arranged the potsherds, he causes the morning milking to be done; its procedure has been explained by the evening milking.

1.4.12.c.s: aprasram̐sāya yajñasya \\ ukhe upadadhāmy aham / \ paśubhiḥ saṃnītaṃ bibhṛtām \ indrāya śṛtam iti mantrāntam̐ saṃnamati /
1.4.12.c.d: अप्रस्रम्̐साय यज्ञस्य \\ उखे उपदधाम्य् अहम् । \ पशुभिः संनीतं बिभृताम् \ इन्द्राय शृतम् इति मन्त्रान्तम्̐ संनमति ।
1.4.12.c.m: He adapts the end of the mantra: 'For the non-slipping of the sacrifice / I set down the two cooking-pots; / let them hold what has been brought together through cattle, / boiled for Indra.'

1.4.12.d.m: He places the branch-strainer with its tip pointing northward.

1.4.12.f.s: nāsomayājī saṃnayed atho khalv āhuḥ kāpeyāḥ saṃneyam evāsomayājineti /
1.4.12.f.d: नासोमयाजी संनयेद् अथो खल्व् आहुः कापेयाः संनेयम् एवासोमयाजिनेति ।
1.4.12.f.m: One who has not performed a soma sacrifice should not offer the curd-and-milk oblation; yet indeed the Kāpeyas say: 'Even one who has not performed a soma sacrifice should offer the curd-and-milk oblation.'

1.4.12.g.m: The curd-and-milk oblation is for Indra; having sacrificed with Soma, he should sacrifice to Mahendra.

1.4.12.h.s: api vā saṃvatsaraṃ dvau vendram iṣṭvāgnaye vratapataye 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirupya kāmaṃ mahendraṃ yajeta /
1.4.12.h.d: अपि वा संवत्सरं द्वौ वेन्द्रम् इष्ट्वाग्नये व्रतपतये ऽष्टाकपालं निरुप्य कामं महेन्द्रं यजेत ।
1.4.12.h.m: Or having sacrificed to Indra for a year or for two [years], having assigned [a cake] on eight potsherds to Agni Vratapati, he may sacrifice to Mahendra at will.

1.4.12.i.s: aurvo gautamo bhāradvājaḥ śuśruvān grāmaṇī rājanya iti sarvatra kāmaṃ mahendraṃ yajeran /
1.4.12.i.d: और्वो गौतमो भारद्वाजः शुश्रुवान् ग्रामणी राजन्य इति सर्वत्र कामं महेन्द्रं यजेरन् ।
1.4.12.i.m: An Aurva, a Gautama, a Bhāradvāja, a learned Brāhmaṇa, a village headman, [or] a kṣatriya may in all cases sacrifice to Mahendra at will.

1.4.12.j.s: paristṛṇīta paridhattāgnim \\ parihito 'gnir yajamānaṃ bhunaktu / \ apām̐ rasa oṣadhīnām̐ suvarṇas \\ niṣkā ime yajamānasya santu \ kāmadughā amutrāmuṣmim̐l loke \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
1.4.12.j.d: परिस्तृणीत परिधत्ताग्निम् \\ परिहितो ऽग्निर् यजमानं भुनक्तु । \ अपाम्̐ रस ओषधीनाम्̐ सुवर्णस् \\ निष्का इमे यजमानस्य सन्तु \ कामदुघा अमुत्रामुष्मिम्̐ल् लोके \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
1.4.12.j.m: He gives the ritual direction: 'Strew around [the fire], enclose the fire; / let the enclosed fire protect the sacrificer; / the sap of the waters, the gold of the plants— / let these golden ornaments belong to the sacrificer, / yielding desires over there in that world!'

1.4.12.k.m: He strews around the fires with darbha grass.

1.4.12.l.s: āhavanīyaṃ paristīrya gārhapatyam atha dakṣiṇāgniṃ gārhapatyaṃ vā paristīrya dakṣiṇāgnim athāhavanīyam /
1.4.12.l.d: आहवनीयं परिस्तीर्य गार्हपत्यम् अथ दक्षिणाग्निं गार्हपत्यं वा परिस्तीर्य दक्षिणाग्निम् अथाहवनीयम् ।
1.4.12.l.m: Having strewn around the āhavanīya fire, [he strews around] the gārhapatya fire, then the dakṣiṇāgni fire; or having strewn around the gārhapatya fire, [then] the dakṣiṇāgni fire, then the āhavanīya fire.

1.4.12.m.m: [The blades] behind and in front have their tips pointing northward.

1.4.12.n.m: Having done this, he fasts on the New Moon day.

1.4.12.p.m: The fueling of the fires and the strewing around the fires take place on the previous day.

1.4.12.q.s: śvo bhūta idhmābarhir vedaṃ ca karoti /
1.4.12.q.d: श्वो भूत इध्माबर्हिर् वेदं च करोति ।
1.4.12.q.m: On the next day he prepares the sacrificial grass and firewood, and the veda.

1.4.13.a.m: When [the performance is] on the same day, he strews around the fires after the rite of the veda.

1.4.13.b.s: prātar agnihotram̐ hutvodita āditye paurṇamāsyās tantraṃ prakramayati prāg udayād amāvāsyāyāḥ /
1.4.13.b.d: प्रातर् अग्निहोत्रम्̐ हुत्वोदित आदित्ये पौर्णमास्यास् तन्त्रं प्रक्रमयति प्राग् उदयाद् अमावास्यायाः ।
1.4.13.b.m: Having offered the morning Agnihotra, when the sun has risen, he initiates the framework of the Full Moon rite; before sunrise, [that] of the New Moon rite.

1.4.13.c.m: Having washed his hands with: 'For the rite, [I wash] you two,'

1.4.13.d.s: yajñasya saṃtatir asi \ yajñasya tvā saṃtatyai stṛṇāmi \ saṃtatyai tvā yajñasya \\ iti gārhapatyāt saṃtatām ulaparājīm̐ stṛṇāty āhavanīyāt tūṣṇīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tūṣṇīm uttarām /
1.4.13.d.d: यज्ञस्य संततिर् असि \ यज्ञस्य त्वा संतत्यै स्तृणामि \ संतत्यै त्वा यज्ञस्य \\ इति गार्हपत्यात् संतताम् उलपराजीम्̐ स्तृणात्य् आहवनीयात् तूष्णीं दक्षिणां तूष्णीम् उत्तराम् ।
1.4.13.d.m: with [the words,] 'You are the continuity of the sacrifice; I strew you for the continuity of the sacrifice; for the continuity of the sacrifice, you,' he strews an unbroken line of coarse grass from the gārhapatya fire up to the āhavanīya fire; silently to the south, silently to the north.

1.4.13.e.m: South of the āhavanīya, he makes the seats for the brahman priest and the sacrificer.

1.4.13.f.m: The eastern [seat] is for the brahman priest, the western for the sacrificer.

1.4.13.g.s: uttareṇa gārhapatyaṃ darbhān sam̐stīrya dvaṃdvaṃ pātrāṇi prakṣālya nyañci prayunakti /
1.4.13.g.d: उत्तरेण गार्हपत्यं दर्भान् सम्̐स्तीर्य द्वंद्वं पात्राणि प्रक्षाल्य न्यञ्चि प्रयुनक्ति ।
1.4.13.g.m: Having spread darbha-grass north of the gārhapatya and rinsed the utensils in pairs, he arranges them face downward:

1.4.13.i.m: the Agnihotra ladle and the winnowing basket;

1.4.13.m.s: aratnimātryo bāhumātryo vā mukhavatyo haṃsamukhaprasecanā agrāgrā bhavanti tvaktobilā vāyasapucchya ity ekeṣām̐ hastyoṣṭhya ity ekeṣām /
1.4.13.m.d: अरत्निमात्र्यो बाहुमात्र्यो वा मुखवत्यो हंसमुखप्रसेचना अग्राग्रा भवन्ति त्वक्तोबिला वायसपुच्छ्य इत्य् एकेषाम्̐ हस्त्योष्ठ्य इत्य् एकेषाम् ।
1.4.13.m.m: they measure a cubit or an arm's length, are fitted with spouts, having spouts shaped like a swan's beak, their tips pointing forward; according to some, their openings are level with the rim, resembling a crow's tail; according to others, they are shaped like an elephant's lip;

1.4.13.p.m: the bunch of grass and the vessel for taking the prāśitra portion;

1.4.13.q.m: the vessel for carrying forward the praṇītā water and the iḍā vessel;

1.4.13.r.m: and one cooking pot for the anvāhārya rice.

1.4.13.s.m: Among them, those whose wood is not specified are of vikaṅkata wood.

1.4.13.t.m: Those not used for oblations, however, are of vāraṇa wood.

1.4.13.u.m: At this point, he arranges the utensils for the morning milking.

1.4.13.v.m: If he does not perform the curd-and-milk oblation, he makes two strainers.

1.4.13.w.m: If he performs the curd-and-milk oblation, the two [strainers] made on the preceding day are kept.

1.4.13.x.s: dakṣāya tvā \\ iti praṇītāpraṇayanaṃ camasam ādāya //
1.4.13.x.d: दक्षाय त्वा \\ इति प्रणीताप्रणयनं चमसम् आदाय ॥
1.4.13.x.m: With the mantra, 'For skill thee,' he takes the praṇītā-cup.

1.4.14.a.s: vānaspatyo 'si devebhyaḥ śundhasva \ devebhyaḥ śumbhasva \ devebhyaḥ śudhyasva \\ iti triḥ prakṣālayati /
1.4.14.a.d: वानस्पत्यो ऽसि देवेभ्यः शुन्धस्व \ देवेभ्यः शुम्भस्व \ देवेभ्यः शुध्यस्व \\ इति त्रिः प्रक्षालयति ।
1.4.14.a.m: He rinses it three times with the mantras: 'Thou art made of wood; be purified for the gods,' 'Be cleansed for the gods,' 'Be made pure for the gods.'

1.4.14.b.m: For one desirous of spiritual luster, he should bring forward [the water] with a bronze vessel; for one desirous of food, with an earthenware vessel.

1.4.14.c.s: apareṇottareṇa vā gārhapatyam upaviśya ko vo gṛhṇāti sa vo gṛhṇātu \ kasmai vo gṛhṇāmi tasmai vo gṛhṇāmi \ poṣāya vas \\ iti pavitrāntarhite pātre 'pa ānayati \\ anayā vo gṛhṇāmi \\ iti pṛthivīṃ manasā dhyāyan /
1.4.14.c.d: अपरेणोत्तरेण वा गार्हपत्यम् उपविश्य को वो गृह्णाति स वो गृह्णातु \ कस्मै वो गृह्णामि तस्मै वो गृह्णामि \ पोषाय वस् \\ इति पवित्रान्तर्हिते पात्रे ऽप आनयति \\ अनया वो गृह्णामि \\ इति पृथिवीं मनसा ध्यायन् ।
1.4.14.c.m: Sitting down behind or to the north of the gārhapatya, he pours water into the vessel with the strainer placed inside it, with the mantra: 'Who takes you? Let him take you. For whom do I take you? For him I take you. For your prosperity'—meditating in his mind on the earth: 'With this [earth] I take you.'

1.4.14.g.s: yāḥ purastāt prasravanti \\ upariṣṭāt sarvataś ca yāḥ / \ tābhī raśmipavitrābhis \\ śraddhāṃ yajñam ārabhe \\ iti vā brahmann apaḥ praṇeṣyāmi \ yajamāna vācaṃ yaccha \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
1.4.14.g.d: याः पुरस्तात् प्रस्रवन्ति \\ उपरिष्टात् सर्वतश् च याः । \ ताभी रश्मिपवित्राभिस् \\ श्रद्धां यज्ञम् आरभे \\ इति वा ब्रह्मन्न् अपः प्रणेष्यामि \ यजमान वाचं यच्छ \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
1.4.14.g.m: Or [with the mantra]: 'They that flow forth in the east, from above, and from every side; / with them, purified by rays, I begin the faith, the sacrifice.' He then issues the direction: 'O brahman priest, I shall bring forward the waters; O sacrificer, restrain your speech!'

1.4.14.h.m: In all addressings, he acts once the impulse has been given.

1.4.14.i.m: Bringing forward [the water], he restrains his speech.

1.4.14.j.m: He releases it at the [call] 'haviskṛt' ('Come, O preparer of the oblation!').

1.4.14.k.s: ko vaḥ praṇayati sa vaḥ praṇayatu \\ apo devīḥ praṇayāmi \ yajñam̐ sam̐sādayantu naḥ / \ iraṃ madantīr ghṛtapṛṣṭhā udākus \\ sahasrapoṣaṃ yajamāne nyañcatīs \\ iti sphenopayamya samaṃ prāṇair dhārayamāṇo viṣiñcan harati /
1.4.14.k.d: को वः प्रणयति स वः प्रणयतु \\ अपो देवीः प्रणयामि \ यज्ञम्̐ सम्̐सादयन्तु नः । \ इरं मदन्तीर् घृतपृष्ठा उदाकुस् \\ सहस्रपोषं यजमाने न्यञ्चतीस् \\ इति स्फेनोपयम्य समं प्राणैर् धारयमाणो विषिञ्चन् हरति ।
1.4.14.k.m: With the mantra: 'Who brings you forward? Let him bring you forward. I bring forward the divine waters; let them establish our sacrifice. Refreshing, boiling, with clarified-butter surfaces, swelling, bringing thousandfold prosperity down into the sacrificer,' having supported [the cup] with the wooden sword, holding it level with his breaths, he carries it without spilling.

1.4.14.l.s: devā gātuvido gātuṃ yajñāya vindata / \ manasas patinā devena vātād yajñaḥ prayujyatām iti vā /
1.4.14.l.d: देवा गातुविदो गातुं यज्ञाय विन्दत । \ मनसस् पतिना देवेन वाताद् यज्ञः प्रयुज्यताम् इति वा ।
1.4.14.l.m: Or [with the mantra]: 'O path-finding gods, find the path for the sacrifice. / Urged by the lord of thought, the divine [one], let the sacrifice proceed from the wind.'

1.4.14.m.s: brahmapūtāḥ stha \ ko vo yunakti sa vo yunaktu \ viśvebhyaḥ kāmebhyo devayajyāyai \\ ity uttareṇāhavanīyaṃ darbheṣu sādayitvā darbhair apidadhāti /
1.4.14.m.d: ब्रह्मपूताः स्थ \ को वो युनक्ति स वो युनक्तु \ विश्वेभ्यः कामेभ्यो देवयज्यायै \\ इत्य् उत्तरेणाहवनीयं दर्भेषु सादयित्वा दर्भैर् अपिदधाति ।
1.4.14.m.m: Having set it down on darbha-grass to the north of the āhavanīya with the mantra: 'You are purified by the brahman. Who yokes you? Let him yoke you, for all desires, for worship of the gods,' he covers it with darbha-grass.

1.4.14.n.m: They do not move them until the conclusion [of the sacrifice].

1.4.14.o.s: saṃviśantāṃ daivīr viśaḥ pātrāṇi devayajyāyai \\ iti sapavitreṇa pāṇinā pātrāṇi saṃmṛśati //
1.4.14.o.d: संविशन्तां दैवीर् विशः पात्राणि देवयज्यायै \\ इति सपवित्रेण पाणिना पात्राणि संमृशति ॥
1.4.14.o.m: With the mantra, 'Let the divine clans enter the utensils for worship of the gods,' he touches the utensils with the hand holding the strainer.

1.5.15.a.s: dakṣāya vānaspatyāsi \\ ity agnihotrahavaṇīm ādatte veṣāya tvā \\ iti śūrpam /
1.5.15.a.d: दक्षाय वानस्पत्यासि \\ इत्य् अग्निहोत्रहवणीम् आदत्ते वेषाय त्वा \\ इति शूर्पम् ।
1.5.15.a.m: With the mantra, 'For skill, made of wood art thou,' he takes the Agnihotra ladle; with 'For work thee,' the winnowing basket.

1.5.15.b.s: pratyuṣṭam ity āhavanīye gārhapatye vā niṣṭapati /
1.5.15.b.d: प्रत्युष्टम् इत्य् आहवनीये गार्हपत्ये वा निष्टपति ।
1.5.15.b.m: With the mantra, 'Scorched [is the Rakṣas]...,' he warms them over the āhavanīya or the gārhapatya.

1.5.15.c.m: He addresses [the sacrificer]: 'O sacrificer, I shall mete out the oblation.'

1.5.15.e.m: he should say: 'O Agni, I shall mete out the oblation.'

1.5.15.f.m: With the mantra, 'I pursue the wide intermediate space,' he goes [to the cart].

1.5.15.g.s: apareṇāhavanīyam apareṇa vā gārhapatyaṃ naddhayugam̐ sapariṇatkam̐ śakaṭam avasthitaṃ vrīhimad yavamad vā prāgīṣam udagīṣaṃ vā /
1.5.15.g.d: अपरेणाहवनीयम् अपरेण वा गार्हपत्यं नद्धयुगम्̐ सपरिणत्कम्̐ शकटम् अवस्थितं व्रीहिमद् यवमद् वा प्रागीषम् उदगीषं वा ।
1.5.15.g.m: Behind the āhavanīya or behind the gārhapatya, a cart is stationed, with its yoke tied, covered with an awning, containing rice or barley, its pole facing east or north.

1.5.15.h.s: dhūr asi \\ iti tasya dakṣiṇāṃ dhuram ālabhya /
1.5.15.h.d: धूर् असि \\ इति तस्य दक्षिणां धुरम् आलभ्य ।
1.5.15.h.m: Touching its southern yoke with the mantra, 'Thou art the yoke,'

1.5.15.i.s: tvaṃ devānām iti savyām īṣām ālabhya japati /
1.5.15.i.d: त्वं देवानाम् इति सव्याम् ईषाम् आलभ्य जपति ।
1.5.15.i.m: and touching the left pole, he murmurs: 'Thou [belongest] to the gods...'

1.5.15.j.s: viṣṇus tvākram̐sta \\ iti savye cakre dakṣiṇaṃ pādam ādadhāti /
1.5.15.j.d: विष्णुस् त्वाक्रम्̐स्त \\ इति सव्ये चक्रे दक्षिणं पादम् आदधाति ।
1.5.15.j.m: With the mantra, 'Viṣṇu strode over thee,' he places his right foot on the left wheel.

1.5.15.l.m: With the mantra, 'Of Mitra thee...,' he looks at the awning.

1.5.15.m.s: uru vātāya \\ iti pariṇaho dvāram apacchādayati /
1.5.15.m.d: उरु वाताय \\ इति परिणहो द्वारम् अपच्छादयति ।
1.5.15.m.m: With the mantra, 'Broad for the wind,' he uncovers the opening of the awning.

1.5.15.n.s: mitrasya tvā \\ iti puroḍāśyān pariṇahaṃ ca prekṣate /
1.5.15.n.d: मित्रस्य त्वा \\ इति पुरोडाश्यान् परिणहं च प्रेक्षते ।
1.5.15.n.m: With the mantra, 'Of Mitra thee...,' he looks at the materials for the sacrificial cake and the awning.

1.5.15.o.m: With the mantra, 'Bestow strength,' he touches the materials for the sacrificial cake.

1.5.15.p.s: payo mayi dhehi \\ ity ātmānaṃ pratyabhimṛśati /
1.5.15.p.d: पयो मयि धेहि \\ इत्य् आत्मानं प्रत्यभिमृशति ।
1.5.15.p.m: With the mantra, 'Place milk in me,' he touches himself in turn.

1.5.15.q.s: apahatam̐ rakṣas \\ iti tatas tṛṇaṃ loṣṭaṃ vā nirasyāpa upaspṛśya /
1.5.15.q.d: अपहतम्̐ रक्षस् \\ इति ततस् तृणं लोष्टं वा निरस्याप उपस्पृश्य ।
1.5.15.q.m: With the mantra, 'Slain is the Rakṣas,' he casts out from there a piece of grass or a clod of earth and touches water.

1.5.15.s.s: yacchantāṃ pañca \ gopīthāya vo nārātaye \\ iti muṣṭiṃ pūrayitvā /
1.5.15.s.d: यच्छन्तां पञ्च \ गोपीथाय वो नारातये \\ इति मुष्टिं पूरयित्वा ।
1.5.15.s.m: he fills a handful with the mantra: 'May the five restrain [you]; for your protection, not for evil,'

1.5.15.u.s: devasya tvā \\ iti pavitrāntarhite caturo muṣṭīn nirvapati trir yajuṣā tūṣṇīṃ caturtham /
1.5.15.u.d: देवस्य त्वा \\ इति पवित्रान्तर्हिते चतुरो मुष्टीन् निर्वपति त्रिर् यजुषा तूष्णीं चतुर्थम् ।
1.5.15.u.m: With the mantra, 'Of divine Savitṛ thee...,' he metes out four handfuls into [the winnowing basket] with the strainer placed inside it: three times with a yajus, the fourth silently.

1.5.15.w.s: etenaiva kalpena yathādevatam uttaraṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapati /
1.5.15.w.d: एतेनैव कल्पेन यथादेवतम् उत्तरं पुरोडाशं निर्वपति ।
1.5.15.w.m: By this very procedure, he metes out [the grain for] the second sacrificial cake according to its deity.

1.5.15.x.s: pātryāṃ vā nirvapati dakṣiṇataḥ sphyam upakṛṣya sarvāñ śakaṭamantrān uktvā /
1.5.15.x.d: पात्र्यां वा निर्वपति दक्षिणतः स्फ्यम् उपकृष्य सर्वाञ् शकटमन्त्रान् उक्त्वा ।
1.5.15.x.m: Or he metes it out into a vessel, having drawn the wooden sword from the south and recited all the cart-mantras.

1.5.15.y.s: idaṃ devānām iti niruptān abhimṛśati \\ idam u naḥ saha \\ iti yato 'dhi nirvapati /
1.5.15.y.d: इदं देवानाम् इति निरुप्तान् अभिमृशति \\ इदम् उ नः सह \\ इति यतो ऽधि निर्वपति ।
1.5.15.y.m: With the mantra, 'This belongs to the gods,' he touches the meted-out grains; with 'And this is ours together,' that from which he metes it out.

1.5.15.z.m: [He touches] only the poured-out [grains] with [the mantra]: 'For abundance thee!'

1.5.15.aa.s: idam ahaṃ nir varuṇasya pāśāt \\ iti puroḍāśyān ādāya pariṇaha upaniḥsarpati /
1.5.15.aa.d: इदम् अहं निर् वरुणस्य पाशात् \\ इति पुरोडाश्यान् आदाय परिणह उपनिःसर्पति ।
1.5.15.aa.m: Taking the materials for the cake, he slips out along the enclosure-mat with [the mantra]: 'Here I [step out] free from Varuṇa's bond.'

1.5.15.ab.m: [With the mantra:] 'May I look upon the light of heaven!'

1.5.16.a.m: he looks intently upon the entire sacrifice.

1.5.16.b.m: With [the mantra]: 'The light of Vaiśvānara,' he looks towards the āhavanīya fire.

1.5.16.c.m: With [the mantra]: 'Let the homesteads stand firm,' he steps down.

1.5.16.d.s: svāhā dyāvāpṛthivībhyām \\ iti skannān anumantrayate \\ urv antarikṣam anvihi \\ iti gacchati /
1.5.16.d.d: स्वाहा द्यावापृथिवीभ्याम् \\ इति स्कन्नान् अनुमन्त्रयते \\ उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम् अन्विहि \\ इति गच्छति ।
1.5.16.d.m: With [the mantra]: 'Svāhā to Heaven and Earth!' he pronounces a mantra over what has spilled. With [the mantra]: 'Go along the wide atmosphere!' he walks [forward].

1.5.16.e.s: adityās tvopasthe sādayāmi \\ ity apareṇāhavanīyam apareṇa vā gārhapatyam upasādayati /
1.5.16.e.d: अदित्यास् त्वोपस्थे सादयामि \\ इत्य् अपरेणाहवनीयम् अपरेण वा गार्हपत्यम् उपसादयति ।
1.5.16.e.m: With [the mantra]: 'I set thee down in the lap of Aditi,' he sets [them] down west of the āhavanīya fire, or west of the gārhapatya fire,

1.5.16.f.m: in whichever fire he cooks [the oblations].

1.5.16.g.s: agne havyam̐ rakṣasva \\ iti yathādevataṃ paridadāti /
1.5.16.g.d: अग्ने हव्यम्̐ रक्षस्व \\ इति यथादेवतं परिददाति ।
1.5.16.g.m: With [the mantra]: 'O Agni, protect the sacrificial oblation!' he entrusts [it], according to the respective deity.

1.5.16.h.s: saśūkāyām̐ sruci prokṣaṇīḥ sam̐skṛtya yathā purastāt /
1.5.16.h.d: सशूकायाम्̐ स्रुचि प्रोक्षणीः सम्̐स्कृत्य यथा पुरस्तात् ।
1.5.16.h.m: Having prepared the sprinkling-waters in a ladle with a beak, as before,

1.5.16.i.m: he calls out: 'O brahman priest, I shall sprinkle.'

1.5.16.j.s: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām agnaye vo juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmy amuṣmā amuṣmai \\ iti yathādevataṃ triḥ prokṣati /
1.5.16.j.d: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम् अग्नये वो जुष्टं प्रोक्षाम्य् अमुष्मा अमुष्मै \\ इति यथादेवतं त्रिः प्रोक्षति ।
1.5.16.j.m: With [the mantra]: 'At the instigation of divine Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I sprinkle you, agreeable to Agni, to such-and-such, to such-and-such,' he sprinkles [the oblations] three times according to the respective deity.

1.5.16.l.m: He sprinkles the vessels, as before.

1.5.16.m.s: vātasya dhrājir asi \\ iti kṛṣṇājinam ādatte devasya tvā \\ iti vā /
1.5.16.m.d: वातस्य ध्राजिर् असि \\ इति कृष्णाजिनम् आदत्ते देवस्य त्वा \\ इति वा ।
1.5.16.m.m: With [the mantra]: 'Thou art the rush of the wind,' or with: 'At [the instigation] of divine [Savitṛ]…', he takes up the black antelope skin.

1.5.16.n.s: avadhūtam̐ rakṣas \\ ity ūrdhvagrīvaṃ bahirviśasanam utkare trir avadhūnoti /
1.5.16.n.d: अवधूतम्̐ रक्षस् \\ इत्य् ऊर्ध्वग्रीवं बहिर्विशसनम् उत्करे त्रिर् अवधूनोति ।
1.5.16.n.m: With [the mantra]: 'Shaken off is the rakṣas,' he shakes it out three times over the rubbish heap, with the neck-part upwards, turned away from the butchering-place.

1.5.16.o.s: adityās tvag asi \\ ity apareṇotkaraṃ pratīcīnagrīvam uttaralomāstṛṇāti /
1.5.16.o.d: अदित्यास् त्वग् असि \\ इत्य् अपरेणोत्करं प्रतीचीनग्रीवम् उत्तरलोमास्तृणाति ।
1.5.16.o.m: With [the mantra]: 'Thou art the skin of Aditi,' he spreads it west of the rubbish heap, with its neck towards the west and the hairy side upwards.

1.5.16.p.s: prati tvā pṛthivī vettu \\ iti purastāt pratīcīṃ bhasadam upasamasyati /
1.5.16.p.d: प्रति त्वा पृथिवी वेत्तु \\ इति पुरस्तात् प्रतीचीं भसदम् उपसमस्यति ।
1.5.16.p.m: With [the mantra]: 'May the earth welcome thee,' he folds the rear part from the east towards the west.

1.5.16.q.s: adhiṣavaṇam asi \\ ity anutsṛjan kṛṣṇājinam ulūkhalam adhivartayati /
1.5.16.q.d: अधिषवणम् असि \\ इत्य् अनुत्सृजन् कृष्णाजिनम् उलूखलम् अधिवर्तयति ।
1.5.16.q.m: Without letting go of the black antelope skin, he sets the mortar upon it with [the mantra]: 'Thou art the pressing-place.'

1.5.16.r.s: agnes tanūr asi \\ ity anutsṛjann ulūkhale havir āvapati trir yajuṣā tūṣṇīṃ caturtham /
1.5.16.r.d: अग्नेस् तनूर् असि \\ इत्य् अनुत्सृजन्न् उलूखले हविर् आवपति त्रिर् यजुषा तूष्णीं चतुर्थम् ।
1.5.16.r.m: Without letting go of the mortar, he pours the sacrificial oblation into it with [the mantra]: 'Thou art the body of Agni'—three times with the yajus, silently the fourth time.

1.5.16.s.m: [With the mantra:] 'Thou art the rock, made of wood,'

1.5.17.b.s: ūrdhvasūr asi vānaspatas \\ iti vā \\ avarakṣo divaḥ sapatnaṃ vadhyāsam iti trir avahanti \\ apahatā yātudhānās \\ apahato 'ghaśam̐sas \\ iti vā /
1.5.17.b.d: ऊर्ध्वसूर् असि वानस्पतस् \\ इति वा \\ अवरक्षो दिवः सपत्नं वध्यासम् इति त्रिर् अवहन्ति \\ अपहता यातुधानास् \\ अपहतो ऽघशम्̐सस् \\ इति वा ।
1.5.17.b.m: Or with: 'Thou art the upward-producing one, made of wood.' With [the mantra]: 'May I strike down the rakṣas, the rival from heaven,' he pounds three times; or with: 'The sorcerers are struck down; struck down is the malevolent speaker.'

1.5.17.c.s: haviṣkṛd ehi \\ iti trir avaghnan haviṣkṛtam āhvayati /
1.5.17.c.d: हविष्कृद् एहि \\ इति त्रिर् अवघ्नन् हविष्कृतम् आह्वयति ।
1.5.17.c.m: Pounding three times, he calls the preparer of the sacrificial oblation with: 'O preparer of the sacrificial oblation, come!'

1.5.17.e.s: ādrava \\ iti rājanyasya \\ āgahi \\ iti vaiśyasya /
1.5.17.e.d: आद्रव \\ इति राजन्यस्य \\ आगहि \\ इति वैश्यस्य ।
1.5.17.e.m: 'Run hither!' [he says] for a Rājanya; 'Arrive!' for a Vaiśya.

1.5.17.f.m: When the rice grains have become visible, he gives the ritual direction: 'Strike loudly together!'

1.5.17.g.s: adrir asi ślokakṛt \\ ity āgnīdhro 'śmānam ādatte /
1.5.17.g.d: अद्रिर् असि श्लोककृत् \\ इत्य् आग्नीध्रो ऽश्मानम् आदत्ते ।
1.5.17.g.m: With [the mantra]: 'Thou art the rock that makes a sound,' the āgnīdhra takes up a stone;

1.5.17.h.s: kuṭarur asi madhujihvas \\ iti vā kukkuṭo 'si madhujihvas \\ iti vā /
1.5.17.h.d: कुटरुर् असि मधुजिह्वस् \\ इति वा कुक्कुटो ऽसि मधुजिह्वस् \\ इति वा ।
1.5.17.h.m: or with: 'Thou art the kuṭaru bird, honey-tongued,' or with: 'Thou art the cock, honey-tongued.'

1.5.17.i.s: iṣam āvada \\ ūrjam āvada \\ iti tena dṛṣadupale samāhanti /
1.5.17.i.d: इषम् आवद \\ ऊर्जम् आवद \\ इति तेन दृषदुपले समाहन्ति ।
1.5.17.i.m: With [the words]: 'Speak forth food! Speak forth nourishment!' he strikes the lower and upper millstones with it:

1.5.17.j.m: twice on the lower millstone, once on the upper millstone.

1.5.17.k.m: Repeating this three times, he brings the total to nine times.

1.5.17.l.m: Or [he strikes] with the yoke-pin; silently he takes up the yoke-pin.

1.5.17.m.s: varṣavṛddham asi \\ iti purastād uttarato vā śūrpam upohati /
1.5.17.m.d: वर्षवृद्धम् असि \\ इति पुरस्ताद् उत्तरतो वा शूर्पम् उपोहति ।
1.5.17.m.m: With [the mantra]: 'Thou art rain-grown,' he pushes the winnowing-basket under from the east or from the north.

1.5.17.n.m: With [the mantra]: 'You are rain-grown,' he touches the materials for the cake.

1.5.17.o.s: prati tvā varṣavṛddhaṃ vettu \\ ity udvapati /
1.5.17.o.d: प्रति त्वा वर्षवृद्धं वेत्तु \\ इत्य् उद्वपति ।
1.5.17.o.m: With [the mantra]: 'May the rain-grown one welcome thee,' he pours [them] out [into the winnowing-basket].

1.5.17.p.s: parāpūtam̐ rakṣas \\ ity utkare trir niṣpunāti /
1.5.17.p.d: परापूतम्̐ रक्षस् \\ इत्य् उत्करे त्रिर् निष्पुनाति ।
1.5.17.p.m: With [the mantra]: 'Blown away is the rakṣas,' he winnows three times over the rubbish heap.

1.5.17.q.s: parādhmātā amitrās \\ iti śūrpāt tuṣān pradhvam̐sayati /
1.5.17.q.d: पराध्माता अमित्रास् \\ इति शूर्पात् तुषान् प्रध्वम्̐सयति ।
1.5.17.q.m: With [the mantra]: 'Blown away are the enemies,' he shakes off the chaff from the winnowing-basket.

1.5.17.r.s: puroḍāśakapālaṃ tuṣaiḥ pūrayitvā rakṣasāṃ bhāgo 'si \\ ity uttarāparam avāntaradeśam adhastāt kṛṣṇājinasyopavapati /
1.5.17.r.d: पुरोडाशकपालं तुषैः पूरयित्वा रक्षसां भागो ऽसि \\ इत्य् उत्तरापरम् अवान्तरदेशम् अधस्तात् कृष्णाजिनस्योपवपति ।
1.5.17.r.m: Having filled a potsherd for the cake with the chaff, he scatters it in the north-western intermediate direction beneath the black antelope skin with [the mantra]: 'Thou art the portion of the rakṣases.'

1.5.17.t.m: With [the mantra]: 'Trodden down is the rakṣas,' he treads it down.

1.5.17.v.m: and having sprinkled the potsherd with water, he sets it down.

1.5.17.w.m: With [the mantra]: 'May Vāyu [separate] you,' he separates [the grains from the unhusked].

1.5.17.x.s: devo vas iti pātryāṃ taṇḍulān praskandayati //
1.5.17.x.d: देवो वस् इति पात्र्यां तण्डुलान् प्रस्कन्दयति ॥
1.5.17.x.m: With [the mantra]: 'May the god [Savitṛ separate] you,' he lets the grains fall into the vessel.

1.5.18.a.s: triṣphalī kartave \\ iti saṃpreṣyaty atra vācaṃ visṛjate /
1.5.18.a.d: त्रिष्फली कर्तवे \\ इति संप्रेष्यत्य् अत्र वाचं विसृजते ।
1.5.18.a.m: He gives the ritual direction: 'To be threshed three times!' At this point he releases his speech.

1.5.18.b.s: yajamānasya patny avahanti yo vā kaścana taddāsyapatnī syāt sāpi katipayakṛtvo 'vahatyānyasmai prayacchet so 'ta ūrdhvam avahanti /
1.5.18.b.d: यजमानस्य पत्न्य् अवहन्ति यो वा कश्चन तद्दास्यपत्नी स्यात् सापि कतिपयकृत्वो ऽवहत्यान्यस्मै प्रयच्छेत् सो ऽत ऊर्ध्वम् अवहन्ति ।
1.5.18.b.m: The sacrificer's wife pounds, or anyone; if she is the wife of his servant, she too, having pounded a few times, should give [the pestle] to someone else; he then pounds henceforth.

1.5.18.c.s: devebhyaḥ śundhadhvam \\ devebhyaḥ śumbhadhvam \\ devebhyaḥ śudhyadhvam iti patnī triṣphalī karoti suphalīkṛtān /
1.5.18.c.d: देवेभ्यः शुन्धध्वम् \\ देवेभ्यः शुम्भध्वम् \\ देवेभ्यः शुध्यध्वम् इति पत्नी त्रिष्फली करोति सुफलीकृतान् ।
1.5.18.c.m: With [the formulas]: 'Be cleansed for the gods! Be adorned for the gods! Be purified for the gods!' the sacrificer's wife threshes three times the [grains that have been] well-threshed.

1.5.18.f.s: triṣphalīkriyamāṇānām \\ yo nyaṅgo avaśiṣyate / \ rakṣasāṃ bhāgadheyam \ āpas tat pravahatād itaḥ svāhā \\ ity antarvedi prakṣālanaṃ ninayati /
1.5.18.f.d: त्रिष्फलीक्रियमाणानाम् \\ यो न्यङ्गो अवशिष्यते । \ रक्षसां भागधेयम् \ आपस् तत् प्रवहताद् इतः स्वाहा \\ इत्य् अन्तर्वेदि प्रक्षालनं निनयति ।
1.5.18.f.m: she pours the wash-water inside the altar with [the mantra]: 'Whatever residue remains of these being threshed three times, the portion of the rakṣases, may the waters carry that away from here, svāhā!'

1.5.18.g.m: The rule for the black antelope skin has been explained.

1.5.18.h.s: divaḥ skambhanir asi \\ iti kṛṣṇājina udīcīnakumbām̐ śamyāṃ nidadhāti /
1.5.18.h.d: दिवः स्कम्भनिर् असि \\ इति कृष्णाजिन उदीचीनकुम्बाम्̐ शम्यां निदधाति ।
1.5.18.h.m: With [the mantra]: 'Thou art the support of the sky,' he places the yoke-pin on the black antelope skin with its thick end pointing north.

1.5.18.i.s: dhiṣaṇāsi parvatyā \\ iti tasyāṃ dṛṣadam adhivartayati /
1.5.18.i.d: धिषणासि पर्वत्या \\ इति तस्यां दृषदम् अधिवर्तयति ।
1.5.18.i.m: With [the mantra]: 'Thou art the heavenly mortar, belonging to the mountains,' he sets the lower millstone upon it.

1.5.18.j.m: He rests it with its western half [upon the pin].

1.5.18.k.m: With [the mantra]: 'Thou art the heavenly mortar, daughter of the mountain,' [he places] the upper millstone upon the lower millstone.

1.5.18.l.s: am̐śavaḥ stha madhumantas \\ iti taṇḍulān avekṣate /
1.5.18.l.d: अम्̐शवः स्थ मधुमन्तस् \\ इति तण्डुलान् अवेक्षते ।
1.5.18.l.m: With [the mantra]: 'You are sweet soma-stalks,' he looks upon the rice grains.

1.5.18.m.s: devasya tvā \\ iti dṛṣadi taṇḍulān adhivapati /
1.5.18.m.d: देवस्य त्वा \\ इति दृषदि तण्डुलान् अधिवपति ।
1.5.18.m.m: With [the mantra]: 'At [the instigation] of divine [Savitṛ]…', he pours the rice grains onto the lower millstone:

1.5.18.n.m: three times with the yajus, silently the fourth time.

1.5.18.o.s: prāṇāya tvā \\ apānāya tvā \ vyānāya tvā \\ iti pinaṣṭi /
1.5.18.o.d: प्राणाय त्वा \\ अपानाय त्वा \ व्यानाय त्वा \\ इति पिनष्टि ।
1.5.18.o.m: With "For out-breath thee!", "For in-breath thee!", "For through-breath thee!", he grinds.

1.5.18.p.s: api vā prāṇāya tvā \\ iti prācīṃ prohati \\ apānāya tvā \\ iti pratīcīṃ vyānāya tvā \\ iti madhyadeśe vyavadhārayati /
1.5.18.p.d: अपि वा प्राणाय त्वा \\ इति प्राचीं प्रोहति \\ अपानाय त्वा \\ इति प्रतीचीं व्यानाय त्वा \\ इति मध्यदेशे व्यवधारयति ।
1.5.18.p.m: Or rather, with "For out-breath thee!" he pushes [the millstone] forward to the east; with "For in-breath thee!" [he pulls it back] to the west; with "For through-breath thee!" he holds it steady in the middle region.

1.5.18.q.m: With "Along the long..." [he pushes it] eastward at the end.

1.5.18.r.m: From then on, he grinds continuously as is convenient.

1.5.18.s.s: devo vas \\ iti kṛṣṇājine piṣṭāni praskandayati /
1.5.18.s.d: देवो वस् \\ इति कृष्णाजिने पिष्टानि प्रस्कन्दयति ।
1.5.18.s.m: With "May the god you..." he pours the flour onto the black antelope skin.

1.5.18.t.m: With "With an unbeguiled eye I gaze upon you," he looks at it.

1.5.18.u.m: He directs: "Grind, not spilling [any], and make it fine!"

1.5.18.x.m: At this point, he sets the boiled water [madantī] over the fire.

1.6.19.a.s: āhavanīye gārhapatye vā havīm̐ṣi śrapyante paścād agneḥ /
1.6.19.a.d: आहवनीये गार्हपत्ये वा हवीम्̐षि श्रप्यन्ते पश्चाद् अग्नेः ।
1.6.19.a.m: The sacrificial oblations are cooked on the āhavanīya or on the gārhapatya, to the west of the fire.

1.6.19.b.m: He takes the fire-stirring poker as prescribed.

1.6.19.c.s: abhihatam̐ rakṣas \\ rakṣasaḥ pāṇiṃ daha \\ ahir asi budhniyas \\ iti vā tena pratyañcāv aṅgārau nirvartayati /
1.6.19.c.d: अभिहतम्̐ रक्षस् \\ रक्षसः पाणिं दह \\ अहिर् असि बुध्नियस् \\ इति वा तेन प्रत्यञ्चाव् अङ्गारौ निर्वर्तयति ।
1.6.19.c.m: With "Smitten is the evil spirit!", "Burn the hand of the evil spirit!", or with "Thou art the serpent of the deep," he turns out two burning coals toward the west using it.

1.6.19.d.s: apāgne \\ ity anyataram uttarāparam avāntaradeśaṃ nirasyāpa upaspṛśya /
1.6.19.d.d: अपाग्ने \\ इत्य् अन्यतरम् उत्तरापरम् अवान्तरदेशं निरस्याप उपस्पृश्य ।
1.6.19.d.m: With "O Agni, keep off..." having cast away one [of them] toward the north-western intermediate direction and touched water,

1.6.19.e.s: ā devayajaṃ vaha \\ ity avaśiṣṭam avasthāpya /
1.6.19.e.d: आ देवयजं वह \\ इत्य् अवशिष्टम् अवस्थाप्य ।
1.6.19.e.m: having positioned the remaining one with "Bring hither the sacrifice to the gods,"

1.6.19.f.s: dhruvam asi \\ iti tasmin kapālam upadadhāti /
1.6.19.f.d: ध्रुवम् असि \\ इति तस्मिन् कपालम् उपदधाति ।
1.6.19.f.m: he places a potsherd upon it with "Thou art firm."

1.6.19.g.m: With "Burnt out [is the evil spirit]," he turns a coal onto it.

1.6.19.h.m: With "Thou art a supporter," [he places another potsherd] to the east of that.

1.6.19.i.s: aṣṭākapālasya dve madhyamād dakṣiṇe trīṇy uttarāṇi /
1.6.19.i.d: अष्टाकपालस्य द्वे मध्यमाद् दक्षिणे त्रीण्य् उत्तराणि ।
1.6.19.i.m: For [a cake on] eight potsherds, two [are placed] to the south of the central one, and three to the north.

1.6.19.j.s: tayor dharmāsi \\ iti dakṣiṇapūrvam marutām̐ śardhas \\ iti dakṣiṇāparam
1.6.19.j.d: तयोर् धर्मासि \\ इति दक्षिणपूर्वम् मरुताम्̐ शर्धस् \\ इति दक्षिणापरम्
1.6.19.j.m: Of those two, [he places] the south-eastern one with "Thou art Dharma" and the south-western one with "The host of the Maruts."

1.6.19.k.s: yantram asi \\ āśā dṛm̐ha \ rayiṃ dṛm̐ha \ poṣaṃ dṛm̐ha \ sajātān asmai yajamānasya paryūha \\ ity uttarāparam /
1.6.19.k.d: यन्त्रम् असि \\ आशा दृम्̐ह \ रयिं दृम्̐ह \ पोषं दृम्̐ह \ सजातान् अस्मै यजमानस्य पर्यूह \\ इत्य् उत्तरापरम् ।
1.6.19.k.m: With "Thou art a restraint; make firm the quarters; make firm wealth; make firm nourishment; gather the kinsmen around this sacrificer," [he places] the north-western one.

1.6.19.l.s: viśvābhyas tvāśābhyo 'cchidram̐ sajātavanasyāyā upadadhāmi \\ ity uttarapūrvam /
1.6.19.l.d: विश्वाभ्यस् त्वाशाभ्यो ऽच्छिद्रम्̐ सजातवनस्याया उपदधामि \\ इत्य् उत्तरपूर्वम् ।
1.6.19.l.m: With "From all quarters I set thee down intact for the winning of kinsmen," [he places] the north-eastern one.

1.6.19.m.m: With "Thou art a layer," [he places] the remaining one to the north.

1.6.19.n.m: For [a cake on] eleven potsherds, he places three just as for [the cake on] eight potsherds.

1.6.19.o.s: teṣāṃ varṣiṣṭhaṃ madhyamaṃ dve madhyamāt pūrve /
1.6.19.o.d: तेषां वर्षिष्ठं मध्यमं द्वे मध्यमात् पूर्वे ।
1.6.19.o.m: Of these, the central one is the largest; two are to the east of the central one.

1.6.19.p.m: Of those two, [he places] the eastern one with "Thou art a layer."

1.6.19.q.m: [He places the others] in the intermediate directions as prescribed.

1.6.19.r.m: With "Ye are layers," [he places] the remaining ones to the north.

1.6.19.s.m: For [a cake on] twelve potsherds, it is just as for [that on] eleven potsherds.

1.6.19.t.s: bhṛgūṇām aṅgirasāṃ tapasā tapyadhvam iti vedena kapāleṣv aṅgārān adhyūhati /
1.6.19.t.d: भृगूणाम् अङ्गिरसां तपसा तप्यध्वम् इति वेदेन कपालेष्व् अङ्गारान् अध्यूहति ।
1.6.19.t.m: With "Heat yourselves through the heat of the Bhṛgus and the Aṅgirases," he sweeps burning coals over the potsherds using the veda-broom.

1.6.19.u.m: Having heated the baking pan over the fire, when it has cooled down,

1.6.19.v.s: devasya tvā \\ iti tiraḥpavitraṃ kṛṣṇājināt piṣṭāni saṃvapati /
1.6.19.v.d: देवस्य त्वा \\ इति तिरःपवित्रं कृष्णाजिनात् पिष्टानि संवपति ।
1.6.19.v.m: he pours the flour across the purifiers from the black antelope skin with "[At the impulse] of the divine [Savitṛ] thee..."

1.6.19.w.m: Three times with the yajus formula, silently the fourth time.

1.6.19.x.m: While pouring, he restrains speech; while covering it, he releases [speech].

1.6.19.y.s: haryos tvā vārābhyām utpunāmi \\ ity udagagrābhyāṃ pavitrābhyāṃ piṣṭāni trir utpunāti /
1.6.19.y.d: हर्योस् त्वा वाराभ्याम् उत्पुनामि \\ इत्य् उदगग्राभ्यां पवित्राभ्यां पिष्टानि त्रिर् उत्पुनाति ।
1.6.19.y.m: With "I purify thee with the two tail-hairs of the two bay horses," he purifies the flour three times with the two purifiers pointing north,

1.6.19.aa.s: sruveṇa praṇītānām ādāya vedenopayamya sam āpas \\ iti piṣṭeṣv ānayati /
