1.6.19.aa.d: स्रुवेण प्रणीतानाम् आदाय वेदेनोपयम्य सम् आपस् \\ इति पिष्टेष्व् आनयति ।
1.6.19.aa.m: Taking [water] from the praṇītā waters with the sruva-spoon, supporting it with the veda-broom, he pours it onto the flour with "May the waters unite..."

1.6.19.ab.s: yadi praṇītā na vidyeran yā eva kāścāpo yajuṣotpūya tābhiḥ saṃnayed ity āpadarthavādaḥ /
1.6.19.ab.d: यदि प्रणीता न विद्येरन् या एव काश्चापो यजुषोत्पूय ताभिः संनयेद् इत्य् आपदर्थवादः ।
1.6.19.ab.m: "If the praṇītā waters should not be available, having purified whatever waters with the yajus, he should mix with them"—this is an explanatory passage for an emergency.

1.6.19.ac.s: adbhyaḥ pari prajātāḥ stha \\ iti taptā ānayati /
1.6.19.ac.d: अद्भ्यः परि प्रजाताः स्थ \\ इति तप्ता आनयति ।
1.6.19.ac.m: With "Ye are born from the waters," he pours heated [water].

1.6.19.ad.s: sam adbhiḥ pṛcyadhvam iti pradakṣiṇam anupariplāvayati /
1.6.19.ad.d: सम् अद्भिः पृच्यध्वम् इति प्रदक्षिणम् अनुपरिप्लावयति ।
1.6.19.ad.m: With "Mix together with the waters!" he pours it all around in a clockwise direction.

1.6.19.ae.s: janayatyai tvā saṃyaumi \\ iti saṃyauti janayīte tvā \\ iti vā /
1.6.19.ae.d: जनयत्यै त्वा संयौमि \\ इति संयौति जनयीते त्वा \\ इति वा ।
1.6.19.ae.m: With "For the mother I knead thee," he kneads it; or with "For the mother-to-be thee."

1.6.19.af.d: मखस्य शिरो ऽसि \\ इति पिण्डं करोति ।
1.6.19.af.m: With "Thou art the head of Makha," he makes a dough-ball.

1.6.19.ag.m: With "Separate according to your shares," he divides it.

1.6.20.a.s: devo vām̐ savitā vibhajatu \ bhago vām̐ savitā vibhajatu \ pūṣā vām̐ savitā vibhajatu \ vāyur vām̐ savitā vibhajatu \ janayatyai tvā vibhajāmi \\ iti vā /
1.6.20.a.d: देवो वाम्̐ सविता विभजतु \ भगो वाम्̐ सविता विभजतु \ पूषा वाम्̐ सविता विभजतु \ वायुर् वाम्̐ सविता विभजतु \ जनयत्यै त्वा विभजामि \\ इति वा ।
1.6.20.a.m: Or with "May the divine Savitṛ divide you two; may Bhaga Savitṛ divide you two; may Pūṣan Savitṛ divide you two; may Vāyu Savitṛ divide you two; for the mother I divide thee."

1.6.20.b.s: samau piṇḍau kṛtvā \\ idam agnaye \\ ity āgneyam abhimṛśati \\ idam amuṣmai \\ iti yathādevatam uttaram /
1.6.20.b.d: समौ पिण्डौ कृत्वा \\ इदम् अग्नये \\ इत्य् आग्नेयम् अभिमृशति \\ इदम् अमुष्मै \\ इति यथादेवतम् उत्तरम् ।
1.6.20.b.m: Having made two equal balls, he touches the one for Agni with "This for Agni," and the northern one with "This for NN," according to the deity.

1.6.20.c.s: idam aham̐ senāyā abhītvaryai mukham apohāmi \\ iti vedena dakṣiṇasmāt kapālayogād aṅgārān apohyottarasmād apohati /
1.6.20.c.d: इदम् अहम्̐ सेनाया अभीत्वर्यै मुखम् अपोहामि \\ इति वेदेन दक्षिणस्मात् कपालयोगाद् अङ्गारान् अपोह्योत्तरस्माद् अपोहति ।
1.6.20.c.m: With "Here do I brush away the face of the attacking army," he brushes away the coals from the southern arrangement of potsherds with the veda-broom, and then brushes [them] away from the northern one.

1.6.20.d.m: In this manner their rites are performed in regular sequence.

1.6.20.e.m: He accompanies each one with its homogeneous rite, and completes each one entirely.

1.6.20.f.m: Those [rites] that are joined together, however, have a single completion, as in the case of cutting off the portions and offering them.

1.6.20.g.s: udvapanaṃ niṣpavanaṃ ca sarvatra pradhānasaṃnipāte kriyante /
1.6.20.g.d: उद्वपनं निष्पवनं च सर्वत्र प्रधानसंनिपाते क्रियन्ते ।
1.6.20.g.m: The taking out and the winnowing are performed everywhere upon the occurrence of the primary rite.

1.6.20.h.s: makhasya śiro 'si \\ iti dakṣiṇaṃ piṇḍam ādāya gharmo 'si viśvāyus \\ iti dakṣiṇe kapālayoge 'dhiśrayati /
1.6.20.h.d: मखस्य शिरो ऽसि \\ इति दक्षिणं पिण्डम् आदाय घर्मो ऽसि विश्वायुस् \\ इति दक्षिणे कपालयोगे ऽधिश्रयति ।
1.6.20.h.m: Taking the southern dough-ball with "Thou art the head of Makha," he places it upon the southern arrangement of potsherds with "Thou art the Gharma, possessing all life."

1.6.20.i.m: Or with "O Gharma, rest upon the Gharma."

1.6.20.k.m: With "Spread out wide," he spreads it out.

1.6.20.l.m: He spreads it over all the potsherds.

1.6.20.m.s: pātryām apa ānīya tvacaṃ gṛhṇīṣva \\ iti pradakṣiṇam anatikṣārayam̐l lepenānuparimārṣṭi /
1.6.20.m.d: पात्र्याम् अप आनीय त्वचं गृह्णीष्व \\ इति प्रदक्षिणम् अनतिक्षारयम्̐ल् लेपेनानुपरिमार्ष्टि ।
1.6.20.m.m: Having poured water into the pan, with "Take on a skin," he rubs it all over smoothly clockwise with the dough-smear, not letting it spill over.

1.6.20.n.s: antaritam̐ rakṣas \\ ity ulmukena triḥ paryagni karoti /
1.6.20.n.d: अन्तरितम्̐ रक्षस् \\ इत्य् उल्मुकेन त्रिः पर्यग्नि करोति ।
1.6.20.n.m: With "Warded off is the evil spirit," he carries fire around it three times with a firebrand.

1.6.20.p.s: devas tvā savitā śrapayatu \\ iti darbhair abhijvalayati /
1.6.20.p.d: देवस् त्वा सविता श्रपयतु \\ इति दर्भैर् अभिज्वलयति ।
1.6.20.p.m: With "May the divine Savitṛ cook thee," he causes it to blaze over with darbha-blades.

1.6.20.q.s: agnis te tanuvaṃ māti dhāk \\ ity ulmukaiḥ paritapati /
1.6.20.q.d: अग्निस् ते तनुवं माति धाक् \\ इत्य् उल्मुकैः परितपति ।
1.6.20.q.m: With "May Agni not scorch thy body," he bakes it all around with firebrands.

1.6.20.r.s: saṃ brahmaṇā pṛcyasva \\ iti vedena sāṅgāraṃ bhasmābhyūhati /
1.6.20.r.d: सं ब्रह्मणा पृच्यस्व \\ इति वेदेन साङ्गारं भस्माभ्यूहति ।
1.6.20.r.m: With [the mantra,] “Unite with the sacred word,” he covers [the cake] with ashes containing burning coals by means of the veda grass-broom.

1.6.20.t.s: avidahantaḥ śrapayata \\ iti saṃpreṣyaty atra vācaṃ visṛjate /
1.6.20.t.d: अविदहन्तः श्रपयत \\ इति संप्रेष्यत्य् अत्र वाचं विसृजते ।
1.6.20.t.m: He gives the ritual direction: “Bake [it] without burning.” At this point he releases his speech.

1.6.20.u.m: Having heated the water used for washing the fingers and cleansing the dish over a firebrand,

1.6.20.v.s: apareṇāhavanīyam apareṇa vā gārhapatyam̐ sphyenodīcīs tisro rekhāḥ kṛtvā \\ ekatāya svāhā \\ iti paścātpaścād asam̐spandayam̐s trir ninayati /
1.6.20.v.d: अपरेणाहवनीयम् अपरेण वा गार्हपत्यम्̐ स्फ्येनोदीचीस् तिस्रो रेखाः कृत्वा \\ एकताय स्वाहा \\ इति पश्चात्पश्चाद् असम्̐स्पन्दयम्̐स् त्रिर् निनयति ।
1.6.20.v.m: and having drawn three lines northward with the wooden sword west of the āhavanīya or west of the gārhapatya, he pours it out three times from behind to behind, without splashing, with: “To Ekata, svāhā!”

1.6.20.x.m: To the west of the āhavanīya, he makes the altar measured by the length of the sacrificer,

1.6.21.a.s: vedena vediṃ vividuḥ pṛthivīm \\ sā paprathe pṛthivī pārthivāni / \ garbhaṃ vibharti bhuvaneṣv antar \\ tato yajño jāyate viśvadānis \\ iti purastāt stambayajuṣo vedena vediṃ triḥ saṃmārṣṭi /
1.6.21.a.d: वेदेन वेदिं विविदुः पृथिवीम् \\ सा पप्रथे पृथिवी पार्थिवानि । \ गर्भं विभर्ति भुवनेष्व् अन्तर् \\ ततो यज्ञो जायते विश्वदानिस् \\ इति पुरस्तात् स्तम्बयजुषो वेदेन वेदिं त्रिः संमार्ष्टि ।
1.6.21.a.m: With [the verse,] “With the broom they found the altar, the earth; that earth spread out earthly things; she bears the embryo within beings; thence is born the sacrifice that gives all,” he sweeps the altar three times with the veda grass-broom before the stambayajus rite.

1.6.21.b.m: In the third part of the eastern half of the altar, he takes up the stambayajus.

1.6.21.c.m: Taking the wooden sword with: “At the impulse of the god [Savitṛ…],”

1.6.21.d.m: he consecrates it with: “You are the arm of Indra.”

1.6.21.e.s: sahasrabhṛṣṭiḥ śatatejās \\ iti tasya darbheṇāgram̐ sam̐śyati /
1.6.21.e.d: सहस्रभृष्टिः शततेजास् \\ इति तस्य दर्भेणाग्रम्̐ सम्̐श्यति ।
1.6.21.e.m: With: “Having a thousand edges, a hundred points,” he touches its tip with a blade of darbha grass.

1.6.21.f.s: pṛthivyai varmāsi \\ iti prāgagram udagagraṃ vā darbhaṃ nidadhāti /
1.6.21.f.d: पृथिव्यै वर्मासि \\ इति प्रागग्रम् उदगग्रं वा दर्भं निदधाति ।
1.6.21.f.m: With: “You are an armor for the earth,” he lays down a blade of darbha grass with its tip pointing east or north.

1.6.21.g.s: pṛthivi devayajani \\ iti tasmin sphyena praharati /
1.6.21.g.d: पृथिवि देवयजनि \\ इति तस्मिन् स्फ्येन प्रहरति ।
1.6.21.g.m: With: “O earth, place of divine worship,” he strikes upon it with the wooden sword.

1.6.21.h.s: apahato 'raruḥ pṛthivyai \\ iti sphyena satṛṇān pām̐sūn apādatte \\ apāraruṃ vadhyāsam iti vā /
1.6.21.h.d: अपहतो ऽररुः पृथिव्यै \\ इति स्फ्येन सतृणान् पाम्̐सून् अपादत्ते \\ अपाररुं वध्यासम् इति वा ।
1.6.21.h.m: With: “Slain is Araru from the earth,” or with: “May I slay Araru,” he picks up with the wooden sword the loose earth along with grass.

1.6.21.i.m: With: “Go to the pen, the place of cattle,” he carries it [away].

1.6.21.j.s: varṣatu te dyaus \\ iti vediṃ pratyavekṣate varṣatu te parjanyas \\ iti yajamānam /
1.6.21.j.d: वर्षतु ते द्यौस् \\ इति वेदिं प्रत्यवेक्षते वर्षतु ते पर्जन्यस् \\ इति यजमानम् ।
1.6.21.j.m: With: “May the sky rain for you,” he looks down at the altar; with: “May Parjanya rain for you,” at the sacrificer.

1.6.21.k.s: namo dive namaḥ pṛthivyai \\ ity uttarata uttānau hastau kṛtvāgnīdhra upaviśati /
1.6.21.k.d: नमो दिवे नमः पृथिव्यै \\ इत्य् उत्तरत उत्तानौ हस्तौ कृत्वाग्नीध्र उपविशति ।
1.6.21.k.m: With: “Homage to heaven, homage to earth,” the āgnīdhra priest sits down to the north, holding his hands turned upward.

1.6.21.l.s: prakrame veder badhāna \\ iti tasmā upanivapati /
1.6.21.l.d: प्रक्रमे वेदेर् बधान \\ इति तस्मा उपनिवपति ।
1.6.21.l.m: With: “Bind [it] at the step of the altar,” he pours [the earth] down for him.

1.6.21.n.s: avabāḍho durasyus \\ ity āgnīdhra utkaram abhigṛhṇāty añjalinā /
1.6.21.n.d: अवबाढो दुरस्युस् \\ इत्य् आग्नीध्र उत्करम् अभिगृह्णात्य् अञ्जलिना ।
1.6.21.n.m: With: “Crushed is the malicious one,” the āgnīdhra receives the rubbish heap with his cupped hands.

1.6.21.p.m: In the same way he carries it a second time, in the same way a third time.

1.6.21.q.s: mā vaḥ śivā oṣadhayo mūlam̐ him̐siṣam iti dvitīyaṃ praharati /
1.6.21.q.d: मा वः शिवा ओषधयो मूलम्̐ हिम्̐सिषम् इति द्वितीयं प्रहरति ।
1.6.21.q.m: With: “May I not harm the root of you auspicious plants,” he strikes the second time.

1.6.21.r.s: apahato 'raruḥ pṛthivyai devayajanyai \\ iti dvitīyam apādatte /
1.6.21.r.d: अपहतो ऽररुः पृथिव्यै देवयजन्यै \\ इति द्वितीयम् अपादत्ते ।
1.6.21.r.m: With: “Slain is Araru from the earth, the place of divine worship,” he picks it up the second time.

1.6.21.s.s: avabāḍhā devayajanyā yātudhānās \\ iti dvitīyam abhigṛhṇāti /
1.6.21.s.d: अवबाढा देवयजन्या यातुधानास् \\ इति द्वितीयम् अभिगृह्णाति ।
1.6.21.s.m: With: “Crushed are the sorcerers from the place of divine worship,” [the āgnīdhra] receives it the second time.

1.6.21.t.s: drapsas te divaṃ mā skān iti tṛtīyaṃ praharati /
1.6.21.t.d: द्रप्सस् ते दिवं मा स्कान् इति तृतीयं प्रहरति ।
1.6.21.t.m: With: “May not your drop leap up to the sky,” he strikes the third time.

1.6.21.u.s: apahato 'raruḥ pṛthivyā adevayajanas \\ iti tṛtīyam apādatte /
1.6.21.u.d: अपहतो ऽररुः पृथिव्या अदेवयजनस् \\ इति तृतीयम् अपादत्ते ।
1.6.21.u.m: With: “Slain is Araru from the earth, the place unfit for divine worship,” he picks it up the third time.

1.6.21.v.m: With: “Crushed is the evil-speaker,” [the āgnīdhra] receives it the third time.

1.6.21.y.s: ararus te divaṃ mā skān iti caturtham abhigṛhṇāti /
1.6.21.y.d: अररुस् ते दिवं मा स्कान् इति चतुर्थम् अभिगृह्णाति ।
1.6.21.y.m: With: “May not Araru leap up to heaven,” [the āgnīdhra] receives it the fourth time.

1.6.21.z.m: He outlines the altar with the wooden sword.

1.6.21.aa.s: vasavas tvā parigṛhṇantu \\ iti dakṣiṇataḥ prācīṃ lekhāṃ likhati /
1.6.21.aa.d: वसवस् त्वा परिगृह्णन्तु \\ इति दक्षिणतः प्राचीं लेखां लिखति ।
1.6.21.aa.m: With: “May the Vasus enclose you,” he draws an eastern line on the south.

1.6.21.ab.m: With: “May the Rudras [enclose] you,” a northern line on the west.

1.6.21.ac.m: With: “May the Ādityas [enclose] you,” an eastern line on the north.

1.6.21.ad.s: prāñcau vedyam̐sāv unnayaty abhita āhavanīyaṃ pratīcī śroṇī abhi gārhapatyaṃ madhye saṃnatā bhavati //
1.6.21.ad.d: प्राञ्चौ वेद्यम्̐साव् उन्नयत्य् अभित आहवनीयं प्रतीची श्रोणी अभि गार्हपत्यं मध्ये संनता भवति ॥
1.6.21.ad.m: He brings forward the two shoulders of the altar facing east on both sides of the āhavanīya; the two hips face west toward the gārhapatya; it is contracted in the middle.

1.6.22.a.s: imāṃ narāḥ kṛṇuta vedim etya \ vasumatīm̐ rudravatīm ādityavatīm \\ varṣman divo nābhā pṛthivyās \\ yathāyaṃ yajamāno na riṣyādeta \ devebhyo juṣṭām adityā upasthe \ imāṃ devā ajuṣanta sarve \ rāyaspoṣā yajamānaṃ viśantu \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
1.6.22.a.d: इमां नराः कृणुत वेदिम् एत्य \ वसुमतीम्̐ रुद्रवतीम् आदित्यवतीम् \\ वर्ष्मन् दिवो नाभा पृथिव्यास् \\ यथायं यजमानो न रिष्यादेत \ देवेभ्यो जुष्टाम् अदित्या उपस्थे \ इमां देवा अजुषन्त सर्वे \ रायस्पोषा यजमानं विशन्तु \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
1.6.22.a.m: He gives the ritual direction: “O men, come and make this altar, possessed of Vasus, Rudras, and Ādityas, on the summit of heaven, on the navel of the earth, so that this sacrificer may not be injured; come to this [altar] dear to the gods, in the lap of Aditi; all the gods have taken pleasure in this; let increases of wealth enter the sacrificer!”

1.6.22.b.s: apahato 'raruḥ pṛthivyai \\ ā devayajaṃ vaha \\ iti sphyenottamāṃ tvacam uddhatyotkare nivapati /
1.6.22.b.d: अपहतो ऽररुः पृथिव्यै \\ आ देवयजं वह \\ इति स्फ्येनोत्तमां त्वचम् उद्धत्योत्करे निवपति ।
1.6.22.b.m: With: “Slain is Araru from the earth; bring hither the worshiper of the gods,” he lifts the top layer [of soil] with the wooden sword and pours it onto the rubbish heap.

1.6.22.c.s: devasya savituḥ save \\ iti khanati devasya savituḥ save \ karma kṛṇvanto mānuṣās \\ mā vaḥ śivā oṣadhayo mūlam̐ him̐siṣam iti vā /
1.6.22.c.d: देवस्य सवितुः सवे \\ इति खनति देवस्य सवितुः सवे \ कर्म कृण्वन्तो मानुषास् \\ मा वः शिवा ओषधयो मूलम्̐ हिम्̐सिषम् इति वा ।
1.6.22.c.m: With: “At the impulse of the god Savitṛ,” he digs, or with: “At the impulse of the god Savitṛ, the mortals performing the rite [dig]; may I not harm the root of you auspicious plants.”

1.6.22.d.s: dvyaṅgulāṃ tryaṅgulāṃ caturaṅgulām̐ sītāmātrīm̐ rathavartmamātrīṃ yāvat pārṣṇiyai śvetaṃ tāvatīṃ vā /
1.6.22.d.d: द्व्यङ्गुलां त्र्यङ्गुलां चतुरङ्गुलाम्̐ सीतामात्रीम्̐ रथवर्त्ममात्रीं यावत् पार्ष्णियै श्वेतं तावतीं वा ।
1.6.22.d.m: [He digs it to a depth of] two finger-breadths, three finger-breadths, four finger-breadths, the depth of a furrow, the depth of a chariot-wheel track, or as deep as the white part of the heel.

1.6.22.e.m: He does not dig beyond these measurements.

1.6.22.f.s: dakṣiṇato barṣīyasīṃ purīṣavatīṃ prācīmudīcīṃ pravaṇāṃ karoti /
1.6.22.f.d: दक्षिणतो बर्षीयसीं पुरीषवतीं प्राचीमुदीचीं प्रवणां करोति ।
1.6.22.f.m: He makes [the altar] broader on the south, supplied with loose earth, sloping toward the north-east.

1.6.22.g.s: yan mūlam atiśete sphyena tac chinatti /
1.6.22.g.d: यन् मूलम् अतिशेते स्फ्येन तच् छिनत्ति ।
1.6.22.g.m: Whatever root lies exposed, he cuts it with the wooden sword.

1.6.22.h.s: yat purīṣam atiricyata utkaraṃ tad gamayati /
1.6.22.h.d: यत् पुरीषम् अतिरिच्यत उत्करं तद् गमयति ।
1.6.22.h.m: Whatever loose earth is in excess, he carries to the rubbish heap.

1.6.22.i.m: For one desirous of cattle, [the altar] should have loose earth brought [from elsewhere].

1.6.22.j.s: yat prāk khananāt tat kṛtvā mantreṇa purīṣaṃ khātvā harati /
1.6.22.j.d: यत् प्राक् खननात् तत् कृत्वा मन्त्रेण पुरीषं खात्वा हरति ।
1.6.22.j.m: Having done what precedes the digging, he digs loose earth with the mantra and brings it.

1.6.22.k.m: Here [on the sacrifice day] he prepares the altar at the Full Moon rite;

1.6.22.l.m: on the preceding day at the New Moon rite,

1.6.22.n.s: yat prāg uttarasmāt parigrāhāt tat pūrvedyuḥ karoti saha vottareṇa parigrāheṇa /
1.6.22.n.d: यत् प्राग् उत्तरस्मात् परिग्राहात् तत् पूर्वेद्युः करोति सह वोत्तरेण परिग्राहेण ।
1.6.22.n.m: What precedes the second enclosing he does on the preceding day, or together with the second enclosing.

1.6.22.o.s: brahmann uttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigrahīṣyāmi \\ ity āmantrya parigṛhṇāti /
1.6.22.o.d: ब्रह्मन्न् उत्तरं परिग्राहं परिग्रहीष्यामि \\ इत्य् आमन्त्र्य परिगृह्णाति ।
1.6.22.o.m: Having addressed [the brahman priest] with: “O brahman, I shall make the second enclosing,” he encloses [it].

1.6.22.p.s: viparītam eke samāmananti mantraiḥ pūrvaṃ parigrāhaṃ yajurbhir uttaram /
1.6.22.p.d: विपरीतम् एके समामनन्ति मन्त्रैः पूर्वं परिग्राहं यजुर्भिर् उत्तरम् ।
1.6.22.p.m: Some teach the reverse: the first enclosing with mantras, the second with yajus formulas.

1.6.22.q.s: ṛtam asi \\ iti dakṣiṇatas \\ ṛtasadanam asi \\ iti paścāt \\ ṛtaśrīr asi \\ ity uttarataḥ /
1.6.22.q.d: ऋतम् असि \\ इति दक्षिणतस् \\ ऋतसदनम् असि \\ इति पश्चात् \\ ऋतश्रीर् असि \\ इत्य् उत्तरतः ।
1.6.22.q.m: [He draws lines] on the south with: “You are truth”; on the west with: “You are the seat of truth”; on the north with: “You are the glory of truth.”

1.6.22.r.s: dhā asi \ svadhā asi \\ iti sphyena pratīcīm̐ saṃmārṣṭi /
1.6.22.r.d: धा असि \ स्वधा असि \\ इति स्फ्येन प्रतीचीम्̐ संमार्ष्टि ।
1.6.22.r.m: With: “You are sustenance; you are ancestral offering,” he smooths it westward with the wooden sword.

1.6.22.s.m: Having consecrated [the altar] with: “Before the cruel [deed]…”,

1.6.22.t.s: paścārdhe veder vitṛtīyadeśe sphyaṃ tiryañcam̐ stabdhvā prokṣaṇīr āsādaya \\ idhmābarhir upasādaya \ sruvaṃ ca srucaś ca saṃmṛḍḍhi \ patnīm̐ saṃnahya \\ ājyenodehi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
1.6.22.t.d: पश्चार्धे वेदेर् वितृतीयदेशे स्फ्यं तिर्यञ्चम्̐ स्तब्ध्वा प्रोक्षणीर् आसादय \\ इध्माबर्हिर् उपसादय \ स्रुवं च स्रुचश् च संमृड्ढि \ पत्नीम्̐ संनह्य \\ आज्येनोदेहि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
1.6.22.t.m: having propped the wooden sword horizontally in the third part of the western half of the altar, he gives the ritual direction: “Place the sprinkling water; place the firewood and sacred grass near; cleanse the dipping spoon and the offering ladles; gird the sacrificer's wife; come up with the clarified butter!”

1.6.22.u.s: agnihotrahavaṇyāṃ pavitrāntarhitāyām apa ānīyodañcam̐ sphyam apakṛṣyāntarvedi dhārayan sphyasya vartmann upaninīya \\ ṛtasadhaḥ stha \\ iti sphyapade sādayati /
1.6.22.u.d: अग्निहोत्रहवण्यां पवित्रान्तर्हितायाम् अप आनीयोदञ्चम्̐ स्फ्यम् अपकृष्यान्तर्वेदि धारयन् स्फ्यस्य वर्त्मन्न् उपनिनीय \\ ऋतसधः स्थ \\ इति स्फ्यपदे सादयति ।
1.6.22.u.m: Having poured water into the Agnihotra ladle in which the purifiers are placed, drawn the wooden sword toward the north and held it within the altar, and poured [water] along the track of the wooden sword, he sets [the water] down on the spot of the wooden sword with: “You are the seats of truth.”

1.6.22.v.m: Whomever he hates, he should meditate on him.

1.6.22.w.s: śatabhṛṣṭir asi vānaspatyo dviṣato vadhas \\ ity utkare sphyam udasyati /
1.6.22.w.d: शतभृष्टिर् असि वानस्पत्यो द्विषतो वधस् \\ इत्य् उत्करे स्फ्यम् उदस्यति ।
1.6.22.w.m: With 'You are a hundred-spiked wooden weapon against the enemy,' he tosses the wooden sword onto the rubbish heap.

1.6.22.x.m: He pushes it under from the east toward the west, from the thicker part.

1.6.22.y.s: nānavanijya hastau pātrāṇi parāhaṇyān na vediṃ parimṛśaty āstaraṇāt /
1.6.22.y.d: नानवनिज्य हस्तौ पात्राणि पराहण्यान् न वेदिं परिमृशत्य् आस्तरणात् ।
1.6.22.y.m: Without washing his hands, he should not touch the utensils; nor does he touch the altar before the strewing [of the sacred grass].

1.6.22.z.s: hastāv avanenikte sphyaṃ prakṣālayati nāgraṃ parimṛśati /
1.6.22.z.d: हस्ताव् अवनेनिक्ते स्फ्यं प्रक्षालयति नाग्रं परिमृशति ।
1.6.22.z.m: He washes his two hands, cleanses the wooden sword, and does not wipe its tip.

1.6.22.aa.s: uttareṇa praṇītā idhmābarhir upasādayati dakṣiṇam idhmam uttaraṃ barhiḥ //
1.6.22.aa.d: उत्तरेण प्रणीता इध्माबर्हिर् उपसादयति दक्षिणम् इध्मम् उत्तरं बर्हिः ॥
1.6.22.aa.m: To the north of the praṇītā waters, he places the fuel and sacred grass: the fuel to the south, the sacred grass to the north.

1.7.23.a.s: vedaprāntaiḥ sruvam̐ srucaś ca saha saṃmārṣṭi /
1.7.23.a.d: वेदप्रान्तैः स्रुवम्̐ स्रुचश् च सह संमार्ष्टि ।
1.7.23.a.m: With the ends of the grass brush, he cleanses the dipping spoon and the offering ladles together,

1.7.23.b.m: either separately dividing [the blades of grass] or without separately dividing.

1.7.23.c.s: uttānās tiraścīr vāpi vā dve uttāne upabhṛtaṃ tiraścīm /
1.7.23.c.d: उत्तानास् तिरश्चीर् वापि वा द्वे उत्ताने उपभृतं तिरश्चीम् ।
1.7.23.c.m: They are either turned upwards, or across; or else two are turned upwards, and the upabhṛt ladle across.

1.7.23.d.m: Having addressed them with 'You are unblunted, destroyers of rivals,'

1.7.23.e.s: ghṛtācīr eta \\ agnir vo hvayati devayajyāyai \\ ity ādāya /
1.7.23.e.d: घृताचीर् एत \\ अग्निर् वो ह्वयति देवयज्यायै \\ इत्य् आदाय ।
1.7.23.e.m: [and] having taken them with 'Come, bearers of clarified butter! Agni summons you to the worship of the gods,'

1.7.23.f.s: pratyuṣṭam ity āhavanīye gārhapatye vā niṣṭapati /
1.7.23.f.d: प्रत्युष्टम् इत्य् आहवनीये गार्हपत्ये वा निष्टपति ।
1.7.23.f.m: he warms them over the fire in the āhavanīya fire or the gārhapatya fire with '[Burnt is] scorched.'

1.7.23.g.s: goṣṭhaṃ mā nirmṛkṣam iti sruvam agrair antarato 'bhyākāram̐ sarvato bilam abhi saṃmārṣṭi mūlair daṇḍam /
1.7.23.g.d: गोष्ठं मा निर्मृक्षम् इति स्रुवम् अग्रैर् अन्तरतो ऽभ्याकारम्̐ सर्वतो बिलम् अभि संमार्ष्टि मूलैर् दण्डम् ।
1.7.23.g.m: With 'May I not wipe away the cow-pen,' he cleanses the dipping spoon with the tips [of the grass] inwards, from all sides around the bowl, and with the root ends, the handle.

1.7.23.h.s: vācaṃ prāṇam iti juhūṃ prācīm agrair antarato 'bhyākāraṃ pratīcīṃ madhyair bāhyato mūlair daṇḍam /
1.7.23.h.d: वाचं प्राणम् इति जुहूं प्राचीम् अग्रैर् अन्तरतो ऽभ्याकारं प्रतीचीं मध्यैर् बाह्यतो मूलैर् दण्डम् ।
1.7.23.h.m: With 'Speech, breath,' [he cleanses] the juhū ladle facing east with the tips inwards, [turning it] westward with the middle parts on the outside, and with the root ends, the handle.

1.7.23.i.s: cakṣuḥ śrotram ity upabhṛtaṃ pratīcīm agrair antarato 'bhyākāraṃ prācīṃ madhyair bāhyato mūlair daṇḍam /
1.7.23.i.d: चक्षुः श्रोत्रम् इत्य् उपभृतं प्रतीचीम् अग्रैर् अन्तरतो ऽभ्याकारं प्राचीं मध्यैर् बाह्यतो मूलैर् दण्डम् ।
1.7.23.i.m: With 'Eye, ear,' [he cleanses] the upabhṛt ladle facing west with the tips inwards, [turning it] eastward with the middle parts on the outside, and with the root ends, the handle.

1.7.23.j.s: prajāṃ yonim iti dhruvāṃ yathā sruvam /
1.7.23.j.d: प्रजां योनिम् इति ध्रुवां यथा स्रुवम् ।
1.7.23.j.m: With 'Offspring, source,' [he cleanses] the dhruvā ladle just like the dipping spoon.

1.7.23.k.m: He does not mix a cleansed [ladle] with an uncleansed one.

1.7.23.m.s: annādyaṃ prajāṃ puṣṭiṃ mā nirmṛkṣam \\ vāji tvā sapatnasāham̐ saṃmārjmi \\ iti prāśitraharaṇam̐ sarvato bilam abhi saṃmārṣṭi mūlair daṇḍam /
1.7.23.m.d: अन्नाद्यं प्रजां पुष्टिं मा निर्मृक्षम् \\ वाजि त्वा सपत्नसाहम्̐ संमार्ज्मि \\ इति प्राशित्रहरणम्̐ सर्वतो बिलम् अभि संमार्ष्टि मूलैर् दण्डम् ।
1.7.23.m.m: With 'May I not wipe away food, offspring, and prosperity; victorious, overcoming rivals, I cleanse you,' he cleanses the prāśitra vessel around the bowl from all sides, and with the root ends, the handle.

1.7.23.n.s: divaḥ śilpam avatatam \\ pṛthivyāḥ kakubhiḥ śritam / \ tena vayam̐ sahasravalśena \ sapatnaṃ nāśayāmasi svāhā \\ iti saṃmārgān abhyukṣyāgnāv ādadhāti yatarasmin saṃmārṣṭi /
1.7.23.n.d: दिवः शिल्पम् अवततम् \\ पृथिव्याः ककुभिः श्रितम् । \ तेन वयम्̐ सहस्रवल्शेन \ सपत्नं नाशयामसि स्वाहा \\ इति संमार्गान् अभ्युक्ष्याग्नाव् आदधाति यतरस्मिन् संमार्ष्टि ।
1.7.23.n.m: With 'The craft of heaven is stretched out, resting upon the peaks of the earth; with that thousand-branched one, we destroy the rival, svāhā,' having sprinkled the cleansings with water, he places them into whichever of the two fires he is cleansing [the ladles] by.

1.7.23.o.s: āśāsānā saumanasam iti mauñjena yoktreṇānyatarataḥpāśena patnīm̐ saṃnahyaty ūrdhvajñur āsīnā tiṣṭhantī vā /
1.7.23.o.d: आशासाना सौमनसम् इति मौञ्जेन योक्त्रेणान्यतरतःपाशेन पत्नीम्̐ संनह्यत्य् ऊर्ध्वज्ञुर् आसीना तिष्ठन्ती वा ।
1.7.23.o.m: With 'Hoping for goodwill,' he girds the sacrificer's wife with a girdle of muñja grass having a loop at one end, while she is either sitting with knees raised or standing.

1.7.23.q.s: pūṣā te granthiṃ grathnātu \\ ity uttarato nābher niṣṭarkyaṃ granthiṃ kṛtvā sa te māsthāt \\ iti dakṣiṇato nābheḥ parikarṣati /
1.7.23.q.d: पूषा ते ग्रन्थिं ग्रथ्नातु \\ इत्य् उत्तरतो नाभेर् निष्टर्क्यं ग्रन्थिं कृत्वा स ते मास्थात् \\ इति दक्षिणतो नाभेः परिकर्षति ।
1.7.23.q.m: Having made a slipknot to the north of the navel with 'May Pūṣan tie your knot,' he draws it around to the south of the navel with 'May it not slip from you.'

1.7.23.r.s: agne gṛhapata upa mā hvayasva \\ iti //
1.7.23.r.d: अग्ने गृहपत उप मा ह्वयस्व \\ इति ॥
1.7.23.r.m: With 'O Agni, master of the house, summon me,'

1.7.24.a.m: standing, she waits upon the gārhapatya fire.

1.7.24.b.s: patni patny eṣa te lokas \\ namas te astu \ mā mā him̐sīs \\ iti tam eva deśaṃ prekṣate /
1.7.24.b.d: पत्नि पत्न्य् एष ते लोकस् \\ नमस् ते अस्तु \ मा मा हिम्̐सीस् \\ इति तम् एव देशं प्रेक्षते ।
1.7.24.b.m: With 'O wife, o wife, this is your place. Homage to you. Do not harm me,' she looks at that very place.

1.7.24.c.s: indrāṇīvāvidhavā bhūyāsam \ aditir iva suputrā / \ asthūri tvā gārhapatya \\ upaniṣade suprajāstvāya \\ iti dakṣiṇataḥpaścād gārhapatyasyodīcy upaviśati /
1.7.24.c.d: इन्द्राणीवाविधवा भूयासम् \ अदितिर् इव सुपुत्रा । \ अस्थूरि त्वा गार्हपत्य \\ उपनिषदे सुप्रजास्त्वाय \\ इति दक्षिणतःपश्चाद् गार्हपत्यस्योदीच्य् उपविशति ।
1.7.24.c.m: With 'Like Indrāṇī may I not be widowed, like Aditi may I have good sons; may I sit near you, the one-horse chariot, O gārhapatya, for good offspring,' she sits down south-west of the gārhapatya fire, facing north.

1.7.24.d.m: Thus girded, she sits by until the unloosing.

1.7.24.e.m: Sitting, she mutters: 'We, having good offspring, [wait upon] you...'

1.7.24.f.s: mama putrāḥ śatruhaṇas \\ atho me duhitā virāṭ / \ utāham asmi saṃjayā \ patyur me śloka uttamas \\ iti ca /
1.7.24.f.d: मम पुत्राः शत्रुहणस् \\ अथो मे दुहिता विराट् । \ उताहम् अस्मि संजया \ पत्युर् मे श्लोक उत्तमस् \\ इति च ।
1.7.24.f.m: and: 'My sons are slayers of enemies, moreover my daughter is splendid, and I am victorious; the fame of my husband is supreme.'

1.7.24.g.s: pūṣā te bilaṃ viṣyatu \\ iti sarpirdhānasya gargarasya bilaṃ viṣyati pūṣāsi \\ iti vā /
1.7.24.g.d: पूषा ते बिलं विष्यतु \\ इति सर्पिर्धानस्य गर्गरस्य बिलं विष्यति पूषासि \\ इति वा ।
1.7.24.g.m: With 'May Pūṣan unclose your mouth,' he opens the mouth of the vessel of clarified butter, or with 'You are Pūṣan.'

1.7.24.h.s: anyasmin pātre niṣicya yāv anirvapsyan bhavati /
1.7.24.h.d: अन्यस्मिन् पात्रे निषिच्य याव् अनिर्वप्स्यन् भवति ।
1.7.24.h.m: Having poured it into another vessel, as much as he is going to apportion [into the pot],

1.7.24.i.s: idaṃ viṣṇur vicakrame \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnāv adhiśritya /
1.7.24.i.d: इदं विष्णुर् विचक्रमे \\ इति दक्षिणाग्नाव् अधिश्रित्य ।
1.7.24.i.m: having placed it over the dakṣiṇāgni fire with 'Through this Viṣṇu strode,'

1.7.24.j.s: aditir asy anācchinnapavitrā \\ ity ājyasthālīm ādāya mahīnāṃ payo 'si \\ iti tasyāṃ pavitrāntarhitāyāṃ prabhūtam ājyaṃ nirvapati /
1.7.24.j.d: अदितिर् अस्य् अनाच्छिन्नपवित्रा \\ इत्य् आज्यस्थालीम् आदाय महीनां पयो ऽसि \\ इति तस्यां पवित्रान्तर्हितायां प्रभूतम् आज्यं निर्वपति ।
1.7.24.j.m: having taken the clarified butter pot with 'You are Aditi, whose strainer is unbroken,' he ladles abundant clarified butter into it over the two strainers placed across it with 'You are the milk of the great ones.'

1.7.24.k.s: iṣe tvā \\ iti dakṣiṇārdhe gārhapatyasyāṅgāreṣv adhiśrayati /
1.7.24.k.d: इषे त्वा \\ इति दक्षिणार्धे गार्हपत्यस्याङ्गारेष्व् अधिश्रयति ।
1.7.24.k.m: With 'For strength to you,' he places it over the embers in the southern half of the gārhapatya fire.

1.7.24.l.s: ūrje tvā \\ ity upādāya vedenopayamya patnyā upaharati /
1.7.24.l.d: ऊर्जे त्वा \\ इत्य् उपादाय वेदेनोपयम्य पत्न्या उपहरति ।
1.7.24.l.m: Taking it up with 'For vigor to you,' supporting it with the grass brush, he brings it near to the sacrificer's wife.

1.7.24.m.s: mahīnāṃ payo 'si \\ iti tat sā nimīlyānucchvasanty avekṣate /
1.7.24.m.d: महीनां पयो ऽसि \\ इति तत् सा निमील्यानुच्छ्वसन्त्य् अवेक्षते ।
1.7.24.m.m: Closing her eyes and without breathing out, she looks at it with 'You are the milk of the great ones.'

1.7.24.n.m: With 'You are fiery energy,' he places it over the gārhapatya fire.

1.7.24.o.s: tejase tvā \\ ity upādāya tejo 'nu prehi \\ iti harati /
1.7.24.o.d: तेजसे त्वा \\ इत्य् उपादाय तेजो ऽनु प्रेहि \\ इति हरति ।
1.7.24.o.m: Taking it up with 'For fiery energy to you,' he carries it with 'Follow after fiery energy.'

1.7.24.p.s: agnis te tejo mā vinait \\ ity āhavanīye 'dhiśrayati \\ agnis te tejo mā vinait \\ yajñe yajñam̐ sam̐sādayāmi yajñe yajñaḥ pratiṣṭhitas \\ iti vā /
1.7.24.p.d: अग्निस् ते तेजो मा विनैत् \\ इत्य् आहवनीये ऽधिश्रयति \\ अग्निस् ते तेजो मा विनैत् \\ यज्ञे यज्ञम्̐ सम्̐सादयामि यज्ञे यज्ञः प्रतिष्ठितस् \\ इति वा ।
1.7.24.p.m: With 'May Agni not depart from your fiery energy,' he places it over the āhavanīya fire; or with 'May Agni not depart from your fiery energy; in the sacrifice I establish the sacrifice, the sacrifice is established in the sacrifice.'

1.7.24.q.s: agner jihvāsi \\ ity uttareṇa prokṣaṇīḥ sphyasya vartman sādayati /
1.7.24.q.d: अग्नेर् जिह्वासि \\ इत्य् उत्तरेण प्रोक्षणीः स्फ्यस्य वर्त्मन् सादयति ।
1.7.24.q.m: With 'You are the tongue of Agni,' he places it north of the sprinkling waters on the track of the wooden sword.

1.7.24.r.m: With 'You are clarified butter,' he looks down at the clarified butter,

1.7.24.t.s: śukram asi \ jyotir asi \ tejo 'si \\ ity udagagrābhyāṃ pavitrābhyāṃ punarāhāram ājyaṃ trir utpunāti /
1.7.24.t.d: शुक्रम् असि \ ज्योतिर् असि \ तेजो ऽसि \\ इत्य् उदगग्राभ्यां पवित्राभ्यां पुनराहारम् आज्यं त्रिर् उत्पुनाति ।
1.7.24.t.m: With 'You are bright,' 'You are light,' 'You are fiery energy,' he purifies the clarified butter three times with the two strainers with ends pointed north, drawing them back [each time].

1.7.24.u.m: With 'May the god [Savitṛ purify] you,' [he purifies] the sprinkling waters three times;

1.7.25.a.m: or with 'O waters, carry away, delight, anoint with sweetness, sit down in the seat, not taking offense at the journey.'

1.7.25.b.m: Within the altar, he takes the portions of clarified butter,

1.7.25.e.s: catuḥ pañca vā juhvāṃ gṛhṇāty aṣṭau daśa vopabhṛti yathā juhvām evaṃ dhruvāyām /
1.7.25.e.d: चतुः पञ्च वा जुह्वां गृह्णात्य् अष्टौ दश वोपभृति यथा जुह्वाम् एवं ध्रुवायाम् ।
1.7.25.e.m: He takes four or five [spoonfuls] in the juhū ladle, eight or ten in the upabhṛt ladle, and as in the juhū ladle, so in the dhruvā ladle.

1.7.25.f.s: bhūyo juhvām alpiṣṭham upabhṛti bhūyiṣṭhaṃ dhruvāyām /
1.7.25.f.d: भूयो जुह्वाम् अल्पिष्ठम् उपभृति भूयिष्ठं ध्रुवायाम् ।
1.7.25.f.m: [He takes] more in the juhū ladle, least in the upabhṛt ladle, and most in the dhruvā ladle.

1.7.25.g.s: upabilam̐ sthālyā juhūṃ dhārayamāṇo madhyadeśa upabhṛti bhūmau pratiṣṭhitāyāṃ dhruvāyām̐ ṣoḍaśāny ājyāni gṛhṇāti /
1.7.25.g.d: उपबिलम्̐ स्थाल्या जुहूं धारयमाणो मध्यदेश उपभृति भूमौ प्रतिष्ठितायां ध्रुवायाम्̐ षोडशान्य् आज्यानि गृह्णाति ।
1.7.25.g.m: Holding the juhū ladle close to the brim of the pot, the upabhṛt ladle in the middle space, and the dhruvā ladle placed on the ground, he takes sixteen portions of clarified butter.

1.7.25.h.m: One desiring cattle should make seventeen; one desiring a firm footing, twenty-one.

1.7.25.i.s: śukraṃ tvā śukrāyām ity etair juhvāṃ gṛhṇāti pañcānāṃ tvā vātānām iti cottarair upabhṛti dhruvāyāṃ ca /
1.7.25.i.d: शुक्रं त्वा शुक्रायाम् इत्य् एतैर् जुह्वां गृह्णाति पञ्चानां त्वा वातानाम् इति चोत्तरैर् उपभृति ध्रुवायां च ।
1.7.25.i.m: With these [mantras beginning with] 'You the bright into the bright,' he takes into the juhū ladle, and with the following ones beginning with 'Of the five winds to you,' into the upabhṛt ladle and the dhruvā ladle.

1.7.25.j.s: yady alpīyām̐so mantrāḥ syus teṣām ardhair upabhṛti gṛhṇīyād ardhair itarayor yadi bhūyām̐so 'vaśiṣṭā vikalpārthāḥ /
1.7.25.j.d: यद्य् अल्पीयाम्̐सो मन्त्राः स्युस् तेषाम् अर्धैर् उपभृति गृह्णीयाद् अर्धैर् इतरयोर् यदि भूयाम्̐सो ऽवशिष्टा विकल्पार्थाः ।
1.7.25.j.m: If the mantras should be fewer, he should take with half of them into the upabhṛt ladle and with half into the other two; if more, the remaining ones serve as alternatives.

1.7.25.k.s: śukram asi \ jyotir asi \ dhāmāsi priyaṃ devānām \ anādhṛṣṭaṃ devayajanam \\ devavītaye tvā gṛhṇāmi \\ iti vā saṃkhyāḥ pūrayati dhāmāsi \\ iti vā sarvāsu /
1.7.25.k.d: शुक्रम् असि \ ज्योतिर् असि \ धामासि प्रियं देवानाम् \ अनाधृष्टं देवयजनम् \\ देववीतये त्वा गृह्णामि \\ इति वा संख्याः पूरयति धामासि \\ इति वा सर्वासु ।
1.7.25.k.m: Or with 'You are bright, you are light, you are the dear abode of the gods, unassailable place of sacrifice; for the banquet of the gods I take you,' he completes the counts; or with 'You are the abode' for all of them.

1.7.25.l.s: anyatrotkarād ājyāni sādayitvāpoddhṛtyājyasthālīṃ prokṣaṇīr abhimantrya brahmāṇam āmantrya /
1.7.25.l.d: अन्यत्रोत्कराद् आज्यानि सादयित्वापोद्धृत्याज्यस्थालीं प्रोक्षणीर् अभिमन्त्र्य ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्य ।
1.7.25.l.m: Having placed the clarified butters elsewhere than the rubbish heap, having removed the pot of clarified butter, having addressed the sprinkling waters, and having summoned the brahman priest,

1.7.25.m.d: कृष्णो ऽसि \\ इति विषायेध्मं त्रिः प्रोक्षति ।
1.7.25.m.m: he unties the fuel and sprinkles it three times with 'You are the black deer.'

1.7.25.q.s: antarvedi purogranthi barhir āsādya dive tvā \\ ity agrāṇi prokṣati \\ antarikṣāya tvā \\ iti madhyāni pṛthivyai tvā \\ iti mūlāni /
1.7.25.q.d: अन्तर्वेदि पुरोग्रन्थि बर्हिर् आसाद्य दिवे त्वा \\ इत्य् अग्राणि प्रोक्षति \\ अन्तरिक्षाय त्वा \\ इति मध्यानि पृथिव्यै त्वा \\ इति मूलानि ।
1.7.25.q.m: Having placed the sacred grass inside the altar with its knot to the front, he sprinkles the tips with: "To the sky, thee!"; the middles with: "To the atmosphere, thee!"; the roots with: "To the earth, thee!"

1.7.25.r.m: Having let the tips touch the ladle, he causes the roots to touch [it].

1.7.25.s.s: poṣāya vas \\ iti sahasrucā purastāt pratyañcaṃ granthiṃ pratyukṣati /
1.7.25.s.d: पोषाय वस् \\ इति सहस्रुचा पुरस्तात् प्रत्यञ्चं ग्रन्थिं प्रत्युक्षति ।
1.7.25.s.m: With "For nourishment, you!" he sprinkles the knot back-to-front with the ladle from the east.

1.7.25.t.s: svadhā pitṛbhyas \\ iti prokṣaṇyavaśeṣaṃ ninayati dakṣiṇasyāḥ śroṇeḥ saṃtatam ottarasyāḥ /
1.7.25.t.d: स्वधा पितृभ्यस् \\ इति प्रोक्षण्यवशेषं निनयति दक्षिणस्याः श्रोणेः संततम् ओत्तरस्याः ।
1.7.25.t.m: With "Svadhā to the fathers!" he pours out the remainder of the sprinkling water in an unbroken line from the southern hip to the northern.

1.7.25.u.s: pūṣā te granthiṃ viṣyatu \\ iti barhiṣo granthiṃ viṣyati /
1.7.25.u.d: पूषा ते ग्रन्थिं विष्यतु \\ इति बर्हिषो ग्रन्थिं विष्यति ।
1.7.25.u.m: With "May Pūṣan untie thy knot," he unties the knot of the sacred grass.

1.7.25.v.s: viṣṇo stūpo 'si \\ iti purastāt prastaraṃ gṛhṇāti /
1.7.25.v.d: विष्णो स्तूपो ऽसि \\ इति पुरस्तात् प्रस्तरं गृह्णाति ।
1.7.25.v.m: With "Thou art the topknot of Viṣṇu," he takes the prastara bunch from the eastern side.

1.7.25.w.m: He does not draw it out downwards.

1.7.25.aa.m: He takes it out, as if dragging it.

1.7.25.ab.s: yajamāne prāṇāpānau dadhāmi \\ iti prastare pavitre apisṛjya /
1.7.25.ab.d: यजमाने प्राणापानौ दधामि \\ इति प्रस्तरे पवित्रे अपिसृज्य ।
1.7.25.ab.m: Having united the two purifiers with the prastara bunch with "In the sacrificer I place the in-breath and the out-breath,"

1.7.25.ac.s: prāṇāpānābhyāṃ tvā satanuṃ karomi \\ iti brahmaṇe prayacchati /
1.7.25.ac.d: प्राणापानाभ्यां त्वा सतनुं करोमि \\ इति ब्रह्मणे प्रयच्छति ।
1.7.25.ac.m: he hands it to the brahman priest with "With the in-breath and the out-breath I make thee embodied."

1.8.26.b.m: Having covered it with blades of grass, he strews the cord diagonally.

1.8.26.c.m: "Along the southern border of the altar," according to some.

1.8.26.d.s: devabarhis \\ ūrṇāmradasaṃ tvā stṛṇāmi ity agrair mūlāny ācchādayan bahulam anatidṛśnaṃ prāgapavargaṃ vā tridhātu pañcadhātu vā /
1.8.26.d.d: देवबर्हिस् \\ ऊर्णाम्रदसं त्वा स्तृणामि इत्य् अग्रैर् मूलान्य् आच्छादयन् बहुलम् अनतिदृश्नं प्रागपवर्गं वा त्रिधातु पञ्चधातु वा ।
1.8.26.d.m: With "O divine grass, I strew thee, soft as wool!" covering the roots with the tips, thickly, not transparent, ending towards the east, in three layers or five layers.

1.8.26.e.m: He repeats the mantra layer by layer.

1.8.26.f.s: anūyājārthe ulmuke udūhyāhavanīyaṃ kalpayitvā pratyādāya prastaraṃ paridhīnp aridadhāti /
1.8.26.f.d: अनूयाजार्थे उल्मुके उदूह्याहवनीयं कल्पयित्वा प्रत्यादाय प्रस्तरं परिधीन्प् अरिदधाति ।
1.8.26.f.m: Having pushed back the two firebrands for the purpose of the after-offerings and arranged the āhavanīya fire, taking back the prastara bunch, he lays down the enclosing sticks.

1.8.26.g.s: gandharvo 'si \\ ity apareṇāhavanīyaṃ barhiṣy udagagraṃ madhyamam indrasya bāhur asi iti dakṣiṇārdhyam̐ sam̐spṛṣṭaṃ madhyamenābhyagraṃ mitrāvaruṇau tvā \\ ity uttarārdhyam̐ sam̐spṛṣṭaṃ madhyamenāgram /
1.8.26.g.d: गन्धर्वो ऽसि \\ इत्य् अपरेणाहवनीयं बर्हिष्य् उदगग्रं मध्यमम् इन्द्रस्य बाहुर् असि इति दक्षिणार्ध्यम्̐ सम्̐स्पृष्टं मध्यमेनाभ्यग्रं मित्रावरुणौ त्वा \\ इत्य् उत्तरार्ध्यम्̐ सम्̐स्पृष्टं मध्यमेनाग्रम् ।
1.8.26.g.m: With "Thou art a Gandharva," [he lays] the middle one behind the āhavanīya fire on the sacred grass with its tip pointing to the north; with "Thou art the arm of Indra," the southern one touching the middle one at its tip; with "May Mitra and Varuṇa [protect] thee," the northern one touching the middle one at its tip.

1.8.26.h.s: sūryas tvā purastāt pātu \\ ity āhavanīyam abhimṛśya /
1.8.26.h.d: सूर्यस् त्वा पुरस्तात् पातु \\ इत्य् आहवनीयम् अभिमृश्य ।
1.8.26.h.m: Having touched the āhavanīya fire with "May the sun protect thee from the east!"

1.8.26.i.s: ūrdhve ādhārasamidhāv ādadhāti vītihotraṃ tvā kave \\ iti dakṣiṇāṃ tūṣṇīm uttarām \\ samid asi \\ āyuṣe tvā \\ iti vā /
1.8.26.i.d: ऊर्ध्वे आधारसमिधाव् आदधाति वीतिहोत्रं त्वा कवे \\ इति दक्षिणां तूष्णीम् उत्तराम् \\ समिद् असि \\ आयुषे त्वा \\ इति वा ।
1.8.26.i.m: he lays down the two upright fuel sticks of the ādhāra offering: the southern one with "Thee, the invoker of feasts, O sage!"; the northern one silently; or with "A fuel stick art thou!" and "For life, thee!"

1.8.26.j.s: samāv anantargarbhau darbhau barhiṣo vidhṛtī karoti /
1.8.26.j.d: समाव् अनन्तर्गर्भौ दर्भौ बर्हिषो विधृती करोति ।
1.8.26.j.m: He makes two equal, shoot-less darbha blades from the sacred grass into the two separator blades.

1.8.26.k.s: viśo yantre sthas \\ iti madhye veder barhiṣy udīcīnāgre nidadhāti /
1.8.26.k.d: विशो यन्त्रे स्थस् \\ इति मध्ये वेदेर् बर्हिष्य् उदीचीनाग्रे निदधाति ।
1.8.26.k.m: With "Ye two are the restrainers of the people," he places them in the middle of the altar on the sacred grass, with their tips pointing to the north.

1.8.26.l.s: vasūnām̐ rudrāṇām iti tayoḥ prastaram̐ sādayati /
1.8.26.l.d: वसूनाम्̐ रुद्राणाम् इति तयोः प्रस्तरम्̐ सादयति ।
1.8.26.l.m: With "Of the Vasus, of the Rudras..." he places the prastara bunch upon the two.

1.8.26.m.s: juhūr asi \\ iti prastare juhūm̐ samaṃ mūlair daṇḍam /
1.8.26.m.d: जुहूर् असि \\ इति प्रस्तरे जुहूम्̐ समं मूलैर् दण्डम् ।
1.8.26.m.m: With "Thou art the juhū," [he places] the juhū ladle on the prastara bunch, its handle aligned with the roots.

1.8.26.n.s: dhruvāsi \\ ity uttarām dhruvām upariṣṭād vidhṛtyoḥ pratikṛṣṭatarām asam̐spṛṣṭām̐ sādayati /
1.8.26.n.d: ध्रुवासि \\ इत्य् उत्तराम् ध्रुवाम् उपरिष्टाद् विधृत्योः प्रतिकृष्टतराम् असम्̐स्पृष्टाम्̐ सादयति ।
1.8.26.n.m: With "Thou art the dhruvā," he places the dhruvā ladle towards the north, above the two separator blades, drawn further back, not touching [the juhū ladle].

1.8.26.o.s: ṛṣabho 'si śākvaras \\ vaṣaṭkārasya tvā mātrāyām̐ sādayāmi \\ iti dakṣiṇena juhūm̐ sruvam̐ sādayati dhruvāṃ vottareṇa \\ ṛṣabho 'si śākvaras \\ ghṛtācīnām̐ sūnuḥ priyeṇa nāmnā priye sadasi sīda \\ iti vā //
1.8.26.o.d: ऋषभो ऽसि शाक्वरस् \\ वषट्कारस्य त्वा मात्रायाम्̐ सादयामि \\ इति दक्षिणेन जुहूम्̐ स्रुवम्̐ सादयति ध्रुवां वोत्तरेण \\ ऋषभो ऽसि शाक्वरस् \\ घृताचीनाम्̐ सूनुः प्रियेण नाम्ना प्रिये सदसि सीद \\ इति वा ॥
1.8.26.o.m: With "Thou art the bull of the Śakvarī verses, I place thee in the measure of the vaṣaṭ-call," he places the dipping spoon south of the juhū ladle, or north of the dhruvā ladle; or with: "Thou art the bull of the Śakvarī verses, the son of the butter-faced ladles; sit down in the dear seat by thy dear name!"

1.8.27.a.m: He addresses them with: "These have sat down."

1.8.27.b.s: viṣṇūni stha \ vaiṣṇavāni dhāmāni prājāpatyāni \\ ity ājyāni /
1.8.27.b.d: विष्णूनि स्थ \ वैष्णवानि धामानि प्राजापत्यानि \\ इत्य् आज्यानि ।
1.8.27.b.m: He addresses the portions of clarified butter with: "Ye belong to Viṣṇu, ye are realms belonging to Viṣṇu, belonging to Prajāpati."

1.8.27.c.s: sruveṇa gārhapatyadakṣiṇāgnyor ājyārthān ājyasyālpāḥ karoti juhvā dhruvāyā āhavanīye /
1.8.27.c.d: स्रुवेण गार्हपत्यदक्षिणाग्न्योर् आज्यार्थान् आज्यस्याल्पाः करोति जुह्वा ध्रुवाया आहवनीये ।
1.8.27.c.m: With the dipping spoon he makes small [portions] of clarified butter intended for clarified butter for the gārhapatya fire and dakṣiṇāgni fire; with the juhū ladle and the dhruvā ladle, for the āhavanīya fire.

1.8.27.d.s: idam aham̐ senāyā abhītvaryai mukham apohāmi \\ iti vedena dakṣiṇasmāt puroḍāśād aṅgārān apohyottarasmād apohati /
1.8.27.d.d: इदम् अहम्̐ सेनाया अभीत्वर्यै मुखम् अपोहामि \\ इति वेदेन दक्षिणस्मात् पुरोडाशाद् अङ्गारान् अपोह्योत्तरस्माद् अपोहति ।
1.8.27.d.m: With "Here I sweep away the mouth of the advancing army," with the veda bunch he sweeps away the burning coals from the southern sacrificial cake and then sweeps [them] away from the northern one.

1.8.27.e.s: sūryajyotir vibhāhi mahata indriyāya \\ ity abhimantrayate syonaṃ te sadanaṃ karomi \ ghṛtasya dhārayā suśevaṃ kalpayāmi \\ iti pātryāmupastīrya \\ āpyāyatāṃ ghṛtayonis \\ agnir havyānumanyatām / \ kham aṅkṣva tvacam aṅkṣva \ surūpaṃ tvā vasuvidaṃ paśūnāṃ tejasāgnaye juṣṭam abhighārayāmi \\ ity āgneyam abhighārayati tūṣṇīm uttaram /
1.8.27.e.d: सूर्यज्योतिर् विभाहि महत इन्द्रियाय \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्रयते स्योनं ते सदनं करोमि \ घृतस्य धारया सुशेवं कल्पयामि \\ इति पात्र्यामुपस्तीर्य \\ आप्यायतां घृतयोनिस् \\ अग्निर् हव्यानुमन्यताम् । \ खम् अङ्क्ष्व त्वचम् अङ्क्ष्व \ सुरूपं त्वा वसुविदं पशूनां तेजसाग्नये जुष्टम् अभिघारयामि \\ इत्य् आग्नेयम् अभिघारयति तूष्णीम् उत्तरम् ।
1.8.27.e.m: He addresses it with "Shine, O sunlight, for great strength!"; having under-layered the dish with "I make a comfortable seat for thee; I prepare it pleasant with a stream of clarified butter!"; with "May the butter-womb swell, may Agni approve the offerings; anoint thy hollow, anoint thy skin; thee, of good form, finding wealth, with the splendor of cattle, agreeable to Agni, I sprinkle," he sprinkles the cake for Agni, and the northern one silently.

1.8.27.f.s: yas ta ātmā paśuṣu praviṣṭas \\ devānāṃ viṣṭām anu yo vitasthe / \ ātmanvān soma ghṛtavān hi bhūtvā \ devān gaccha suvar vinda yajamānāya mahyam iti śṛtam /
1.8.27.f.d: यस् त आत्मा पशुषु प्रविष्टस् \\ देवानां विष्टाम् अनु यो वितस्थे । \ आत्मन्वान् सोम घृतवान् हि भूत्वा \ देवान् गच्छ सुवर् विन्द यजमानाय मह्यम् इति शृतम् ।
1.8.27.f.m: With "What self of thine has entered the cattle, which extended along the expanse of the gods, having become possessed of a self and rich in clarified butter, O Soma, go to the gods, win the heavenly realm for me, the sacrificer!" [he addresses] the boiled [milk].

1.8.27.g.s: ārdraḥ prathasnur bhuvanasya gopās \\ śṛta utsnāti janitā matīnām iti puroḍāśam udvāsayaty abhindann aparyāvartayan /
1.8.27.g.d: आर्द्रः प्रथस्नुर् भुवनस्य गोपास् \\ शृत उत्स्नाति जनिता मतीनाम् इति पुरोडाशम् उद्वासयत्य् अभिन्दन्न् अपर्यावर्तयन् ।
1.8.27.g.m: With "Moist, broad, protector of the world, cooked, he swims out, the begetter of thoughts," he takes off the sacrificial cake without breaking it and without turning it over.

1.8.27.h.m: Having wiped off the ashes with the veda bunch,

1.8.27.i.s: tasmin sīdāmṛte pratitiṣṭha \ vrīhīṇāṃ medha sumanasyamānas \\ ity upastīrṇe pātryāṃ nidadhāti /
1.8.27.i.d: तस्मिन् सीदामृते प्रतितिष्ठ \ व्रीहीणां मेध सुमनस्यमानस् \\ इत्य् उपस्तीर्णे पात्र्यां निदधाति ।
1.8.27.i.m: he places it in the under-layered dish with: "Sit in that, be established in the immortal, O sap of rice, being well-disposed!"

1.8.27.j.s: irā bhūtiḥ pṛthivyai raso motkramīt \\ ity ekaikaśaḥ kapālāny abhighārya saṃkhyāyodvāsayati /
1.8.27.j.d: इरा भूतिः पृथिव्यै रसो मोत्क्रमीत् \\ इत्य् एकैकशः कपालान्य् अभिघार्य संख्यायोद्वासयति ।
1.8.27.j.m: With "May not refreshment, prosperity, the sap of the earth depart!" having sprinkled each potsherd one by one and counted them, he removes them.

1.8.27.k.s: devas tvā savitā madhvānaktu \\ iti puroḍāśam anakti /
1.8.27.k.d: देवस् त्वा सविता मध्वानक्तु \\ इति पुरोडाशम् अनक्ति ।
1.8.27.k.m: With "May the divine Savitṛ anoint thee with honey!" he anoints the sacrificial cake.

1.8.27.l.s: svaktam akūrmapṛṣantam aparivargamaṇikāṣam upariṣṭād abhyajya sruveṇa hastenādhastād upānakti /
1.8.27.l.d: स्वक्तम् अकूर्मपृषन्तम् अपरिवर्गमणिकाषम् उपरिष्टाद् अभ्यज्य स्रुवेण हस्तेनाधस्ताद् उपानक्ति ।
1.8.27.l.m: Having anointed it well on top with the dipping spoon, not spotted like a tortoise, without leaving any dry spot, he anoints it underneath with his hand.

1.8.27.m.s: priyeṇa nāmnā priyam̐ sada āsīdatām ity apareṇa srucaḥ puroḍāśāv āsādayati dakṣiṇam āgneyam uttaram itaram /
1.8.27.m.d: प्रियेण नाम्ना प्रियम्̐ सद आसीदताम् इत्य् अपरेण स्रुचः पुरोडाशाव् आसादयति दक्षिणम् आग्नेयम् उत्तरम् इतरम् ।
1.8.27.m.m: With "May the two sit down in their dear seat by their dear name!" he places the two sacrificial cakes behind the ladles, the one for Agni to the south, the other to the north.

1.8.27.n.s: madhye vedeḥ sāṃnāyyakumbhyau saṃdhāya vyūhati dakṣiṇasyām̐ śroṇyām̐ śṛtam uttarasyāṃ dadhi /
1.8.27.n.d: मध्ये वेदेः सांनाय्यकुम्भ्यौ संधाय व्यूहति दक्षिणस्याम्̐ श्रोण्याम्̐ शृतम् उत्तरस्यां दधि ।
1.8.27.n.m: Having brought together the two vessels of curd-and-milk oblation in the middle of the altar, he separates them: the boiled [milk] on the southern hip, the curd on the northern.

1.8.27.o.s: ayaṃ vedaḥ pṛthivīm anvavindat \\ guhā satīṃ gahane gahvareṣu / \ sa vindatu yajamānāya lokam \ acchidraṃ yajñaṃ bhūrikarmā karotu \\ ity agreṇa dhruvāṃ vedaṃ nidhāya /
1.8.27.o.d: अयं वेदः पृथिवीम् अन्वविन्दत् \\ गुहा सतीं गहने गह्वरेषु । \ स विन्दतु यजमानाय लोकम् \ अच्छिद्रं यज्ञं भूरिकर्मा करोतु \\ इत्य् अग्रेण ध्रुवां वेदं निधाय ।
1.8.27.o.m: Having placed the veda bunch in front of the dhruvā ladle with "This veda found the earth hidden in secret in deep recesses; may it find a realm for the sacrificer; may it of many rites make the sacrifice flawless!"

1.8.27.q.m: he prepares the seat of the hotṛ, he prepares it.

2.1.1.a.s: agnaye samidhyamānāyānubrūhi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati samidhyamānāyānubrūhi \\ iti vā \\ agnaye devebhyaḥ samidhyamānāya hotar anubrūhi \\ iti vā /
2.1.1.a.d: अग्नये समिध्यमानायानुब्रूहि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति समिध्यमानायानुब्रूहि \\ इति वा \\ अग्नये देवेभ्यः समिध्यमानाय होतर् अनुब्रूहि \\ इति वा ।
2.1.1.a.m: He issues the direction: "Recite for Agni being kindled!" or "Recite for [him] being kindled!" or "O hotṛ, recite for Agni being kindled for the gods!"

2.1.1.b.m: Seated, at each praṇava he puts on a fuel stick.

2.1.1.c.s: samiddho agna āhuta \\ ity asyām uttamāyāṃ vānuyājasamidham avaśiṣya sarvam idhmam ādadhāti /
2.1.1.c.d: समिद्धो अग्न आहुत \\ इत्य् अस्याम् उत्तमायां वानुयाजसमिधम् अवशिष्य सर्वम् इध्मम् आदधाति ।
2.1.1.c.m: With "Kindled, O Agni, invoked..." or at this final verse, having left aside a fuel stick for the after-offerings, he puts on the entire kindling bundle.

2.1.1.e.m: He fans the āhavanīya fire three times with the veda bunch.

2.1.1.f.s: sruveṇa dhruvāyā ājyam ādāya vedenopayamyottaraṃ paridhisaṃdhim anvavahṛtya sruvaṃ prajāpataye manave svāhā \\ iti manasā dhyāyan dakṣiṇāprāñcam ṛjuṃ dīrgham̐ saṃtataṃ jyotiṣmatyāghārayati tiryañcaṃ vā sarvāṇīdhmakāṣṭhāni sam̐sparśayati /
2.1.1.f.d: स्रुवेण ध्रुवाया आज्यम् आदाय वेदेनोपयम्योत्तरं परिधिसंधिम् अन्ववहृत्य स्रुवं प्रजापतये मनवे स्वाहा \\ इति मनसा ध्यायन् दक्षिणाप्राञ्चम् ऋजुं दीर्घम्̐ संततं ज्योतिष्मत्याघारयति तिर्यञ्चं वा सर्वाणीध्मकाष्ठानि सम्̐स्पर्शयति ।
2.1.1.f.m: Taking clarified butter from the dhruvā ladle with the dipping spoon, supporting it with the veda bunch, bringing down the dipping spoon along the northern junction of the enclosing sticks, meditating in mind on "To Prajāpati, to Manu, svāhā!", he makes an āghāra libation in an unbroken, straight, long line towards the south-east into the flaming [fire], or transversely, causing it to touch all the firewood sticks.

2.1.1.g.s: sruveṇājyasthālyā ājyam ādāya \\ āpyāyatāṃ dhruvā ghṛtena \\ iti dhruvām āpyāyayati /
2.1.1.g.d: स्रुवेणाज्यस्थाल्या आज्यम् आदाय \\ आप्यायतां ध्रुवा घृतेन \\ इति ध्रुवाम् आप्याययति ।
2.1.1.g.m: Taking clarified butter from the pot of clarified butter with the dipping spoon, he replenishes the dhruvā ladle with "May the dhruvā swell with clarified butter!"

2.1.1.i.s: agnīt paridhīm̐ś cāgniṃ ca tristriḥ samṛḍḍhi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
2.1.1.i.d: अग्नीत् परिधीम्̐श् चाग्निं च त्रिस्त्रिः समृड्ढि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
2.1.1.i.m: He issues the direction: "O Agnīdhra, cleanse the enclosing sticks and the fire, three times each!"

2.1.1.j.s: idhmasaṃnahanāni sphya upasaṃgṛhyāgnīdhraḥ pradakṣiṇam anuparikrāman paridhīn saṃmārṣṭi madhyamam udañcaṃ prāñcāv itarau /
2.1.1.j.d: इध्मसंनहनानि स्फ्य उपसंगृह्याग्नीध्रः प्रदक्षिणम् अनुपरिक्रामन् परिधीन् संमार्ष्टि मध्यमम् उदञ्चं प्राञ्चाव् इतरौ ।
2.1.1.j.m: Taking the cords of the kindling bundle onto the wooden sword, walking around clockwise, the Agnīdhra cleanses the enclosing sticks: the middle one towards the north, the other two towards the east.

2.1.1.k.s: agne vājajid vājaṃ tvā sariṣyantaṃ vājaṃ jeṣyantaṃ vājajitaṃ vājajityāyai saṃmārjmy agnim annādyam annādyāya \\ iti trir agnim /
2.1.1.k.d: अग्ने वाजजिद् वाजं त्वा सरिष्यन्तं वाजं जेष्यन्तं वाजजितं वाजजित्यायै संमार्ज्म्य् अग्निम् अन्नाद्यम् अन्नाद्याय \\ इति त्रिर् अग्निम् ।
2.1.1.k.m: "O Agni, winner of prize, you about to run for the prize, about to win the prize, the winner of prize, for winning the prize I wipe, Agni the food-eater for eating food"—with [this mantra] he wipes the fire three times.

2.1.1.l.s: sarvāsv āhutiṣūpabhṛtā juhūm upadadhāti mukhato 'bhihṛtyopabhṛti juhūm avadadhāti hoṣyam̐s tenaiva pratyavaharati na sam̐śiñjayati nābhiṃ prati srucau dhārayate //
2.1.1.l.d: सर्वास्व् आहुतिषूपभृता जुहूम् उपदधाति मुखतो ऽभिहृत्योपभृति जुहूम् अवदधाति होष्यम्̐स् तेनैव प्रत्यवहरति न सम्̐शिञ्जयति नाभिं प्रति स्रुचौ धारयते ॥
2.1.1.l.m: At all oblations he supports the juhū with the upabhṛt; having brought [it] forward in front, he places the juhū down upon the upabhṛt; about to offer, he brings it forward together with it; he does not let them clink together; he holds both ladles opposite his navel.

2.1.2.a.m: "Level with the vital breaths," say some [teachers].

2.1.2.b.s: apareṇāhavanīyaṃ dakṣiṇena dakṣiṇātikrāmati savyenodaṅṅ api vā savyena dakṣiṇātikrāmati dakṣiṇenodaṅ /
2.1.2.b.d: अपरेणाहवनीयं दक्षिणेन दक्षिणातिक्रामति सव्येनोदङ्ङ् अपि वा सव्येन दक्षिणातिक्रामति दक्षिणेनोदङ् ।
2.1.2.b.m: To the west of the āhavanīya fire, he steps across to the south with his right [foot] and to the north with his left, or he steps across to the south with his left [foot] and to the north with his right.

2.1.2.c.s: ādhāram āghārayiṣyan bhuvanam asi \\ ity agreṇa juhūpabhṛtau devebhyaḥ prācīnam añjaliṃ karoti saprathā namo devebhyas \\ iti vā /
2.1.2.c.d: आधारम् आघारयिष्यन् भुवनम् असि \\ इत्य् अग्रेण जुहूपभृतौ देवेभ्यः प्राचीनम् अञ्जलिं करोति सप्रथा नमो देवेभ्यस् \\ इति वा ।
2.1.2.c.m: About to pour the continuous libation, [saying,] "You are the world," he makes an añjali toward the east for the gods in front of the juhū and the upabhṛt, or [saying,] "Far-extending, homage to the gods!"

2.1.2.d.m: [Saying,] "Svadhā to the ancestors!" toward the south.

2.1.2.e.s: juhv ehi \\ iti juhūm ādatte \\ upabhṛd ehi \\ ity upabhṛtam /
2.1.2.e.d: जुह्व् एहि \\ इति जुहूम् आदत्ते \\ उपभृद् एहि \\ इत्य् उपभृतम् ।
2.1.2.e.m: Saying, "Come, juhū!" he takes the juhū; saying, "Come, upabhṛt!" the upabhṛt.

2.1.2.f.s: suyame me 'dya ghṛtācī bhūyāstam̐ svāvṛtau sūpāvṛtau \\ ity upabhṛti juhūm avadadhāti /
2.1.2.f.d: सुयमे मे ऽद्य घृताची भूयास्तम्̐ स्वावृतौ सूपावृतौ \\ इत्य् उपभृति जुहूम् अवदधाति ।
2.1.2.f.m: Saying, "May you two be easily managed for me today, butter-laden, easy to turn, easy to turn toward!" he places the juhū down upon the upabhṛt.

2.1.2.g.m: Saying, "O Agni and Viṣṇu!" without trampling upon the prastara, he steps across to the south.

2.1.2.h.m: Saying, "You are the place of Viṣṇu," he stands.

2.1.2.i.s: yatrendras tiṣṭhan vīryam akarot tat tiṣṭhan vīryaṃ kriyāsam iti vā /
2.1.2.i.d: यत्रेन्द्रस् तिष्ठन् वीर्यम् अकरोत् तत् तिष्ठन् वीर्यं क्रियासम् इति वा ।
2.1.2.i.m: Or [saying,] "Where Indra standing performed a heroic deed, there standing may I perform a heroic deed!"

2.1.2.j.s: antarvedi dakṣiṇaṃ pādam avaghnan savyaṃ kṛtvā /
2.1.2.j.d: अन्तर्वेदि दक्षिणं पादम् अवघ्नन् सव्यं कृत्वा ।
2.1.2.j.m: Setting down his right foot inside the altar, having made it [follow] the left,

2.1.2.k.m: having brought the ladle along the southern enclosure-stick joint,

2.1.2.l.m: he pours the continuous libation [saying], "Taking hold..."

2.1.2.n.s: prāñcam udañcam ṛjuṃ dīrgham̐ saṃtataṃ jyotiṣmatyāghārayati /
2.1.2.n.d: प्राञ्चम् उदञ्चम् ऋजुं दीर्घम्̐ संततं ज्योतिष्मत्याघारयति ।
2.1.2.n.m: He pours the continuous libation eastward, northward, straight, long, unbroken, on a luminous [ember].

2.1.2.p.m: He causes it to touch all the firewood-sticks.

2.1.2.r.m: He should pour the continuous libation upwards for one desiring heaven; downwards for one desiring rain.

2.1.2.s.m: For an enemy, he pours downwards, or he breaks [the stream].

2.1.2.t.s: yaṃ kāmayeta pramāyukaḥ syād iti jihmaṃ tasyāghārayet /
2.1.2.t.d: यं कामयेत प्रमायुकः स्याद् इति जिह्मं तस्याघारयेत् ।
2.1.2.t.m: For whomsoever he might wish, "May he perish," he should pour his continuous libation crookedly.

2.1.2.u.m: Saying, "Lofty light..." he raises the ladle.

2.1.2.v.s: pāhi māgne \\ ity asam̐sprśayan srucāv atyākrāmati /
2.1.2.v.d: पाहि माग्ने \\ इत्य् असम्̐स्प्र्शयन् स्रुचाव् अत्याक्रामति ।
2.1.2.v.m: Saying, "Protect me, O Agni..." without letting the two ladles touch each other, he steps back across.

2.1.2.w.s: samaktam agninā ghṛtam \\ samaktam̐ haviṣā haviḥ / \ sam antarikṣam arciṣā \\ iti juhvā dhruvāṃ triḥ samanakti /
2.1.2.w.d: समक्तम् अग्निना घृतम् \\ समक्तम्̐ हविषा हविः । \ सम् अन्तरिक्षम् अर्चिषा \\ इति जुह्वा ध्रुवां त्रिः समनक्ति ।
2.1.2.w.m: "Anointed is the clarified butter by Agni, / anointed is the oblation with the oblation, / along with the atmosphere by radiance"—[with this verse] he anoints the dhruvā three times with the juhū.

2.1.2.y.s: unnītam̐ rāye \\ iti sruveṇa dhruvāyā ājyam ādāya suvīrāya svāhā \\ iti juhūṃ pratyabhighārayati /
2.1.2.y.d: उन्नीतम्̐ राये \\ इति स्रुवेण ध्रुवाया आज्यम् आदाय सुवीराय स्वाहा \\ इति जुहूं प्रत्यभिघारयति ।
2.1.2.y.m: Saying, "Brought up for wealth..." taking clarified butter from the dhruvā with the dipping ladle, he sprinkles it back onto the juhū [saying], "For good heroes, svāhā!"

2.1.2.z.s: yajñena yajñaḥ saṃtatas \\ iti juhvā dhruvām /
2.1.2.z.d: यज्ञेन यज्ञः संततस् \\ इति जुह्वा ध्रुवाम् ।
2.1.2.z.m: With "The sacrifice is continuous through sacrifice," [he touches] the dhruvā with the juhū.

2.1.2.ac.s: idhmasaṃnahanāni sphya upasaṃgṛhya vedeś ca tṛṇam avyantam adhvaryuḥ pravarāyāvatiṣṭhate //
2.1.2.ac.d: इध्मसंनहनानि स्फ्य उपसंगृह्य वेदेश् च तृणम् अव्यन्तम् अध्वर्युः प्रवरायावतिष्ठते ॥
2.1.2.ac.m: Having gathered the kindling ties and a single grass-blade from the altar upon the wooden sword, the adhvaryu stands in position for the ancestral invocation.

2.1.3.a.s: ka idam adhvaryur bhaviṣyati sa idam adhvaryur bhaviṣyati \ yajño yajñasya \ viṣṇoḥ sthāne tiṣṭhāmi \ vāg ārtvijyaṃ karotu \ mana ārtvijyaṃ karotu \ vācaṃ prapadye \ bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar ity adhvaryur japati /
2.1.3.a.d: क इदम् अध्वर्युर् भविष्यति स इदम् अध्वर्युर् भविष्यति \ यज्ञो यज्ञस्य \ विष्णोः स्थाने तिष्ठामि \ वाग् आर्त्विज्यं करोतु \ मन आर्त्विज्यं करोतु \ वाचं प्रपद्ये \ भूर् भुवः सुवर् इत्य् अध्वर्युर् जपति ।
2.1.3.a.m: "Who will be the adhvaryu here? He will be the adhvaryu here. Sacrifice of sacrifice. I stand in the place of Viṣṇu. May speech perform the priestly function; may mind perform the priestly function; I take refuge in speech; bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar"—[thus] the adhvaryu mutters.

2.1.3.b.m: Touching him from behind, the āgnīdhra stands behind [him].

2.1.3.c.s: ka idam agnīd bhaviṣyati sa idam agnīd bhaviṣyati \\ iti mantram̐ saṃnamati /
2.1.3.c.d: क इदम् अग्नीद् भविष्यति स इदम् अग्नीद् भविष्यति \\ इति मन्त्रम्̐ संनमति ।
2.1.3.c.m: "Who will be the agnīdh here? He will be the agnīdh here"—he alters the mantra accordingly.

2.1.3.d.m: "O brahman priest, I will issue the call for the ancestral invocation," he addresses [the brahman priest].

2.1.3.e.m: Saying, "āśrāvaya" or "ośrāvaya," he issues the call.

2.1.3.g.m: In this way the call and the response take place.

2.1.3.h.s: utkare dakṣiṇāmukhas tiṣṭhann āgnīdhraḥ sphyaṃ dhārayan pratyāśrāvayaty anyeṣv āśrāvaṇeṣu pravarāt /
2.1.3.h.d: उत्करे दक्षिणामुखस् तिष्ठन्न् आग्नीध्रः स्फ्यं धारयन् प्रत्याश्रावयत्य् अन्येष्व् आश्रावणेषु प्रवरात् ।
2.1.3.h.m: Standing on the rubbish heap facing south, holding the wooden sword, the āgnīdhra responds in the other calls [other] than the ancestral invocation.

2.1.3.i.m: When the response has been made, he chooses the ancestral invocation.

2.1.3.j.s: agnir devo hotā devān yakṣad vidvām̐ś cikitvan manuṣvad bharatavad amuvad amuvat \\ iti yathā yajamānasyārṣeyam̐ saha pareṇa trīn anantarān /
2.1.3.j.d: अग्निर् देवो होता देवान् यक्षद् विद्वाम्̐श् चिकित्वन् मनुष्वद् भरतवद् अमुवद् अमुवत् \\ इति यथा यजमानस्यार्षेयम्̐ सह परेण त्रीन् अनन्तरान् ।
2.1.3.j.m: "Agni is the divine hotṛ; may he worship the gods, wise, discerning, like Manu, like Bharata, like so-and-so, like so-and-so"—according to the ancestral line of the sacrificer, together with the highest, the three immediately preceding.

2.1.3.k.s: ita ūrdhvān mantrakṛto 'dhvaryur vṛṇīte yatharṣi mantrakṛto vṛṇīta iti vijñāyate /
2.1.3.k.d: इत ऊर्ध्वान् मन्त्रकृतो ऽध्वर्युर् वृणीते यथर्षि मन्त्रकृतो वृणीत इति विज्ञायते ।
2.1.3.k.m: Ascending from this [present one], the adhvaryu chooses the mantra-makers; "He chooses the mantra-makers according to the ṛṣis," so it is known.

2.1.3.l.m: "Descending from yonder is the hotṛ," so it is known.

2.1.3.m.m: A king chooses with the ancestral invocation of his purohita.

2.1.3.n.s: purohitasyārṣeyeṇāvedayed iti rājño vijñāyate niṣādarathakārāś ca yam ṛṣim anubruvate tena teṣāṃ pravaraṃ pravṛṇīte /
2.1.3.n.d: पुरोहितस्यार्षेयेणावेदयेद् इति राज्ञो विज्ञायते निषादरथकाराश् च यम् ऋषिम् अनुब्रुवते तेन तेषां प्रवरं प्रवृणीते ।
2.1.3.n.m: "He should announce [the descent] of the king with the ṛṣi-lineage of his purohita," so it is known; and for the Niṣādas and the Rathakāras, whichever ṛṣi they profess, with that he chooses their ancestral invocation.

2.1.3.o.s: tathā brāhmaṇānāṃ rājārpitānāṃ rājñāṃ vā brāhmaṇārpitānām /
2.1.3.o.d: तथा ब्राह्मणानां राजार्पितानां राज्ञां वा ब्राह्मणार्पितानाम् ।
2.1.3.o.m: Likewise for Brahmins belonging to a king, or kings belonging to a Brahmin.

2.1.3.p.m: For one belonging to two clans, he should indicate three [ancestors] from each clan.

2.1.3.q.m: Likewise, for one whose family connections are unknown, [he chooses] with the ancestral invocation of the purohita or with the ancestral invocation of the teacher.

2.1.3.r.s: kṛtsnam ekeṣāṃ pravaraṃ pratiṣidhya manuvat \\ ity eva vidadhāti /
2.1.3.r.d: कृत्स्नम् एकेषां प्रवरं प्रतिषिध्य मनुवत् \\ इत्य् एव विदधाति ।
2.1.3.r.m: In the view of some, having prohibited the entire ancestral invocation, he prescribes only "like Manu."

2.1.3.s.s: brahmaṇvad ā ca vakṣat \\ brāhmaṇā asya yajñasya prāvitāras \\ iti pravaraśeṣaḥ /
2.1.3.s.d: ब्रह्मण्वद् आ च वक्षत् \\ ब्राह्मणा अस्य यज्ञस्य प्रावितारस् \\ इति प्रवरशेषः ।
2.1.3.s.m: "Endowed with holy power, may he bring [them] here; the Brahmins are the protectors of this sacrifice"—this is the remainder of the ancestral invocation.

2.1.3.t.s: asau \\ iti hotur upām̐śu nāma gṛhṇāti /
2.1.3.t.d: असौ \\ इति होतुर् उपाम्̐शु नाम गृह्णाति ।
2.1.3.t.m: Saying, "so-and-so," he utters the name of the hotṛ inaudibly.

2.1.3.w.m: He drops the blade of grass onto the altar.

2.2.4.a.s: ājyabhāgayor āvāpe sviṣṭakṛti patnīsaṃyājeṣu ca yājyāpuronuvākye yājyaiva prayājānuyājeṣu /
2.2.4.a.d: आज्यभागयोर् आवापे स्विष्टकृति पत्नीसंयाजेषु च याज्यापुरोनुवाक्ये याज्यैव प्रयाजानुयाजेषु ।
2.2.4.a.m: At the insertion of the two clarified butter portions, at the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, and at the patnīsaṃyāja offerings, there are both an offering verse and an introductory verse; at the fore-offerings and after-offerings, there is only an offering verse.

2.2.4.b.m: In both kinds, the call and response and the direction for the offering verse [take place].

2.2.4.d.s: so 'dhvaryur nāpavyāharet purāśrāvaṇād āśrāvite 'gnīn nāpavyāharet purā pratyāśrāvaṇāt pratyāśrāvite 'dhvaryur nāpavyāharet purā yajeti vacanād yajety ukte hotā nāpavyāharet purā vaṣaṭkārāt /
2.2.4.d.d: सो ऽध्वर्युर् नापव्याहरेत् पुराश्रावणाद् आश्राविते ऽग्नीन् नापव्याहरेत् पुरा प्रत्याश्रावणात् प्रत्याश्राविते ऽध्वर्युर् नापव्याहरेत् पुरा यजेति वचनाद् यजेत्य् उक्ते होता नापव्याहरेत् पुरा वषट्कारात् ।
2.2.4.d.m: The adhvaryu must not speak amiss before the call; once the call is given, the agnīdh must not speak amiss before the response; once the response is given, the adhvaryu must not speak amiss before the utterance "Recite the offering verse"; when "Recite the offering verse" is said, the hotṛ must not speak amiss before the vaṣaṭ-call.

2.2.4.e.s: uttarataḥ puronuvākyām avadāsyann avadyann avatte vā saṃpreṣyati /
2.2.4.e.d: उत्तरतः पुरोनुवाक्याम् अवदास्यन्न् अवद्यन्न् अवत्ते वा संप्रेष्यति ।
2.2.4.e.m: Stationed to the north, about to cut off [portions], while cutting off, or when it has been cut off, he issues the direction for the introductory verse.

2.2.4.f.m: "Recite [the introductory verse] for so-and-so," according to the deity.

2.2.4.g.s: dakṣiṇato yājyām atyākramyāśrāvya pratyāśrāvite \\ amuṃ yaja \\ iti yathādevatam̐ saṃpreṣyati /
2.2.4.g.d: दक्षिणतो याज्याम् अत्याक्रम्याश्राव्य प्रत्याश्राविते \\ अमुं यज \\ इति यथादेवतम्̐ संप्रेष्यति ।
2.2.4.g.m: To the south, [the adhvaryu] directs [the hotṛ] for the offering verse: having stepped across, having called for recitation, when the call has been answered, 'Recite the offering verse for [deity] N.,' according to the deity.

2.2.4.h.s: vaṣaṭkārevaṣaṭkṛte vā juhoti yājyāpuronuvākyāvatīṣu caturavattaṃ pañcāvattaṃ vā /
2.2.4.h.d: वषट्कारेवषट्कृते वा जुहोति याज्यापुरोनुवाक्यावतीषु चतुरवत्तं पञ्चावत्तं वा ।
2.2.4.h.m: At the vaṣaṭ-call, or when the vaṣaṭ-call has been uttered, he offers the fourfold portion or the fivefold portion in the offerings provided with an offering verse and an introductory verse.

2.2.4.i.m: The portion is fivefold for descendants of Jamadagni; it is fourfold for other lineages.

2.2.4.j.s: apy ajāmadagnyo jāmadagnyam āmantrya pañcāvattaṃ kurvīta /
2.2.4.j.d: अप्य् अजामदग्न्यो जामदग्न्यम् आमन्त्र्य पञ्चावत्तं कुर्वीत ।
2.2.4.j.m: Even one who is not a descendant of Jamadagni may make the fivefold portion after consulting a descendant of Jamadagni.

2.2.4.k.m: The cut portions for the deities measure the joint of a thumb.

2.2.4.l.m: The subsequent ones are progressively thicker.

2.2.4.m.s: daivatebhyaḥ sauviṣṭakṛtāni sauviṣṭakṛtebhya aiḍāni tathā cāturdhākaraṇikāni /
2.2.4.m.d: दैवतेभ्यः सौविष्टकृतानि सौविष्टकृतेभ्य ऐडानि तथा चातुर्धाकरणिकानि ।
2.2.4.m.m: Those for the Sviṣṭakṛt offering are thicker than those for the deities; those for the Iḍā thicker than those for the Sviṣṭakṛt offering; likewise those for the fourfold division.

2.2.4.n.s: mām̐sasam̐hitābhyām aṅgulībhyām aṅguṣṭhena ca puroḍāśasyāvadyati sruveṇājyasāṃnāyyayor mekṣaṇena carūṇām /
2.2.4.n.d: माम्̐ससम्̐हिताभ्याम् अङ्गुलीभ्याम् अङ्गुष्ठेन च पुरोडाशस्यावद्यति स्रुवेणाज्यसांनाय्ययोर् मेक्षणेन चरूणाम् ।
2.2.4.n.m: He cuts off [the portion] of the sacrificial cake with the thumb and the two fingers that meet the flesh; [he cuts off the portion] of the clarified butter and the curd-and-milk oblation with the sruva-spoon; and of the mess of boiled rice with the stirring-stick.

2.2.4.o.s: madhyāt puroḍāśasyāvadāya pūrvārdhād avadyati paścārdhāt tṛtīyaṃ pañcāvattinaḥ /
2.2.4.o.d: मध्यात् पुरोडाशस्यावदाय पूर्वार्धाद् अवद्यति पश्चार्धात् तृतीयं पञ्चावत्तिनः ।
2.2.4.o.m: Having cut off from the middle of the sacrificial cake, he cuts off from the eastern half; a third from the western half for one who takes a fivefold portion.

2.2.4.p.m: For one born after [an inferior sibling], the last cut portion is first.

2.2.4.q.s: avadāya pūrvārdhe sruco nidadhyāt prathamaṃ jaghanyaṃ paścārdhe /
2.2.4.q.d: अवदाय पूर्वार्धे स्रुचो निदध्यात् प्रथमं जघन्यं पश्चार्धे ।
2.2.4.q.m: Having cut off, he should place the first in the eastern half of the offering ladle, and the last in the western half.

2.2.4.r.m: He should cut off the easternmost portions first for the eldest son or the son of an eldest wife,

2.2.5.b.m: He should cut off the westernmost portions first for the youngest son, the son of a youngest wife, or one born after [an inferior sibling].

2.2.5.c.m: In the case of the sacrificial cake and the curd-and-milk oblation, having made an under-layering with clarified butter and having cut off from the sacrificial oblation, he should pour clarified butter over it as the under-layering and over-pouring.

2.2.5.d.s: srucy upastīrya mā bhes \\ mā saṃvikthās \\ mā tvā him̐siṣaṃ \ mā te tejo 'pakramīt / \ bharatam uddharem anuṣiñca \\ avadānāni te pratyavadāsyāmi \ namas te astu \ mā mā him̐sīs \\ ity avadāsyan havir abhimṛśati /
2.2.5.d.d: स्रुच्य् उपस्तीर्य मा भेस् \\ मा संविक्थास् \\ मा त्वा हिम्̐सिषं \ मा ते तेजो ऽपक्रमीत् । \ भरतम् उद्धरेम् अनुषिञ्च \\ अवदानानि ते प्रत्यवदास्यामि \ नमस् ते अस्तु \ मा मा हिम्̐सीस् \\ इत्य् अवदास्यन् हविर् अभिमृशति ।
2.2.5.d.m: Having made an under-layering in the offering ladle, about to cut off, he touches the sacrificial oblation with: 'Fear not; tremble not; let me not injure you; let not your fiery energy depart. O Bharata, pour after the portion lifted out; I will cut portions of you; reverence be to you; do not injure me.'

2.2.5.e.s: avadāyābhighārya yad avadānāni te 'vadyan \ vilomākārṣam ātmanaḥ / \ ājyena pratyanajmy enat \ tat ta āpyāyatāṃ punar iti haviḥ pratyabhighārayati /
2.2.5.e.d: अवदायाभिघार्य यद् अवदानानि ते ऽवद्यन् \ विलोमाकार्षम् आत्मनः । \ आज्येन प्रत्यनज्म्य् एनत् \ तत् त आप्यायतां पुनर् इति हविः प्रत्यभिघारयति ।
2.2.5.e.m: Having cut off and poured over, he pours [clarified butter] back over the sacrificial oblation with: 'Whatever portions of you, cutting off, I have made contrary to myself, that I anoint again with clarified butter; let that swell again for you.'

2.2.5.f.m: It is taught in the Brāhmaṇa: 'Cutting off portion after portion, he anoints the prastara-bunch and the barhis-grass.'

2.2.5.g.s: apidadhad ivāprakṣṇan puroḍāśāhutiṃ juhoty ājyam̐ hutvāvadānaṃ juhoty ājyenāntato 'nvavasrāvayati /
2.2.5.g.d: अपिदधद् इवाप्रक्ष्णन् पुरोडाशाहुतिं जुहोत्य् आज्यम्̐ हुत्वावदानं जुहोत्य् आज्येनान्ततो ऽन्ववस्रावयति ।
2.2.5.g.m: As if covering [it], without breaking [it], he offers the oblation of sacrificial cake; having offered clarified butter, he offers the cut portion; at the end, he causes [the residue] to trickle down with clarified butter.

2.2.5.h.m: He causes the others to trickle through the spout.

2.2.5.i.m: He offers each preceding insertion-offering connected [with the previous one].

2.2.5.j.m: He offers along with it the ladle-libation.

2.2.5.k.s: pravaraṃ pravṛtya ghṛtavatīm adhvaryo srucam āsyasva \\ ity ucyamāne juhūpabhṛtāv ādāya sakṛdatikrāntaḥ pañca prayājān yajaty abhikrāmaṃ samānatra vā tiṣṭhan /
2.2.5.k.d: प्रवरं प्रवृत्य घृतवतीम् अध्वर्यो स्रुचम् आस्यस्व \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने जुहूपभृताव् आदाय सकृदतिक्रान्तः पञ्च प्रयाजान् यजत्य् अभिक्रामं समानत्र वा तिष्ठन् ।
2.2.5.k.m: Having chosen the ancestral invocation, while it is being said, 'O adhvaryu, fill the ghee-laden offering ladle,' he takes the juhū ladle and the upabhṛt ladle, steps across once, and standing or stepping forward at the same place, performs the five fore-offerings.

2.2.5.m.s: samidho yaja \\ iti prathamaṃ prayājam̐ saṃpreṣyati yaja yaja ity uttarān /
2.2.5.m.d: समिधो यज \\ इति प्रथमं प्रयाजम्̐ संप्रेष्यति यज यज इत्य् उत्तरान् ।
2.2.5.m.m: He directs for the first fore-offering: 'Recite the offering verse for the Samidhs,' and for the subsequent ones: 'Recite the offering verse, recite the offering verse.'

2.2.5.n.s: samidhaḥ purastād yajati tanūnapātaṃ dakṣiṇata iḍaḥ paścād argham aupabhṛtasya juhvām ānīya barhir uttarato yajati svāhākāraṃ madhye 'pareṇa vāghārasaṃbhedaṃ pūrvaṃpūrvam̐ sam̐hitam̐ samānatra vā sarvān /
2.2.5.n.d: समिधः पुरस्ताद् यजति तनूनपातं दक्षिणत इडः पश्चाद् अर्घम् औपभृतस्य जुह्वाम् आनीय बर्हिर् उत्तरतो यजति स्वाहाकारं मध्ये ऽपरेण वाघारसंभेदं पूर्वंपूर्वम्̐ सम्̐हितम्̐ समानत्र वा सर्वान् ।
2.2.5.n.m: He offers the Samidhs in front, Tanūnapāt in the south, the Iḍs in the west; having poured half of what is in the upabhṛt ladle into the juhū ladle, he offers the Barhis in the north, and the Svāhā-call in the middle, or to the west of the junction of the continuous libations, each preceding one connected, or all in the same place.

2.2.5.o.m: Having stepped back across, he pours the residue of the fore-offering over the sacrificial oblations,

2.2.5.p.m: as they are presented in regular order.

2.2.5.q.m: Having poured over the dhruvā ladle, he pours over the oblation destined for Agni, and finally over the upabhṛt ladle.

2.2.5.r.m: He proceeds with the two clarified butter portions, which are oblations of clarified butter.

2.2.5.s.s: tau prabāhug jyotiṣmaty uttarārdhe 'gnaye juhoti dakṣiṇārdhe somāya /
2.2.5.s.d: तौ प्रबाहुग् ज्योतिष्मत्य् उत्तरार्धे ऽग्नये जुहोति दक्षिणार्धे सोमाय ।
2.2.5.s.m: Side by side, he offers them in the blazing [fire]: to Agni in the northern half, to Soma in the southern half.

2.2.5.t.m: Between the two, he offers the other oblations.

2.2.6.a.s: ājyabhāgau prati srucāv ādatte na nidadhāty ā sviṣṭakṛtaḥ /
2.2.6.a.d: आज्यभागौ प्रति स्रुचाव् आदत्ते न निदधात्य् आ स्विष्टकृतः ।
2.2.6.a.m: For the two clarified butter portions, he takes up the two offering ladles; he does not set them down until the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

2.2.6.b.m: Having proceeded with the sacrificial cake for Agni, he proceeds with the inaudible offering, which is an oblation of clarified butter.

2.2.6.c.m: In its case, the calling for recitation and answering, the ritual direction for the offering verse and introductory verse, and the vaṣaṭ-call are loud.

2.2.6.e.m: He proceeds with the subsequent sacrificial cake according to the deity.

2.2.6.f.s: samavadāya sāṃnāyyābhyāṃ pracarati dviḥ śṛtasyāvadyati dvir dadhnas triḥ pañcāvattinaḥ /
2.2.6.f.d: समवदाय सांनाय्याभ्यां प्रचरति द्विः शृतस्यावद्यति द्विर् दध्नस् त्रिः पञ्चावत्तिनः ।
2.2.6.f.m: Having cut off the portions together, he proceeds with the two curd-and-milk oblations; he cuts twice from the boiled milk, twice from the sour curd; three times for one who takes a fivefold portion.

2.2.6.g.m: Having cut off the portions together, he proceeds with the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

2.2.6.h.s: yad anupūrvāṇi pradīyante sarvebhya uttarārdhebhyaḥ sakṛtsakṛd avadyati /
2.2.6.h.d: यद् अनुपूर्वाणि प्रदीयन्ते सर्वेभ्य उत्तरार्धेभ्यः सकृत्सकृद् अवद्यति ।
2.2.6.h.m: As they are presented in regular order, he cuts off once from each of their northern halves;

2.2.6.j.m: He pours over twice; he does not pour back over the remnants of the sacrificial oblation.

2.2.6.k.m: He offers [it] in the north-eastern part, unconnected with the other oblations.

2.2.6.l.s: pratyākramya srucam adbhiḥ pūrayitvā vaiśvānare havir idaṃ juhomi \ sāhasram utsam̐ śatadhāram etam / \ tasminn eṣa pitaraṃ pitāmaham \\ prapitāmaham̐ svarge loke bibharat pinvamānas \\ iti madhyamaṃ paridhiṃ pradakṣiṇam anu pariṣiñcati //
2.2.6.l.d: प्रत्याक्रम्य स्रुचम् अद्भिः पूरयित्वा वैश्वानरे हविर् इदं जुहोमि \ साहस्रम् उत्सम्̐ शतधारम् एतम् । \ तस्मिन्न् एष पितरं पितामहम् \\ प्रपितामहम्̐ स्वर्गे लोके बिभरत् पिन्वमानस् \\ इति मध्यमं परिधिं प्रदक्षिणम् अनु परिषिञ्चति ॥
2.2.6.l.m: Having stepped back across, having filled the offering ladle with water, he sprinkles clockwise around the middle enclosing-stick with: 'I offer this oblation into Vaiśvānara, this fountain of a thousand streams, of a hundred streams; in it, this father, grandfather, and great-grandfather, maintaining them in the heavenly world, overflowing.'

2.3.7.a.s: sādayitvā srucāv āgneyaṃ prāñcaṃ virujyāṅguṣṭhenopamadhyamayā cāṅgulyājyāyo yavāmātrāt \\ āvyādhāt kṛtyatām idam / \ mā rūrupāma yajñasya \ śuddham̐ sviṣṭam idam̐ havis \\ ity anumṛśya yavamātraṃ pippalamātraṃ vā prāśitram avadyati /
2.3.7.a.d: सादयित्वा स्रुचाव् आग्नेयं प्राञ्चं विरुज्याङ्गुष्ठेनोपमध्यमया चाङ्गुल्याज्यायो यवामात्रात् \\ आव्याधात् कृत्यताम् इदम् । \ मा रूरुपाम यज्ञस्य \ शुद्धम्̐ स्विष्टम् इदम्̐ हविस् \\ इत्य् अनुमृश्य यवमात्रं पिप्पलमात्रं वा प्राशित्रम् अवद्यति ।
2.3.7.a.m: Having set down the two offering ladles, having broken off the front part of the [sacrificial cake] for Agni toward the east with the thumb and the fourth finger, after touching it with: 'From clarified butter, from barley size, let this be cut from the pierceable part; let us not harm the sacrifice; this sacrificial oblation is pure and well-sacrificed,' he cuts off the prāśitra portion of the size of a barley corn or a pippala berry.

2.3.7.c.m: Having made an under-layering in the vessel for holding the prāśitra, and having cut [the portion], he pours clarified butter over it.

2.3.7.d.s: upastṛṇīyād abhi ca ghārayed ity ekeṣām /
2.3.7.d.d: उपस्तृणीयाद् अभि च घारयेद् इत्य् एकेषाम् ।
2.3.7.d.m: According to some teachers, he should make an under-layering and pour over.

2.3.7.e.m: According to some teachers, he cuts the prāśitra portion only from the cake for Agni.

2.3.7.g.s: iḍāpātram upastīryeḍām̐ samavadyati caturavattāṃ pañcāvattāṃ vā sviṣṭakṛtānupūrvyaṃ vyākhyātam /
2.3.7.g.d: इडापात्रम् उपस्तीर्येडाम्̐ समवद्यति चतुरवत्तां पञ्चावत्तां वा स्विष्टकृतानुपूर्व्यं व्याख्यातम् ।
2.3.7.g.m: having made an under-layering in the Iḍā vessel, he cuts off the Iḍā together, fourfold or fivefold; the order of the Sviṣṭakṛt offering has been explained.

2.3.7.h.s: manunā dṛṣṭāṃ ghṛtapadīm \\ mitrāvaruṇasamīritām / \ dakṣiṇārdhād asaṃbhindan \\ avadyāmy ekatomukhām iti dakṣiṇārdhāt puroḍāśasya pūrvam iḍāvadānam avadyati /
2.3.7.h.d: मनुना दृष्टां घृतपदीम् \\ मित्रावरुणसमीरिताम् । \ दक्षिणार्धाद् असंभिन्दन् \\ अवद्याम्य् एकतोमुखाम् इति दक्षिणार्धात् पुरोडाशस्य पूर्वम् इडावदानम् अवद्यति ।
2.3.7.h.m: With: 'Seen by Manu, ghee-footed, impelled by Mitra and Varuṇa, from the southern half, without dividing it, I cut off [the portion] having one opening,' he cuts the first Iḍā-portion from the southern half of the sacrificial cake.

2.3.7.i.m: From the eastern half, he cuts the portion for the sacrificer, thin, as it were, and long.

2.3.7.j.m: Having gratified it with clarified butter, having brought it near from the dhruvā ladle,

2.3.7.l.m: A third [cut portion] from the western half in the case of the fivefold portion.

2.3.7.m.m: Having poured clarified butter over it, he places the Iḍā in the hand of the hotṛ.

2.3.7.o.s: anutsṛjann eva hoteḍayādhvaryuṃ parigṛhṇāti yadi hotre prattā bhavati /
2.3.7.o.d: अनुत्सृजन्न् एव होतेडयाध्वर्युं परिगृह्णाति यदि होत्रे प्रत्ता भवति ।
2.3.7.o.m: Without letting go, the hotṛ embraces the adhvaryu with the Iḍā, if it has been handed over to the hotṛ.

2.3.7.p.s: agreṇa hotāraṃ dakṣiṇātikramya paścāt prāṅ āsīno hotur aṅguliparvaṇī anakti /
2.3.7.p.d: अग्रेण होतारं दक्षिणातिक्रम्य पश्चात् प्राङ् आसीनो होतुर् अङ्गुलिपर्वणी अनक्ति ।
2.3.7.p.m: Having stepped past the hotṛ in front towards the south, seated behind facing east, he anoints the finger-joints of the hotṛ.

2.3.7.r.m: Having smelled it, he touches water.

2.3.7.s.s: yathetaṃ pratyetya purastāt pratyaṅṅ āsīno dakṣiṇe hotuḥ pāṇāv iḍāyā avāntareḍām avadyati /
2.3.7.s.d: यथेतं प्रत्येत्य पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ्ङ् आसीनो दक्षिणे होतुः पाणाव् इडाया अवान्तरेडाम् अवद्यति ।
2.3.7.s.m: Returning the way he came and sitting facing west in front, he cuts off the intermediary iḍā from the iḍā into the hotṛ's right hand.

2.3.7.w.m: While the iḍā is being invoked, the adhvaryu, the āgnīdhra,

2.3.8.a.m: and the sacrificer touch [it] from behind.

2.3.8.b.s: daivyā adhvaryava upahūtās \\ ity ucyamāne \\ upahūtaḥ paśumān asāni \\ iti japati /
2.3.8.b.d: दैव्या अध्वर्यव उपहूतास् \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने \\ उपहूतः पशुमान् असानि \\ इति जपति ।
2.3.8.b.m: When [the phrase], “The divine adhvaryus are invoked,” is spoken, he mutters: “Invoked, may I possess cattle.”

2.3.8.c.m: When it has been invoked, he carries the prāśitra portion around in front of the āhavanīya fire to the brahman.

2.3.8.e.s: iḍāsi \ syonāsi syonakṛt \ sā no rāyaspoṣe suprajāstve dhāḥ / \ mukhasya tvā dyumnāya surabhyāsyatvāya prāśnāmi \\ ity upahūtām ṛtvijaḥ prāśnanti yajamānapañcamāḥ /
2.3.8.e.d: इडासि \ स्योनासि स्योनकृत् \ सा नो रायस्पोषे सुप्रजास्त्वे धाः । \ मुखस्य त्वा द्युम्नाय सुरभ्यास्यत्वाय प्राश्नामि \\ इत्य् उपहूताम् ऋत्विजः प्राश्नन्ति यजमानपञ्चमाः ।
2.3.8.e.m: the priests, with the sacrificer as the fifth, consume the invoked [iḍā] with: “You are Iḍā; you are pleasant; you make pleasant; may you establish us in increase of wealth and good offspring; for splendor of the mouth, for fragrance of the mouth, I eat you.”

2.3.8.f.m: They remain restrained in speech until the cleansing.

2.3.8.g.s: mano jyotir jupatām ity antarvedi pavitravati mārjayante /
2.3.8.g.d: मनो ज्योतिर् जुपताम् इत्य् अन्तर्वेदि पवित्रवति मार्जयन्ते ।
2.3.8.g.m: With: “May mind delight in the light,” they cleanse themselves inside the altar where there are strainers.

2.3.8.h.m: Having broken the [cake] for Agni into four, he places it on the sacrificial grass.

2.3.8.i.s: tasminn ādiśyamāne \\ idaṃ yajamānasya \\ iti yajamānabhāgam ādiśati /
2.3.8.i.d: तस्मिन्न् आदिश्यमाने \\ इदं यजमानस्य \\ इति यजमानभागम् आदिशति ।
2.3.8.i.m: While it is being assigned, he assigns the sacrificer's portion with: “This is the sacrificer's.”

2.3.8.j.m: Of what has been assigned, he prepares the thickest [part] as a six-cut portion for the agnīdh.

2.3.8.k.m: Having under-layered, cut off, and basted, he cuts off [again] in the same manner.

2.3.8.l.s: divo bhāgo 'si \\ agner āgnīdhram asi \\ agneḥ śāmitram asi \\ agnes tvāsyena prāśnāmi \ namas te astu \ mā mā him̐sīs \\ ity āgnīdhraḥ prāśnāti /
2.3.8.l.d: दिवो भागो ऽसि \\ अग्नेर् आग्नीध्रम् असि \\ अग्नेः शामित्रम् असि \\ अग्नेस् त्वास्येन प्राश्नामि \ नमस् ते अस्तु \ मा मा हिम्̐सीस् \\ इत्य् आग्नीध्रः प्राश्नाति ।
2.3.8.l.m: The āgnīdhra consumes it with: “You are the share of heaven; you are the āgnīdhra [portion] of Agni; you are the śāmitra [portion] of Agni; with Agni's mouth I eat you; homage be to you; do not harm me.”

2.3.8.m.m: He carries around the portions of the brahman and the sacrificer with the veda-broom.

2.3.8.n.m: With another vessel to the hotṛ, with another to the adhvaryu.

2.3.8.o.s: pṛthivyai bhāgo 'si \\ iti hotā prāśnāti \\ antarikṣasya bhāge 'si \\ ity adhvaryus \\ divo bhāgo 'si \\ iti brahmā /
2.3.8.o.d: पृथिव्यै भागो ऽसि \\ इति होता प्राश्नाति \\ अन्तरिक्षस्य भागे ऽसि \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युस् \\ दिवो भागो ऽसि \\ इति ब्रह्मा ।
2.3.8.o.m: The hotṛ consumes [his] with: “You are the share of the earth”; the adhvaryu with: “You are the share of the atmosphere”; the brahman with: “You are the share of heaven.”
