2.3.8.p.s: mahān aparimito 'nvāhāryo dakṣiṇāgnāv odanaḥ pakvas tam abhighāryānabhighārya vāntarvedy āsādayati /
2.3.8.p.d: महान् अपरिमितो ऽन्वाहार्यो दक्षिणाग्नाव् ओदनः पक्वस् तम् अभिघार्यानभिघार्य वान्तर्वेद्य् आसादयति ।
2.3.8.p.m: A large, unmeasured anvāhārya cooked rice is cooked on the dakṣiṇāgni fire; having basted it or without basting it, he sets it down inside the altar.

2.3.8.q.m: He gives the ritual direction: “Bring [it] near to those who sit on the south.”

2.3.8.r.s: dakṣiṇata eta \\ iti yajamānenocyamāne yathāsaṃpraiṣaṃ kurvanti /
2.3.8.r.d: दक्षिणत एत \\ इति यजमानेनोच्यमाने यथासंप्रैषं कुर्वन्ति ।
2.3.8.r.m: When it is said by the sacrificer: “Go from the south,” they act according to the ritual direction.

2.3.8.s.m: Having accepted the anvāhārya [rice], they return.

2.3.8.u.m: having thrown [back] the two firebrands intended for the after-offerings,

2.3.8.v.s: brahman prasthāsyāmas \\ samidham ādhāyāgnīt paridhīm̐ś cāgniṃ ca sakṛtsakṛt saṃmṛḍḍhi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
2.3.8.v.d: ब्रह्मन् प्रस्थास्यामस् \\ समिधम् आधायाग्नीत् परिधीम्̐श् चाग्निं च सकृत्सकृत् संमृड्ढि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
2.3.8.v.m: he gives the ritual direction: “O brahman, we shall set forth; having placed the firewood, O agnīdh, cleanse the enclosing-sticks and the fire once each.”

2.3.8.w.s: eṣā te agne samit \ tayā vardhasva cā ca pyāyasva / \ vardhattāṃ ca te yajñapatir ā ca pyāyatām̐ svāhā \\ ity āgīdhraḥ samidham ādhāyāsphyair idhmasaṃnahanair aparikrāman paridhīn saṃmārṣṭi madhyamam udañcaṃ prāñcāv itarau /
2.3.8.w.d: एषा ते अग्ने समित् \ तया वर्धस्व चा च प्यायस्व । \ वर्धत्तां च ते यज्ञपतिर् आ च प्यायताम्̐ स्वाहा \\ इत्य् आगीध्रः समिधम् आधायास्फ्यैर् इध्मसंनहनैर् अपरिक्रामन् परिधीन् संमार्ष्टि मध्यमम् उदञ्चं प्राञ्चाव् इतरौ ।
2.3.8.w.m: With: “This is your firewood, O Agni; grow with it and thrive; and may the lord of the sacrifice grow and thrive, svāhā,” the āgnīdhra, having placed the firewood, without walking around, cleanses the enclosing-sticks with the cord of the firewood-bundle, not using the sphya: the middle one towards the north, the other two towards the east.

2.3.8.x.s: agne vājajid vājaṃ tvā sasṛvām̐sam iti mantram̐ saṃnamati /
2.3.8.x.d: अग्ने वाजजिद् वाजं त्वा ससृवाम्̐सम् इति मन्त्रम्̐ संनमति ।
2.3.8.x.m: He adapts the mantra: “O Agni, winner of the prize, having run for the prize…”

2.3.8.y.s: yo bhūtānām adhipatis \\ rudras tanticaro yuvā / \ paśūn asmākaṃ mā him̐sīr \ etad astu hutaṃ tava svāhā \\ iti saṃmārgān abhyukṣyāhavanīye praharati /
2.3.8.y.d: यो भूतानाम् अधिपतिस् \\ रुद्रस् तन्तिचरो युवा । \ पशून् अस्माकं मा हिम्̐सीर् \ एतद् अस्तु हुतं तव स्वाहा \\ इति संमार्गान् अभ्युक्ष्याहवनीये प्रहरति ।
2.3.8.y.m: Having sprinkled the sweepings with water, he throws them into the āhavanīya fire with: “He who is the overlord of beings, Rudra, the wanderer of the herd, the youth, do not harm our cattle; let this be offered to you, svāhā.”

2.3.8.z.m: He may cast [them] away on the rubbish heap, in the hall, or in the thatch.

2.3.8.aa.m: Or he may carry [them] beyond the cow-pen or beyond the pasture.

2.4.9.a.s: yad upabhṛty ājyaṃ taj juhvām ānīya tena sakṛdatikrāntas trīn anūyājān yajati /
2.4.9.a.d: यद् उपभृत्य् आज्यं तज् जुह्वाम् आनीय तेन सकृदतिक्रान्तस् त्रीन् अनूयाजान् यजति ।
2.4.9.a.m: Having poured into the juhū the clarified butter that is in the upabhṛt, having stepped across once, he offers the three after-offerings with it.

2.4.9.b.s: devān yaja \\ iti prathamam anūyājam̐ saṃpreṣyati yaja yaja \\ ity uttarau /
2.4.9.b.d: देवान् यज \\ इति प्रथमम् अनूयाजम्̐ संप्रेष्यति यज यज \\ इत्य् उत्तरौ ।
2.4.9.b.m: He gives the ritual direction for the first after-offering: “Worship the gods”; for the next two: “Worship; worship.”

2.4.9.c.m: In front of the intersection of the two continuous butter-flows, he offers on the firewood progressively further west.

2.4.9.d.s: prāñcam uttamaṃ dīrgham̐ saṃtataṃ tenetarāv anusaṃbhinatti /
2.4.9.d.d: प्राञ्चम् उत्तमं दीर्घम्̐ संततं तेनेतराव् अनुसंभिनत्ति ।
2.4.9.d.m: He makes the last one eastward, long, and continuous, and with it he intersects the other two.

2.4.9.e.m: Having stepped back and set down the two offering ladles in their proper places,

2.4.9.f.m: he separates them with the two [mantras] containing the word ‘vāja’ [prize].

2.4.9.g.s: vājasya mā prasavena \\ iti dakṣiṇenottānena saprastarāṃ juhūm udgṛhṇāti \\ athā sapatnām̐ indro me \\ iti nīcā savyenopabhṛtaṃ nigṛhṇāti \\ udgrābhaṃ ca \\ iti juhūm udgṛhṇāti nigrābhaṃ ca \\ ity upabhṛtaṃ nigṛhṇāti brahma devā avīvṛdhan \\ iti dakṣiṇenottānena prācīṃ juhūṃ prohati \\ athā sapatnān indrāgnī me \\ iti nīcā savyenopabhṛtaṃ pratīcīṃ bahirvedi nirasyati /
2.4.9.g.d: वाजस्य मा प्रसवेन \\ इति दक्षिणेनोत्तानेन सप्रस्तरां जुहूम् उद्गृह्णाति \\ अथा सपत्नाम्̐ इन्द्रो मे \\ इति नीचा सव्येनोपभृतं निगृह्णाति \\ उद्ग्राभं च \\ इति जुहूम् उद्गृह्णाति निग्राभं च \\ इत्य् उपभृतं निगृह्णाति ब्रह्म देवा अवीवृधन् \\ इति दक्षिणेनोत्तानेन प्राचीं जुहूं प्रोहति \\ अथा सपत्नान् इन्द्राग्नी मे \\ इति नीचा सव्येनोपभृतं प्रतीचीं बहिर्वेदि निरस्यति ।
2.4.9.g.m: With: “At the impulse of the prize…” he raises the juhū along with the prastara bunch with his right hand turned upwards; with: “Now my rivals, Indra…” he presses down the upabhṛt with his left hand turned downwards; with: “The uplifting…” he raises the juhū; with: “And the pressing down…” he presses down the upabhṛt; with: “The gods have magnified the brahman…” he pushes forward the juhū to the east with his right hand turned upwards; with: “Now the rivals, Indra and Agni, for me…” he casts the upabhṛt away to the west outside the altar with his left hand turned downwards.

2.4.9.h.s: devas tam̐ savitā pratinudatu yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmas \\ iti vā /
2.4.9.h.d: देवस् तम्̐ सविता प्रतिनुदतु यो ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मस् \\ इति वा ।
2.4.9.h.m: Or with: “May god Savitṛ thrust back him who hates us and whom we hate.”

2.4.9.i.m: Having sprinkled and brought back the upabhṛt, he anoints the enclosing-sticks with the juhū.

2.4.9.j.s: vasubhyas tvā \\ iti madhyamam \\ rudrebhyas tvā \\ iti dakiṣṇārdhyam ādityebhyas tvā \\ ity uttarārdhyam \\ vasur asi \ vasuvanir asi \ vasudheyo 'si \\ iti vā /
2.4.9.j.d: वसुभ्यस् त्वा \\ इति मध्यमम् \\ रुद्रेभ्यस् त्वा \\ इति दकिष्णार्ध्यम् आदित्येभ्यस् त्वा \\ इत्य् उत्तरार्ध्यम् \\ वसुर् असि \ वसुवनिर् असि \ वसुधेयो ऽसि \\ इति वा ।
2.4.9.j.m: The middle one with: “Thee for the Vasus”; the southern one with: “Thee for the Rudras”; the northern one with: “Thee for the Ādityas”; or with: “You are Vasu; you are the winner of wealth; you are the bestower of wealth.”

2.4.9.k.s: anyatra prastarāj juhūm̐ sādayitvā saṃjānāthāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī \ mitrāvaruṇau tvā vṛṣṭyāvatām iti vidhṛtībhyāṃ prastaram̐ samullipya barhiṣi vidhṛtī apisṛjya /
2.4.9.k.d: अन्यत्र प्रस्तराज् जुहूम्̐ सादयित्वा संजानाथां द्यावापृथिवी \ मित्रावरुणौ त्वा वृष्ट्यावताम् इति विधृतीभ्यां प्रस्तरम्̐ समुल्लिप्य बर्हिषि विधृती अपिसृज्य ।
2.4.9.k.m: Having placed the juhū elsewhere than on the prastara bunch, having smeared the prastara bunch with the two separating blades of grass with: “Do you two agree, O Heaven and Earth; may Mitra and Varuṇa protect you with rain,” and having thrown the two separating blades of grass onto the sacrificial grass,

2.4.9.l.s: srukṣu prastaram anakti \\ aktam̐ rihāṇās \\ iti juhvām agrāṇi viyantu vayas \\ ity upabhṛti madhyāni prajāṃ yonis \\ iti dhruvāyāṃ mūlāni /
2.4.9.l.d: स्रुक्षु प्रस्तरम् अनक्ति \\ अक्तम्̐ रिहाणास् \\ इति जुह्वाम् अग्राणि वियन्तु वयस् \\ इत्य् उपभृति मध्यानि प्रजां योनिस् \\ इति ध्रुवायां मूलानि ।
2.4.9.l.m: he anoints the prastara bunch in the offering ladles: the tips in the juhū with: “Licking the anointed…”; the middles in the upabhṛt with: “May the birds disperse…”; the roots in the dhruvā with: “Progeny, the womb…”

2.4.9.n.s: tṛtīye dhruvāyām ādito mūlāny upabhṛti madhyāni juhvām antato 'grāṇi /
2.4.9.n.d: तृतीये ध्रुवायाम् आदितो मूलान्य् उपभृति मध्यानि जुह्वाम् अन्ततो ऽग्राणि ।
2.4.9.n.m: At the third [time], the roots first in the dhruvā, the middles in the upabhṛt, and finally the tips in the juhū.

2.4.9.o.s: divy aṅkṣva \\ antarikṣe 'ṅkṣva \ pṛthivyām aṅkṣva \\ iti vā /
2.4.9.o.d: दिव्य् अङ्क्ष्व \\ अन्तरिक्षे ऽङ्क्ष्व \ पृथिव्याम् अङ्क्ष्व \\ इति वा ।
2.4.9.o.m: Or with: “Be anointed in heaven; be anointed in the atmosphere; be anointed on earth.”

2.4.9.p.s: āyuṣe tvā \\ ity aktasya tṛṇam apādāya prajñātaṃ nidhāya /
2.4.9.p.d: आयुषे त्वा \\ इत्य् अक्तस्य तृणम् अपादाय प्रज्ञातं निधाय ।
2.4.9.p.m: Having taken a blade of the anointed [prastara bunch] with: “Thee for life,” and having placed it recognizably,

2.4.9.q.m: having taken the prastara bunch and the branch,

2.4.9.r.m: having brought them down along the northern joint of the enclosing-sticks,

2.4.9.s.m: having called for response and the response having been given,

2.4.10.a.s: iṣitā daivyā hotāro bhadravācyāya preṣito mānuṣaḥ sūktavākāya \ sūktā brūhi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati sūktavākam̐ hotā pratipadyate /
2.4.10.a.d: इषिता दैव्या होतारो भद्रवाच्याय प्रेषितो मानुषः सूक्तवाकाय \ सूक्ता ब्रूहि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति सूक्तवाकम्̐ होता प्रतिपद्यते ।
2.4.10.a.m: he gives the ritual direction: “The divine hotṛs are sent for auspicious speech, the human [hotṛ] is directed for the recitation of the hymn; utter the hymns”; the hotṛ begins the recitation of the hymn.

2.4.10.b.s: āpyāyantām āpa oṣadhayas \\ ity adhvaryuḥ prastaram̐ śākhāṃ cānu praharati /
2.4.10.b.d: आप्यायन्ताम् आप ओषधयस् \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युः प्रस्तरम्̐ शाखां चानु प्रहरति ।
2.4.10.b.m: With: “May the waters, the plants swell,” the adhvaryu throws the prastara bunch and the branch into [the fire].

2.4.10.c.s: aktaṃ devānām̐ rihantu rihāvyantu vayām̐si \ vaśā pṛśnir bhūtvā divaṃ gaccha \\ iti vā /
2.4.10.c.d: अक्तं देवानाम्̐ रिहन्तु रिहाव्यन्तु वयाम्̐सि \ वशा पृश्निर् भूत्वा दिवं गच्छ \\ इति वा ।
2.4.10.c.m: Or with: “May the anointed of the gods lick… may the birds disperse… becoming a spotted cow, go to heaven.”

2.4.10.d.s: nātyagram anudagram apratiśṛṇann agram ajihmam iva hastaṃ dhārayan /
2.4.10.d.d: नात्यग्रम् अनुदग्रम् अप्रतिशृणन्न् अग्रम् अजिह्मम् इव हस्तं धारयन् ।
2.4.10.d.m: Holding his hand neither too high at the tip nor turned upwards, not breaking off the tip, as it were straight,

2.4.10.e.m: dragging it, as it were, facing downwards, he turns it around at the end.

2.4.10.f.s: āśāste 'yaṃ yajamāno 'sau \\ ity ucyamāne 'pisṛjya prastaram agnīd gamaya \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
2.4.10.f.d: आशास्ते ऽयं यजमानो ऽसौ \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने ऽपिसृज्य प्रस्तरम् अग्नीद् गमय \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
2.4.10.f.m: When [the phrase], “This sacrificer, N.N., prays…” is being uttered, having thrown the prastara bunch [into the fire], he gives the ritual direction: “O agnīdh, make [it] go [to heaven].”

2.4.10.g.m: With folded hands, the āgnīdhra tosses the prastara bunch upwards three times.

2.4.10.h.s: anuprahara \\ iti saṃpreṣyati svagā tanubhyaḥ svāhā \\ iti prastarasya tṛṇam apāttam āgnīdhro 'nupraharati /
2.4.10.h.d: अनुप्रहर \\ इति संप्रेष्यति स्वगा तनुभ्यः स्वाहा \\ इति प्रस्तरस्य तृणम् अपात्तम् आग्नीध्रो ऽनुप्रहरति ।
2.4.10.h.m: "Cast it [into the fire]!"—he gives the direction. With "Svagā to the bodies, svāhā!", the āgnīdhra casts into the fire the grass taken from the prastara.

2.4.10.i.m: With "This, this!", he points along thrice with his finger.

2.4.10.j.s: āyuṣpā agne 'si \\ āyur me pāhi \\ iti yathārūpaṃ prāṇāyatanāni saṃmṛśati /
2.4.10.j.d: आयुष्पा अग्ने ऽसि \\ आयुर् मे पाहि \\ इति यथारूपं प्राणायतनानि संमृशति ।
2.4.10.j.m: With "O Agni, you are the protector of life; protect my life!", he touches his vital organs in proper order.

2.4.10.k.m: With "You are firm (dhruvā)", he touches this [earth].

2.4.10.m.m: "Has it gone, O Agnīdh?"—the adhvaryu asks.

2.4.10.o.s: śrāvaya \\ ity adhvaryuḥ śrauṣaṭ \\ ity āgnīdhraḥ /
2.4.10.o.d: श्रावय \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युः श्रौषट् \\ इत्य् आग्नीध्रः ।
2.4.10.o.m: "Cause [him] to hear!" [says] the adhvaryu. "Śrauṣaṭ!" [responds] the āgnīdhra.

2.4.10.p.s: madhyamaṃ paridhim anvārabhya svagā daivyā hotṛbhyas \ svastir mānuṣebhyas \\ śaṃyor brūhi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
2.4.10.p.d: मध्यमं परिधिम् अन्वारभ्य स्वगा दैव्या होतृभ्यस् \ स्वस्तिर् मानुषेभ्यस् \\ शंयोर् ब्रूहि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
2.4.10.p.m: Touching the middle enclosing stick, he gives the ritual direction: "Svagā to the divine hotṛs! Welfare to the humans! Recite the Śaṃyu-formula!"

2.4.10.q.m: The hotṛ commences the Śaṃyuvāka recitation.

2.4.10.r.m: The adhvaryu casts the enclosing sticks into the fire:

2.4.10.s.m: the middle one with "The enclosing stick which...";

2.4.10.t.m: the other two with "To the food of sacrifice, well-gathered...".

2.4.10.u.m: He pushes the downward tip of the northern [stick] onto the burning coals.

2.4.10.v.m: With "Extend the sacrificer!", he follows all of them with the mantra.

2.4.10.w.s: juhvā bila upabhṛto 'gram avadhāya sam̐srāvabhāgāḥ stha \\ iti srucau prasrāvayati /
2.4.10.w.d: जुह्वा बिल उपभृतो ऽग्रम् अवधाय सम्̐स्रावभागाः स्थ \\ इति स्रुचौ प्रस्रावयति ।
2.4.10.w.m: Having placed the tip of the upabhṛt into the bowl of the juhū, with "You are the shares of the tricklings", he causes the two offering ladles to drain out [into the fire].

2.4.10.x.m: When the Śaṃyuvāka has been recited, they consume the remnants of the oblation,

2.5.11.a.s: juhūpabhṛtāv adhvaryur ādatte vedam̐ hotā sasruvām ājyasthālīm āgnīdhraḥ pratyañco yanti patnīḥ saṃyājayiṣyantaḥ /
2.5.11.a.d: जुहूपभृताव् अध्वर्युर् आदत्ते वेदम्̐ होता सस्रुवाम् आज्यस्थालीम् आग्नीध्रः प्रत्यञ्चो यन्ति पत्नीः संयाजयिष्यन्तः ।
2.5.11.a.m: The adhvaryu takes the juhū and upabhṛt, the hotṛ the veda-bundle, and the āgnīdhra the pot of clarified butter with the dipping spoon; they go west to perform the patnīsaṃyāja offerings.

2.5.11.b.m: The adhvaryu steps across to the south of the gārhapatya, the other two to the north.

2.5.11.c.s: agner vām apannagṛhasya sadasi sādayāmi \\ iti kastambhyām̐ srucau sādayati /
2.5.11.c.d: अग्नेर् वाम् अपन्नगृहस्य सदसि सादयामि \\ इति कस्तम्भ्याम्̐ स्रुचौ सादयति ।
2.5.11.c.m: With "I place you two in the seat of Agni of unfallen house", he places the two offering ladles on the two props.

2.5.11.d.s: dhuri dhuryau pātam iti dhuroḥ prohati prohaṇam eke pūrvam̐ samāmananti /
2.5.11.d.d: धुरि धुर्यौ पातम् इति धुरोः प्रोहति प्रोहणम् एके पूर्वम्̐ समामनन्ति ।
2.5.11.d.m: With "Protect the two pole-bearers at the pole!", he pushes them forward onto the two poles; some teachers prescribe pushing forward earlier.

2.5.11.e.m: Or he sets them down on the wooden sword, having unyoked them on the wooden sword.

2.5.11.f.s: vimuktābhyām apareṇa gārhapatyam upaviśya dhvānenaiva srugbhyāṃ patnīḥ saṃyājayanti /
2.5.11.f.d: विमुक्ताभ्याम् अपरेण गार्हपत्यम् उपविश्य ध्वानेनैव स्रुग्भ्यां पत्नीः संयाजयन्ति ।
2.5.11.f.m: Sitting down to the west of the gārhapatya with them unyoked, they perform the patnīsaṃyāja offerings with the two offering ladles in a murmur.

2.5.11.g.s: vedaṃ copabhṛtya patnyām anvārabdhāyām uttarārdhe somaṃ yajati dakṣiṇārdhe tvaṣṭāraṃ tāv antareṇetarā yajati /
2.5.11.g.d: वेदं चोपभृत्य पत्न्याम् अन्वारब्धायाम् उत्तरार्धे सोमं यजति दक्षिणार्धे त्वष्टारं ताव् अन्तरेणेतरा यजति ।
2.5.11.g.m: Holding the veda-bundle, with the sacrificer's wife touching him, he sacrifices to Soma in the northern half, to Tvaṣṭṛ in the southern half, and between the two he sacrifices to the other [deities].

2.5.11.h.d: परिश्रिते ऽपरिश्रिते वा देवानां पत्नीर् यजति ।
2.5.11.h.m: Behind an enclosure or unenclosed, he sacrifices to the Wives of the Gods.

2.5.11.i.s: apariśrite rākāṃ putrakāmo yajeta sinīvālīṃ paśukāmaḥ kuhūṃ puṣṭikāmaḥ /
2.5.11.i.d: अपरिश्रिते राकां पुत्रकामो यजेत सिनीवालीं पशुकामः कुहूं पुष्टिकामः ।
2.5.11.i.m: Unenclosed, one desiring a son should sacrifice to Rākā, one desiring cattle to Sinīvālī, and one desiring prosperity to Kuhū.

2.5.11.j.s: purastād devānāṃ patnībhyo rākāsinīvālyāv eke samāmananti /
2.5.11.j.d: पुरस्ताद् देवानां पत्नीभ्यो राकासिनीवाल्याव् एके समामनन्ति ।
2.5.11.j.m: Some teachers prescribe [the offerings to] Rākā and Sinīvālī prior to the Wives of the Gods.

2.5.11.k.s: agniṃ gṛhapatim iṣṭvā saṃ patnī patyā sukṛtena gacchatām \\ yajñasya yuktau dhuryāva bhūtām / \ saṃjānānau vijahatām arātīs \\ divi jyotir ajaram ārabhetām iti sruveṇa gārhapatye saṃpatnīyaṃ juhoti patnyāṃ samanvārabdhāyām /
2.5.11.k.d: अग्निं गृहपतिम् इष्ट्वा सं पत्नी पत्या सुकृतेन गच्छताम् \\ यज्ञस्य युक्तौ धुर्याव भूताम् । \ संजानानौ विजहताम् अरातीस् \\ दिवि ज्योतिर् अजरम् आरभेताम् इति स्रुवेण गार्हपत्ये संपत्नीयं जुहोति पत्न्यां समन्वारब्धायाम् ।
2.5.11.k.m: Having sacrificed to Agni Gṛhapati, while the sacrificer's wife touches him, he offers the saṃpatnīya oblation with the dipping spoon into the gārhapatya with: "May the wife and the husband go together through good deeds; may they become the two draught-bearers yoked to the sacrifice. Agreeing together, may they discard enemies; may they touch unaging light in heaven!"

2.5.11.l.s: hotur aṅguliparvaṇī anakty aparam aṅktvātha pūrvam itarathā vā /
2.5.11.l.d: होतुर् अङ्गुलिपर्वणी अनक्त्य् अपरम् अङ्क्त्वाथ पूर्वम् इतरथा वा ।
2.5.11.l.m: He anoints the two joints of the hotṛ's fingers, either having anointed the further one and then the earlier, or vice versa.

2.5.11.o.s: dakṣiṇe hotuḥ pāṇau catura ājyabindūn iḍām avadyati /
2.5.11.o.d: दक्षिणे होतुः पाणौ चतुर आज्यबिन्दून् इडाम् अवद्यति ।
2.5.11.o.m: He cuts off the iḍā as four drops of clarified butter in the right hand of the hotṛ;

2.5.11.r.m: While the iḍā is being invoked, the adhvaryu, the āgnīdhra,

2.5.12.b.s: upahūteyaṃ yajamāna \\ ity ucyamāne \\ upahūtā paśumaty asāni \\ iti japati /
2.5.12.b.d: उपहूतेयं यजमान \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने \\ उपहूता पशुमत्य् असानि \\ इति जपति ।
2.5.12.b.m: When "Invoked is this sacrificer..." is spoken, [the sacrificer's wife] mutters: "May I, being invoked, possess cattle!"

2.5.12.d.s: upahūto dyauḥ pitā \\ upa māṃ dyauḥ pitā hvayatām \ agnir āgnīdhrād āyuṣe varcase jīvātvai puṇyāya \\ ity āgnīdhraḥ prāśnāti \\ upahūtā pṛthivī mātā \\ upa māṃ mātā pṛthivī hvayatām \ agnir āgnīdhrād āyuṣe varcase jīvātvai puṇyāya \\ iti vā /
2.5.12.d.d: उपहूतो द्यौः पिता \\ उप मां द्यौः पिता ह्वयताम् \ अग्निर् आग्नीध्राद् आयुषे वर्चसे जीवात्वै पुण्याय \\ इत्य् आग्नीध्रः प्राश्नाति \\ उपहूता पृथिवी माता \\ उप मां माता पृथिवी ह्वयताम् \ अग्निर् आग्नीध्राद् आयुषे वर्चसे जीवात्वै पुण्याय \\ इति वा ।
2.5.12.d.m: The āgnīdhra consumes it with "Invoked is Father Sky; may Father Sky invoke me; Agni from the Āgnīdhra for life, luster, livelihood, and holy merit!", or with "Invoked is Mother Earth; may Mother Earth invoke me; Agni from the Āgnīdhra for life, luster, livelihood, and holy merit!"

2.5.12.e.m: Having consumed it, he silently sips water.

2.5.12.g.s: śaṃyvante vedāt tṛṇam apādāya tasya juhvām agram añjyāt sruve madhyam upabhṛty ājyasthālyāṃ mūlam /
2.5.12.g.d: शंय्वन्ते वेदात् तृणम् अपादाय तस्य जुह्वाम् अग्रम् अञ्ज्यात् स्रुवे मध्यम् उपभृत्य् आज्यस्थाल्यां मूलम् ।
2.5.12.g.m: If it ends with the Śaṃyu-formula, having taken a blade of grass from the veda-bundle, he should anoint its tip in the juhū, its middle in the dipping spoon and the upabhṛt, and its root in the clarified-butter pot.

2.5.12.h.m: Its ritual procedure is that of the prastara.

2.5.12.i.m: Having placed the cuttings of kindling-wood onto the dakṣiṇāgni fire, he offers the flour-paste oblation and the chaff oblation.

2.5.12.j.s: caturgṛhītājye phalīkaraṇān opya \\ agne 'dabdhāyo iti juhoti /
2.5.12.j.d: चतुर्गृहीताज्ये फलीकरणान् ओप्य \\ अग्ने ऽदब्धायो इति जुहोति ।
2.5.12.j.m: Having thrown the chaff into four ladlefuls of clarified butter, he offers it with: "O Agni, undeceivable..."

2.5.12.k.s: aparaṃ caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā piṣṭalepam opya \\ ulūkhale musale yac ca śūrpe \\ āśiśleṣa dṛṣadi yat kapāle / \ avapruṣo vipruṣaḥ saṃyajāmi \ viśve devā havir idaṃ juṣantām \\ yajñe yā vipruṣaḥ santi bahvīs \\ agnau tāḥ sarvāḥ sviṣṭāḥ suhutā juhomi \\ iti piṣṭalepaṃ juhoti /
2.5.12.k.d: अपरं चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वा पिष्टलेपम् ओप्य \\ उलूखले मुसले यच् च शूर्पे \\ आशिश्लेष दृषदि यत् कपाले । \ अवप्रुषो विप्रुषः संयजामि \ विश्वे देवा हविर् इदं जुषन्ताम् \\ यज्ञे या विप्रुषः सन्ति बह्वीस् \\ अग्नौ ताः सर्वाः स्विष्टाः सुहुता जुहोमि \\ इति पिष्टलेपं जुहोति ।
2.5.12.k.m: Having taken another four ladlefuls and thrown in the flour-paste, he offers the flour-paste oblation with: "What adhered to the mortar, pestle, and winnowing basket, what adhered to the lower grinding stone and the potsherd, all those scattered drops I offer together; may the Viśvedevas enjoy this oblation! The many drops that exist in the sacrifice, all those well-offered and well-poured I offer into the fire!"

2.5.12.l.s: piṣṭalepaṃ pūrvam eke samāmananti devo 'si \ vittir asi \\ iti vedam̐ hotā patnyai prayacchati /
2.5.12.l.d: पिष्टलेपं पूर्वम् एके समामनन्ति देवो ऽसि \ वित्तिर् असि \\ इति वेदम्̐ होता पत्न्यै प्रयच्छति ।
2.5.12.l.m: Some teachers prescribe the flour-paste oblation earlier. The hotṛ hands the veda-bundle to the sacrificer's wife with: "You are a god; you are acquisition;"

2.5.12.m.s: vedo 'si \ vedase tvā \ vedo me vinda \\ iti vā /
2.5.12.m.d: वेदो ऽसि \ वेदसे त्वा \ वेदो मे विन्द \\ इति वा ।
2.5.12.m.m: or with: "You are the veda; for wealth [I take] you; find wealth for me!"

2.5.12.n.s: ghṛtavantaṃ kulāyinam iti tam̐ somasthe kṛtvā /
2.5.12.n.d: घृतवन्तं कुलायिनम् इति तम्̐ सोमस्थे कृत्वा ।
2.5.12.n.m: With "Possessing ghee, having a nest...", having placed it on her lap,

2.5.12.q.m: According to some, he unties it thrice.

2.5.12.r.s: nir dviṣantaṃ nir arātiṃ nuda \\ iti vedaṃ patnī nirasyate /
2.5.12.r.d: निर् द्विषन्तं निर् अरातिं नुद \\ इति वेदं पत्नी निरस्यते ।
2.5.12.r.m: With "Drive out the hater, drive out the enemy!", the sacrificer's wife tosses the veda-bundle out.

2.5.12.s.m: With "I untie this...", she unfastens the cord-girdle.

2.5.12.t.m: Into her folded hands holding the cord, he pours the full vessel of water.

2.5.12.u.m: While it is being poured, she mutters: "Together with life..."

2.5.12.v.s: tat sā ninīya mukhaṃ vimṛjya yathārthaṃ gacchati /
2.5.12.v.d: तत् सा निनीय मुखं विमृज्य यथार्थं गच्छति ।
2.5.12.v.m: Having poured it out and wiped her face, she goes according to her purpose.

2.5.12.w.s: ghṛtavantaṃ kulāyinam iti vedam̐ hotā stṛṇann eti gārhapatyāt saṃtatam āhavanīyāt /
2.5.12.w.d: घृतवन्तं कुलायिनम् इति वेदम्̐ होता स्तृणन्न् एति गार्हपत्यात् संततम् आहवनीयात् ।
2.5.12.w.m: With "Possessing ghee, having a nest...", the hotṛ goes scattering the veda-grass in an unbroken line from the gārhapatya to the āhavanīya.

2.5.13.a.m: Having returned the way he came, the adhvaryu...

2.5.13.b.s: yā sarasvatī yaśobhagīnā tasyai te svāhā \ yā sarasvatī veśabhagīnā tasyai te svāhā \\ iti sārasvatau homau hutvā /
2.5.13.b.d: या सरस्वती यशोभगीना तस्यै ते स्वाहा \ या सरस्वती वेशभगीना तस्यै ते स्वाहा \\ इति सारस्वतौ होमौ हुत्वा ।
2.5.13.b.m: Having offered the two Sarasvatī offerings with: 'To that Sarasvatī who possesses the fortune of renown, to you, hail! To that Sarasvatī who possesses the fortune of a home, to you, hail!'

2.5.13.c.s: indro 'pānasya keha manaso veśān kuru sumanasaḥ sajātān svāhā /
2.5.13.c.d: इन्द्रो ऽपानस्य केह मनसो वेशान् कुरु सुमनसः सजातान् स्वाहा ।
2.5.13.c.m: 'Indra, of expiration […] here make the dwellers of the mind well-disposed, [our] kinsmen, hail!'

2.5.13.d.s: ṛṣabhaṃ vājinaṃ vayaṃ pūrṇamāsaṃ yajāmahe / \ sa no dohatām̐ suvīram \\ rāyaspoṣam̐ sahasriṇam \\ prāṇāya surādhase pūrṇamāsāya svāhā \\ iti paurṇamāsyām / amāvāsyā subhagā suśevā \ dhenur iva bhūya āpyāyamānā / \ sā no dohatām̐ suvīryam \\ rāyaspoṣam̐ sahasriṇam \ apānāya surādhase 'māvāsyāyai svāhā \\ ity amāvāsyāyām̐ sruveṇa pārvaṇau homau juhoti /
2.5.13.d.d: ऋषभं वाजिनं वयं पूर्णमासं यजामहे । \ स नो दोहताम्̐ सुवीरम् \\ रायस्पोषम्̐ सहस्रिणम् \\ प्राणाय सुराधसे पूर्णमासाय स्वाहा \\ इति पौर्णमास्याम् । अमावास्या सुभगा सुशेवा \ धेनुर् इव भूय आप्यायमाना । \ सा नो दोहताम्̐ सुवीर्यम् \\ रायस्पोषम्̐ सहस्रिणम् \ अपानाय सुराधसे ऽमावास्यायै स्वाहा \\ इत्य् अमावास्यायाम्̐ स्रुवेण पार्वणौ होमौ जुहोति ।
2.5.13.d.m: 'We worship the bull, the vigorous Full Moon; / may he yield us abundant heroism, / a thousandfold increase of wealth; / to the Full Moon of bountiful gifts, for inspiration, hail!' at the Full Moon rite; 'The New Moon is auspicious and benevolent, / swelling like a cow again and again; / may she yield us abundant heroism, / a thousandfold increase of wealth; / to the New Moon of bountiful gifts, for expiration, hail!' at the New Moon rite, he offers the two Parvan offerings with the dipping spoon.

2.5.13.e.m: Some teach [these] before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

2.5.13.f.s: daśa te tanuvo yajña yajñiyās \ tāḥ prīṇātu yajamāno ghṛtena / \ nāriṣṭhayoḥ praśiṣam īḍamānas \\ devānāṃ daivye 'pi yajamāno 'mṛto 'bhūt /
2.5.13.f.d: दश ते तनुवो यज्ञ यज्ञियास् \ ताः प्रीणातु यजमानो घृतेन । \ नारिष्ठयोः प्रशिषम् ईडमानस् \\ देवानां दैव्ये ऽपि यजमानो ऽमृतो ऽभूत् ।
2.5.13.f.m: 'Ten are your sacrificial forms, O sacrifice; / may the sacrificer satisfy them with clarified butter. / Yearning for the command of the two Nāriṣṭhas, / among the divine [realm] of the gods the sacrificer has become immortal.'

2.5.13.g.s: yaṃ vāṃ devā akalpayan \\ ūrjo bhāgam̐ śatakratū / \ etad vāṃ tena prīṇāti \ tena tṛpyatām̐ hahau /
2.5.13.g.d: यं वां देवा अकल्पयन् \\ ऊर्जो भागम्̐ शतक्रतू । \ एतद् वां तेन प्रीणाति \ तेन तृप्यताम्̐ हहौ ।
2.5.13.g.m: 'The portion of strength which the gods prepared for you two, / O Śatakratus, / with that he satisfies you two; / with that may both be satisfied, hahau!'

2.5.13.h.s: ahaṃ devānām̐ sukṛtām asmi loke \ mamedam iṣṭaṃ na mithur bhavāti / \ ahaṃ nāriṣṭhāv anuyajāmi vidvān \ yad ābhyām indro adadhād bhāgadheyam /
2.5.13.h.d: अहं देवानाम्̐ सुकृताम् अस्मि लोके \ ममेदम् इष्टं न मिथुर् भवाति । \ अहं नारिष्ठाव् अनुयजामि विद्वान् \ यद् आभ्याम् इन्द्रो अदधाद् भागधेयम् ।
2.5.13.h.m: 'I am in the world of the pious gods; / may this sacrifice of mine not fail. / Knowing, I offer after to the two Nāriṣṭhas, / since Indra assigned a share to them.'

2.5.13.i.s: adārasṛd bhavata deva soma \\ asmin yajñe maruto mṛḍatā naḥ / \ mā no vidad abhi bhāmo aśastis \\ mā no vidad vṛjanā dveṣyā yā /
2.5.13.i.d: अदारसृद् भवत देव सोम \\ अस्मिन् यज्ञे मरुतो मृडता नः । \ मा नो विदद् अभि भामो अशस्तिस् \\ मा नो विदद् वृजना द्वेष्या या ।
2.5.13.i.m: 'Become not causing injury, O divine Soma; / in this sacrifice, O Maruts, be gracious to us. / May not fury, may not curse find us; / may not that plotting which is hostile find us.'

2.5.13.j.s: brahma pratiṣṭhā manaso brahma vācas \\ brahma yajñānām̐ haviṣām ājyasya / \ atiriktaṃ karmaṇo yac ca hīnam \\ yajñaḥ parvāṇi pratirann eti kalpayan \ svāhākṛtāhutir etu devān / \ saṃ te manasā manas \\ saṃ prāṇe prāṇaṃ dadhāmi te \ saṃ vyāne sam apānaṃ dadhāmi te / \ parigṛhya yajamāno 'mṛto 'bhūt \\ śaṃ na edhi dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade svāhā \\ iti nāriṣṭhāñ juhoti //
2.5.13.j.d: ब्रह्म प्रतिष्ठा मनसो ब्रह्म वाचस् \\ ब्रह्म यज्ञानाम्̐ हविषाम् आज्यस्य । \ अतिरिक्तं कर्मणो यच् च हीनम् \\ यज्ञः पर्वाणि प्रतिरन्न् एति कल्पयन् \ स्वाहाकृताहुतिर् एतु देवान् । \ सं ते मनसा मनस् \\ सं प्राणे प्राणं दधामि ते \ सं व्याने सम् अपानं दधामि ते । \ परिगृह्य यजमानो ऽमृतो ऽभूत् \\ शं न एधि द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे स्वाहा \\ इति नारिष्ठाञ् जुहोति ॥
2.5.13.j.m: 'The sacred formulation is the foundation of the mind; the sacred formulation, of speech; / the sacred formulation, of the sacrifices, of the oblations, of the clarified butter. / Whatever in the rite is redundant and whatever is deficient, / extending its joints the sacrifice goes on arranging; / may the offering made with svāhā go to the gods! / With [your] mind I unite your mind; / in [your] breath I place your breath; / in [your] circulating breath I unite your downward breath. / Having embraced [them], the sacrificer has become immortal; / be welfare for our biped, welfare for our quadruped, hail!'—[with these verses] he offers the Nāriṣṭha offerings.

2.6.14.a.s: iṣṭebhyaḥ svāhā vaṣaḍ aniṣṭebhyaḥ svāhā \ bheṣajaṃ duriṣṭyai svāhā \ niṣkṛtyai svāhā \ nirṛtyai svāhā \ daurārdhyai svāhā \ daivībhyas tanūbhyaḥ svāhā \\ ṛdhyai svāhā \ samṛddhyai svāhā /
2.6.14.a.d: इष्टेभ्यः स्वाहा वषड् अनिष्टेभ्यः स्वाहा \ भेषजं दुरिष्ट्यै स्वाहा \ निष्कृत्यै स्वाहा \ निरृत्यै स्वाहा \ दौरार्ध्यै स्वाहा \ दैवीभ्यस् तनूभ्यः स्वाहा \\ ऋध्यै स्वाहा \ समृद्ध्यै स्वाहा ।
2.6.14.a.m: 'To what has been sacrificed, hail! To what has not been sacrificed, vaṣaṭ! Hail! / Medicine for faulty sacrifice, hail! / To expiation, hail! / To destruction, hail! / To misfortune, hail! / To the divine bodies, hail! / To prosperity, hail! / To complete prosperity, hail!'

2.6.14.b.s: ayāś cāgne 'sy anabhiśastīś ca \ satyam it tvam ayā asi / \ ayasā manasā dhṛtas \\ ayasā havyam ūhiṣe \\ ayā no dhehi bheṣajam̐ svāhā \\ imaṃ me varuṇa \ tat tvā yāmi \ tvaṃ no agne \ sa tvaṃ no agne \ tvam agne ayāsi \ prajāpate bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar iti vyāhṛtibhir juhoty ekaikaśaḥ samastābhiś ca /
2.6.14.b.d: अयाश् चाग्ने ऽस्य् अनभिशस्तीश् च \ सत्यम् इत् त्वम् अया असि । \ अयसा मनसा धृतस् \\ अयसा हव्यम् ऊहिषे \\ अया नो धेहि भेषजम्̐ स्वाहा \\ इमं मे वरुण \ तत् त्वा यामि \ त्वं नो अग्ने \ स त्वं नो अग्ने \ त्वम् अग्ने अयासि \ प्रजापते भूर् भुवः सुवर् इति व्याहृतिभिर् जुहोत्य् एकैकशः समस्ताभिश् च ।
2.6.14.b.m: 'You are Agile, O Agni, and free from curse; / truly you are Agile. / Held by agile mind, / with agile [mind] you bear the oblation; / agile, place medicine in us, hail!' With: 'This my [prayer], O Varuṇa', 'That of you I ask', 'You to us, O Agni', 'So you to us, O Agni', 'You, O Agni, are agile', 'O Prajāpati', and with the sacred utterances: 'bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar', he offers [the expiations] individually and all together.

2.6.14.c.s: āśrāvitam atyāśrāvitam \\ vaṣaṭkṛtam atyanūktaṃ ca yajñe / \ atiriktaṃ karmaṇo yac ca hīnam \\ yajñaḥ parvāṇi pratirann eti kalpayan \ svāhākṛtāhutir etu devān /
2.6.14.c.d: आश्रावितम् अत्याश्रावितम् \\ वषट्कृतम् अत्यनूक्तं च यज्ञे । \ अतिरिक्तं कर्मणो यच् च हीनम् \\ यज्ञः पर्वाणि प्रतिरन्न् एति कल्पयन् \ स्वाहाकृताहुतिर् एतु देवान् ।
2.6.14.c.m: 'What was called out, what was called out in excess, / what was accompanied by the vaṣaṭ call, and what was recited beyond measure at the sacrifice, / whatever in the rite is redundant and whatever is deficient, / extending its joints the sacrifice goes on arranging; / may the offering made with svāhā go to the gods!'

2.6.14.d.s: anājñātaṃ yad ājñātam \\ yajñasya kriyate mithu / \ agne tad asya kalpaya \ tvam̐ hi vettha yathātatham \\ svāhākṛtāhutir etu devān /
2.6.14.d.d: अनाज्ञातं यद् आज्ञातम् \\ यज्ञस्य क्रियते मिथु । \ अग्ने तद् अस्य कल्पय \ त्वम्̐ हि वेत्थ यथातथम् \\ स्वाहाकृताहुतिर् एतु देवान् ।
2.6.14.d.m: 'What is unknown, what is known, / whatever is done amiss in the sacrifice, / arrange that, O Agni, for this [sacrifice]; / for you know how it truly is; / may the offering made with svāhā go to the gods!'

2.6.14.e.s: atiriktaṃ nyūne juhomi \ nyūnam atirikte juhomi / \ samam̐ same juhomi \ svāhākṛtāhutir etu devān /
2.6.14.e.d: अतिरिक्तं न्यूने जुहोमि \ न्यूनम् अतिरिक्ते जुहोमि । \ समम्̐ समे जुहोमि \ स्वाहाकृताहुतिर् एतु देवान् ।
2.6.14.e.m: 'The redundant I offer into the deficient; / the deficient I offer into the redundant; / the equal I offer into the equal; / may the offering made with svāhā go to the gods!'

2.6.14.f.s: yad akarma yan nākarma \ yad atyagāma yan nātyagām \ yad atyarīricāma yan nātyarīricāma / \ tat tvaṃ viṣṇo yajñe yajñaṃ pratiṣṭhāpaya \ svāhākṛtāhutir etu devān /
2.6.14.f.d: यद् अकर्म यन् नाकर्म \ यद् अत्यगाम यन् नात्यगाम् \ यद् अत्यरीरिचाम यन् नात्यरीरिचाम । \ तत् त्वं विष्णो यज्ञे यज्ञं प्रतिष्ठापय \ स्वाहाकृताहुतिर् एतु देवान् ।
2.6.14.f.m: 'What we have done, what we have not done, / what we have transgressed, what we have not transgressed, / what we have left in excess, what we have not left in excess, / establish that sacrifice in the sacrifice, O Viṣṇu; / may the offering made with svāhā go to the gods!'

2.6.14.g.s: yat pramattāntaragāma kiṃcid asmin yajñe \ mantrataḥ karmato vā / \ anayāhutyā tac chamayāmi sarvam \\ tṛpyantu devā haviṣo ghṛtasya \ svāhākṛtāhutir etu devān /
2.6.14.g.d: यत् प्रमत्तान्तरगाम किंचिद् अस्मिन् यज्ञे \ मन्त्रतः कर्मतो वा । \ अनयाहुत्या तच् छमयामि सर्वम् \\ तृप्यन्तु देवा हविषो घृतस्य \ स्वाहाकृताहुतिर् एतु देवान् ।
2.6.14.g.m: 'Whatever we, through negligence, have omitted in this sacrifice, / whether in respect of mantra or of rite, / all that I appease with this offering; / may the gods be satisfied with the oblation of clarified butter; / may the offering made with svāhā go to the gods!'

2.6.14.h.m: [Then] this [verse]: 'The sacred formulation is the foundation of the mind…'

2.6.14.i.s: tataṃ ma āpas tad u tāyate punaḥ \ svādiṣṭhā dhītir ucathāya śasyate / \ ayam̐ samudra uta viśvabheṣajas \\ svāhākṛtasya sam u tṛpṇutarbhuvaḥ /
2.6.14.i.d: ततं म आपस् तद् उ तायते पुनः \ स्वादिष्ठा धीतिर् उचथाय शस्यते । \ अयम्̐ समुद्र उत विश्वभेषजस् \\ स्वाहाकृतस्य सम् उ तृप्णुतर्भुवः ।
2.6.14.i.m: 'My rite is stretched out; and it is stretched out again; / the sweetest poetic vision is praised for recitation. / This ocean possesses all medicines; / and the Ṛbhus find satisfaction from what is consecrated with svāhā.'

2.6.14.j.s: ud vayaṃ tamasas pari \\ ud u tyam \\ citram /
2.6.14.j.d: उद् वयं तमसस् परि \\ उद् उ त्यम् \\ चित्रम् ।
2.6.14.j.m: 'Out of the darkness we…', 'Up indeed that…', 'A wondrous…'

2.6.14.k.s: yad vo devā atipādayāni \ vācā cit prayataṃ devaheḍanam / \ arāyo asmām̐ abhiducchunāyate \\ anyatrāsman marutas taṃ nidhetana /
2.6.14.k.d: यद् वो देवा अतिपादयानि \ वाचा चित् प्रयतं देवहेडनम् । \ अरायो अस्माम्̐ अभिदुच्छुनायते \\ अन्यत्रास्मन् मरुतस् तं निधेतन ।
2.6.14.k.m: 'If, O gods, I should commit a transgression against you, / even through speech, bringing about wrath of the gods, / the malevolent plotter is bringing misfortune upon us; / O Maruts, deposit that away from us!'

2.6.14.l.s: yata indra bhayāmahe \ tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi / \ maghavañ chagdhi tava tan na ūtaye \ vidviṣo vimṛdho jahi /
2.6.14.l.d: यत इन्द्र भयामहे \ ततो नो अभयं कृधि । \ मघवञ् छग्धि तव तन् न ऊतये \ विद्विषो विमृधो जहि ।
2.6.14.l.m: 'From where we fear, O Indra, / make us fearless from that. / O generous one, be able to grant us that for our protection; / slay the hostile adversaries!'

2.6.14.m.s: svastidā viśas patis \\ vṛtrahā vimṛdho vaśī / \ vṛṣendraḥ pura etu naḥ \ svastidā abhayaṃkaraḥ /
2.6.14.m.d: स्वस्तिदा विशस् पतिस् \\ वृत्रहा विमृधो वशी । \ वृषेन्द्रः पुर एतु नः \ स्वस्तिदा अभयंकरः ।
2.6.14.m.m: 'Bestowing welfare, lord of the people, / slayer of Vṛtra, subduing adversaries, having control, / may Indra, the bull, go before us, / bestowing welfare, creating fearlessness.'

2.6.14.o.s: puruṣasaṃmito yajñas \\ yajñaḥ puruṣasaṃmitaḥ / \ agne tad asya kalpaya \ tvam̐ hi vettha yathātatham \\ svāhākṛtāhutir etu devān /
2.6.14.o.d: पुरुषसंमितो यज्ञस् \\ यज्ञः पुरुषसंमितः । \ अग्ने तद् अस्य कल्पय \ त्वम्̐ हि वेत्थ यथातथम् \\ स्वाहाकृताहुतिर् एतु देवान् ।
2.6.14.o.m: 'The sacrifice is commensurate with man; / man is commensurate with the sacrifice. / Arrange that, O Agni, for this [sacrifice]; / for you know how it truly is; / may the offering made with svāhā go to the gods!'

2.6.14.p.s: yat pākatrā manasā dīnadakṣās \\ na yajñasya manvate martyāsaḥ / \ agniṣ ṭad dhotā kratuvid vijānan \ yajiṣṭho devām̐ ṛtuśo yajāti /
2.6.14.p.d: यत् पाकत्रा मनसा दीनदक्षास् \\ न यज्ञस्य मन्वते मर्त्यासः । \ अग्निष् टद् धोता क्रतुविद् विजानन् \ यजिष्ठो देवाम्̐ ऋतुशो यजाति ।
2.6.14.p.m: 'Since as simpletons in mind, with feeble discernment, / mortals do not comprehend the sacrifice, / may Agni the hotṛ, who knows the sacrificial design, discerning, / being most expert in sacrifice, sacrifice to the gods in due season.'

2.6.14.q.m: 'Hail!'—[with this verse] the adhvaryu [offers] into the āhavanīya fire with the juhū.

2.6.15.c.s: devā gātuvidas \\ ity antarvedy ūrdhvas tiṣṭhan dhruvayāhavanīye trīṇi samiṣṭayajūm̐ṣi juhoti /
2.6.15.c.d: देवा गातुविदस् \\ इत्य् अन्तर्वेद्य् ऊर्ध्वस् तिष्ठन् ध्रुवयाहवनीये त्रीणि समिष्टयजूम्̐षि जुहोति ।
2.6.15.c.m: standing upright within the altar ground, he offers three samiṣṭayajus offerings into the āhavanīya fire with the dhruvā ladle, with: 'O gods who know the path…'

2.6.15.d.m: Continuously [he pours] one, two, or three [streams of butter].

2.6.15.f.m: For [the injury of] one who is hated, [he pours] downwards, or he cuts [the stream] off.

2.6.15.g.s: yaṃ kāmayeta pramāyukaḥ syād iti jihmas tiṣṭhañ juhuyāt /
2.6.15.g.d: यं कामयेत प्रमायुकः स्याद् इति जिह्मस् तिष्ठञ् जुहुयात् ।
2.6.15.g.m: If he should desire of anyone, 'May he perish', he should make the offering standing crooked.

2.6.15.h.m: At the middle utterance of svāhā, he throws the sacrificial grass after [into the fire].

2.6.15.k.m: Or he should offer upon it after having thrown [it].

2.6.15.l.s: yadi yajamānaḥ pravaset prajāpater vibhān nāma lokas \\ iti dhruvāyāṃ yajamānabhāgam avadhāya saha samiṣṭayajuṣā juhuyāt /
2.6.15.l.d: यदि यजमानः प्रवसेत् प्रजापतेर् विभान् नाम लोकस् \\ इति ध्रुवायां यजमानभागम् अवधाय सह समिष्टयजुषा जुहुयात् ।
2.6.15.l.m: If the sacrificer is away from home, having placed the sacrificer's share into the dhruvā ladle with: 'The world named Shining of Prajāpati…', he should offer it together with the samiṣṭayajus.

2.6.15.m.s: abhistṛṇīhi paridhehi vedim \\ jāmiṃ mā him̐sīr amuyā śayānā / \ hotṛṣadanā haritāḥ suvarṇās \\ niṣkā ime yajamānasya bradhne \\ iti hotṛṣadanair vedim abhistṛṇāti /
2.6.15.m.d: अभिस्तृणीहि परिधेहि वेदिम् \\ जामिं मा हिम्̐सीर् अमुया शयाना । \ होतृषदना हरिताः सुवर्णास् \\ निष्का इमे यजमानस्य ब्रध्ने \\ इति होतृषदनैर् वेदिम् अभिस्तृणाति ।
2.6.15.m.m: With: 'Strew around, enclose the altar; / do not harm the female relative lying in that manner; / the hotṛ's seats are green, golden-colored, / these gold pendants of the sacrificer in the sun', he covers the altar with the hotṛ's seats.

2.6.15.n.s: poṣāya vas \\ ity agreṇāhavanīyaṃ praṇītāḥ paryāhṛtya yo vo 'yaukṣīt sa vo vimuñcatu \\ ity antarvedi vimuñcati /
2.6.15.n.d: पोषाय वस् \\ इत्य् अग्रेणाहवनीयं प्रणीताः पर्याहृत्य यो वो ऽयौक्षीत् स वो विमुञ्चतु \\ इत्य् अन्तर्वेदि विमुञ्चति ।
2.6.15.n.m: Having carried the praṇītā waters around in front of the āhavanīya fire with: 'For prosperity [I release] you…', he releases them within the altar ground with: 'May he who yoked you release you.'

2.6.15.o.s: yaṃ devā manuṣyeṣu \\ upaveṣam adhārayan / \ ye asmadapacetasas \ tān asmabhyam ihā kuru / \ upaveṣopaviḍḍhi naḥ \ prajāṃ puṣṭim atho dhanam / \ dvipado naś catuṣpadas \\ dhruvān anapagān kuru \\ ity upaveṣam ādāya /
2.6.15.o.d: यं देवा मनुष्येषु \\ उपवेषम् अधारयन् । \ ये अस्मदपचेतसस् \ तान् अस्मभ्यम् इहा कुरु । \ उपवेषोपविड्ढि नः \ प्रजां पुष्टिम् अथो धनम् । \ द्विपदो नश् चतुष्पदस् \\ ध्रुवान् अनपगान् कुरु \\ इत्य् उपवेषम् आदाय ।
2.6.15.o.m: Taking the fire-stirrer with: "The fire-stirrer which the gods placed among humans /— those who are foolish towards us, bring them to us here! / Fire-stirrer, furnish us / with offspring, prosperity, and wealth! / Our two-footed and four-footed [creatures], / make firm and non-departing!"—

2.6.15.p.s: yopaveṣe śuk sāmum ṛcchatu yaṃ dviṣmas \\ ity utkare nikhanen nirasyed vā /
2.6.15.p.d: योपवेषे शुक् सामुम् ऋच्छतु यं द्विष्मस् \\ इत्य् उत्करे निखनेन् निरस्येद् वा ।
2.6.15.p.m: he should bury it in the rubbish heap or discard it with: "Whatever grief is in the fire-stirrer, let it reach him whom we hate!"

2.6.15.q.s: nir amuṃ nuda okasaḥ \ sapatno yaḥ pṛtanyati / \ nirbādhyena haviṣā \\ indra eṇaṃ parāśarīt / \ ihi tisraḥ parāvatas \\ ihi pañcajanām̐ ati / \ ihi tisro 'ti rocanās \\ yāvat sūryo asad divi / \ paramāṃ tvā parāvatam \ indro nayatu vṛtrahā / \ yato na punar āyasi \ śaśvatībhyaḥ samābhyaḥ / \ hato 'sau \\ avadhiṣmāmum iti yaṃ dveṣṭi tasya vadhaṃ manasā dhyāyati \\ avasṛṣṭaḥ parāpata \ śaro brahmasam̐śitas \\ iti vāpa upaspṛśya /
2.6.15.q.d: निर् अमुं नुद ओकसः \ सपत्नो यः पृतन्यति । \ निर्बाध्येन हविषा \\ इन्द्र एणं पराशरीत् । \ इहि तिस्रः परावतस् \\ इहि पञ्चजनाम्̐ अति । \ इहि तिस्रो ऽति रोचनास् \\ यावत् सूर्यो असद् दिवि । \ परमां त्वा परावतम् \ इन्द्रो नयतु वृत्रहा । \ यतो न पुनर् आयसि \ शश्वतीभ्यः समाभ्यः । \ हतो ऽसौ \\ अवधिष्मामुम् इति यं द्वेष्टि तस्य वधं मनसा ध्यायति \\ अवसृष्टः परापत \ शरो ब्रह्मसम्̐शितस् \\ इति वाप उपस्पृश्य ।
2.6.15.q.m: Or touching water with: "Drive that one from his home, / the rival who wages war! / With the crushing sacrificial oblation, / Indra has shattered him. / Go across the three distant realms, / go beyond the five peoples, / go beyond the three luminous spheres, / as long as the sun shall be in the sky! / To the furthest distance / may Indra, slayer of Vṛtra, lead you, / whence you shall not return / for endless years! / Slain is so-and-so; / we have slain that one," he meditates in his mind on the slaying of him whom he hates, [or with:] "Sped forth, fly far away, / arrow sharpened by sacred power!"

2.6.15.r.s: kas tvā yunakti sā tvā vimuñcatu \\ iti yajñaṃ vimuñcati /
2.6.15.r.d: कस् त्वा युनक्ति सा त्वा विमुञ्चतु \\ इति यज्ञं विमुञ्चति ।
2.6.15.r.m: He unyokes the sacrifice with: "Who yokes you? May she unyoke you!"

2.6.15.t.m: [He looks along] the potsherds with: "Whatever potsherds are at the cauldon..."

2.6.15.u.m: When the Full Moon rite is completed,

2.6.16.a.m: he sets in motion the sacrificial framework of the Vaimṛdha sacrifice.

2.6.16.b.m: Its ritual procedure is explained by [that of] the offering to Indra-Agni.

2.6.16.c.m: There are fifteen or seventeen kindling verses.

2.6.16.d.s: nirvapaṇakāla indrāya vaimṛdhāya prabhūtān vrīhīn nirvapati /
2.6.16.d.d: निर्वपणकाल इन्द्राय वैमृधाय प्रभूतान् व्रीहीन् निर्वपति ।
2.6.16.d.m: At the time of pouring out the grain, he pours out abundant rice for Indra Vaimṛdha.

2.6.16.e.m: At the time of the priestly gift, he gives a priestly gift according to his ability.

2.6.16.f.m: In that matter, there is freedom of choice regarding the setting in motion.

2.6.16.g.m: After setting it in motion, however, it is obligatory.

2.6.16.h.m: We shall explain the optional procedures of the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices.

2.6.16.i.m: One who desires prosperity should sacrifice with these New- and Full-Moon sacrifices.

2.6.16.j.m: He should perform two Full Moon rites and two New Moon rites.

2.6.16.k.s: yaḥ kāmayetardhnuyām ity ekeṣāṃ paurṇamāsīm eva yajeta /
2.6.16.k.d: यः कामयेतर्ध्नुयाम् इत्य् एकेषां पौर्णमासीम् एव यजेत ।
2.6.16.k.m: According to some, one who desires, "May I prosper," should perform only the Full Moon rite.

2.6.16.l.s: bhrātṛvyavān nāmāvāsyāṃ dvyavarārdhyaṃ tryavarārdhyaṃ vā yajeta saṃkrāmesaṃkrāme vajraṃ bhrātṛvyāya praharati /
2.6.16.l.d: भ्रातृव्यवान् नामावास्यां द्व्यवरार्ध्यं त्र्यवरार्ध्यं वा यजेत संक्रामेसंक्रामे वज्रं भ्रातृव्याय प्रहरति ।
2.6.16.l.m: One who has a rival should perform the New Moon rite for at least two or at least three [months]; at each successive step, he hurls the thunderbolt at his rival.

2.6.16.m.s: agnīṣomīyāṇi pradhānāni syur bhrātṛvyavato 'bhicaratas titīriṣato vā /
2.6.16.m.d: अग्नीषोमीयाणि प्रधानानि स्युर् भ्रातृव्यवतो ऽभिचरतस् तितीरिषतो वा ।
2.6.16.m.m: The primary rites should be dedicated to Agni-Soma for one who has a rival, one who is practicing sorcery, or one who wishes to cross over [adversity].

2.6.16.n.m: One who desires cattle should sacrifice with the Sākaṃprasthāyīya rite.

2.6.16.o.s: bahavaḥ sāyaṃdohā bhavanti bahavaḥ prātardohās tair anantaraṃ dohād yajate /
2.6.16.o.d: बहवः सायंदोहा भवन्ति बहवः प्रातर्दोहास् तैर् अनन्तरं दोहाद् यजते ।
2.6.16.o.m: There are many evening milkings and many morning milkings; immediately after the milking, he sacrifices with them.

2.6.16.p.s: api vā yathāmāvāsyāyām̐ havir duhanty evaṃ dugdhvātacya nidadhyād yat prātaḥ syāt tac chṛtaṃ kuryāt pātrasam̐sādanakāle yathārthaṃ pātrāṇi prayunakti juhum̐ś caudumbarān mahataś camasām̐s teṣāṃ juhvā kalpo vyākhyātaḥ /
2.6.16.p.d: अपि वा यथामावास्यायाम्̐ हविर् दुहन्त्य् एवं दुग्ध्वातच्य निदध्याद् यत् प्रातः स्यात् तच् छृतं कुर्यात् पात्रसम्̐सादनकाले यथार्थं पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति जुहुम्̐श् चौदुम्बरान् महतश् चमसाम्̐स् तेषां जुह्वा कल्पो व्याख्यातः ।
2.6.16.p.m: Or rather, just as they milk the sacrificial oblation at the New Moon rite, having thus milked it and curdled it, he should set it down; whatever there is in the morning, he should boil that; at the time of setting down the vessels, he prepares the vessels according to need: the juhū ladles and large cups made of udumbara wood; their ritual procedure is explained by [that of] the juhū ladle.

2.6.16.q.s: pracaryāgneyena puroḍāśenāgnīdhre srucau nidhāya saha kumbhībhir atikrāmann āha \\ indrāyānubrūhi \\ āśrāvaya \\ indraṃ yaja \\ iti yāvatyaḥ kumbhyaḥ syus tāvanto brāhmaṇā dakṣiṇata upavītina upottiṣṭheyur dārupātrāṇy ādāya teṣu kumbhīr ānīya sarve yugapaj juhvaty adhvaryor āhutim anujuhvati /
2.6.16.q.d: प्रचर्याग्नेयेन पुरोडाशेनाग्नीध्रे स्रुचौ निधाय सह कुम्भीभिर् अतिक्रामन्न् आह \\ इन्द्रायानुब्रूहि \\ आश्रावय \\ इन्द्रं यज \\ इति यावत्यः कुम्भ्यः स्युस् तावन्तो ब्राह्मणा दक्षिणत उपवीतिन उपोत्तिष्ठेयुर् दारुपात्राण्य् आदाय तेषु कुम्भीर् आनीय सर्वे युगपज् जुह्वत्य् अध्वर्योर् आहुतिम् अनुजुह्वति ।
2.6.16.q.m: Having performed [the offering] with the sacrificial cake for Agni and placed the two offering ladles in the Āgnīdhra [hearth], striding across together with the jars, he says: "Recite for Indra! Call for the response! Sacrifice to Indra!" As many jars as there are, so many Brāhmaṇas wearing the sacred cord over the left shoulder should stand up towards the south, having taken wooden vessels; having poured the jars into them, they all offer simultaneously, offering after the offering of the adhvaryu.

2.6.16.r.m: One who desires heaven should sacrifice with the Dākṣāyaṇayajña.

2.6.16.s.m: There are two Full Moon rites and two New Moon rites.

2.6.16.t.s: āgneyo 'ṣṭākapālo 'gnīṣomīya ekādaśakapālaḥ pūrvasyāṃ paurṇamāsyām āgneyo 'ṣṭākapāla aindraṃ dadhy uttarasyām āgneyo 'ṣṭākapāla aindrāgna ekādaśakapālaḥ pūrvasyām amāvāsyāyām āgneyo 'ṣṭākapālo maitrāvaruṇy āmikṣottarasyām /
2.6.16.t.d: आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपालो ऽग्नीषोमीय एकादशकपालः पूर्वस्यां पौर्णमास्याम् आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपाल ऐन्द्रं दध्य् उत्तरस्याम् आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपाल ऐन्द्राग्न एकादशकपालः पूर्वस्याम् अमावास्यायाम् आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपालो मैत्रावरुण्य् आमिक्षोत्तरस्याम् ।
2.6.16.t.m: [There are] an eight-potsherd [cake] for Agni and an eleven-potsherd [cake] for Agni-Soma on the first Full Moon day; an eight-potsherd [cake] for Agni and curd for Indra on the second; an eight-potsherd [cake] for Agni and an eleven-potsherd [cake] for Indra-Agni on the first New Moon day; an eight-potsherd [cake] for Agni and a curd mixture for Mitra-Varuṇa on the second.

2.6.16.u.s: tasyaitad vrataṃ nānṛtaṃ vaden na mām̐sam aśnīyān na striyam upeyān nāsya palpūlanena vāsaḥ palpūlayeyur nāñjīta nābhyañjītartau jāyām upeyāt /
2.6.16.u.d: तस्यैतद् व्रतं नानृतं वदेन् न माम्̐सम् अश्नीयान् न स्त्रियम् उपेयान् नास्य पल्पूलनेन वासः पल्पूलयेयुर् नाञ्जीत नाभ्यञ्जीतर्तौ जायाम् उपेयात् ।
2.6.16.u.m: This is his ritual observance: he must not speak untruth, he must not eat meat, he must not approach a woman [sexually], they must not wash his garment with alkaline water, he must not apply eye-salve, nor anoint himself; he may approach his wife [only] in her fertile period.

2.6.16.v.s: so 'yaṃ darśapūrṇamasayor ādito vikalpo 'nena darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ vā yajeta /
2.6.16.v.d: सो ऽयं दर्शपूर्णमसयोर् आदितो विकल्पो ऽनेन दर्शपूर्णमासाभ्यां वा यजेत ।
2.6.16.v.m: This is the alternative to the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices from the beginning; or he may sacrifice with these [standard] New- and Full-Moon sacrifices.

2.6.16.w.m: Having sacrificed with it for fifteen years, he abandons the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices.

2.7.17.a.m: In the afternoon on the New Moon day, he sacrifices with the Piṇḍapitṛyajña,

2.7.17.c.s: yad ahaḥ purastāc candramasaṃ na paśyanti /
2.7.17.c.d: यद् अहः पुरस्ताच् चन्द्रमसं न पश्यन्ति ।
2.7.17.c.m: on the day when they do not see the moon in the east.

2.7.17.d.m: If it is visible, however, having fasted, he sacrifices on the next day.

2.7.17.e.s: apāṃ medhyaṃ yajñiyam \\ sadevam̐ śivam astu me / \ ācchettā vo mā riṣam \\ jīvāni śaradaḥ śatam iti sakṛdācchinnam̐ samūlaṃ barhir ācchinatti /
2.7.17.e.d: अपां मेध्यं यज्ञियम् \\ सदेवम्̐ शिवम् अस्तु मे । \ आच्छेत्ता वो मा रिषम् \\ जीवानि शरदः शतम् इति सकृदाच्छिन्नम्̐ समूलं बर्हिर् आच्छिनत्ति ।
2.7.17.e.m: He cuts grass cut once with its roots, with: "Sacrificial essence of the waters, accompanied by the gods, may it be auspicious for me! May I, its cutter, not come to harm; may I live a hundred autumns!"

2.7.17.f.m: Having strewn darbha grass around the dakṣiṇāgni fire with the tips pointing south-east,

2.7.17.g.m: and having strewn darbha grass north of the fire,

2.7.17.h.m: he sets out one by one the vessels of the Piṇḍapitṛyajña:

2.7.17.i.s: sphyam̐ sthālīṃ mekṣaṇaṃ śūrpaṃ kṛṣṇājinam ulūkhalaṃ musalam /
2.7.17.i.d: स्फ्यम्̐ स्थालीं मेक्षणं शूर्पं कृष्णाजिनम् उलूखलं मुसलम् ।
2.7.17.i.m: the wooden sword, the pot, the stirring stick, the winnowing basket, the black antelope skin, the mortar, and the pestle.

2.7.17.j.s: apareṇāgniṃ vrīhimac chakaṭam avasthāpyaikapavitrāntarhitām̐ sthālīṃ vrīhibhiḥ pūrayitvā nimṛjya pitṛbhyas tvā juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi \\ iti sakṛd eva śūrpe nirvapati /
2.7.17.j.d: अपरेणाग्निं व्रीहिमच् छकटम् अवस्थाप्यैकपवित्रान्तर्हिताम्̐ स्थालीं व्रीहिभिः पूरयित्वा निमृज्य पितृभ्यस् त्वा जुष्टं निर्वपामि \\ इति सकृद् एव शूर्पे निर्वपति ।
2.7.17.j.m: Having stationed the cart containing rice behind the fire, filled the pot separated by a single strainer with rice, and wiped it clean, he pours it out only once into the winnowing basket with: "For the fathers, agreeable to you, I pour out!"

2.7.17.k.s: dakṣiṇena dakṣiṇāgniṃ dakṣiṇāpūrveṇa dakṣiṇāpareṇa vā pratyagudaggrīvaṃ kṛṣṇājinam āstīryolūkhalam adhivartya /
2.7.17.k.d: दक्षिणेन दक्षिणाग्निं दक्षिणापूर्वेण दक्षिणापरेण वा प्रत्यगुदग्ग्रीवं कृष्णाजिनम् आस्तीर्योलूखलम् अधिवर्त्य ।
2.7.17.k.m: To the south of the dakṣiṇāgni fire, south-east or south-west, having spread the black antelope skin with the neck to the north-west and placed the mortar on it,

2.7.17.l.m: the sacrificer's wife, standing facing south-east, pounds [the grain].

2.7.17.m.s: parāpāvam avivekam̐ sakṛt phalīkaroti dakṣiṇāgnau jīvataṇḍulam iva carum̐ śrapayitvotpūtena navanītenānutpūtenājyena vābhighāryodvāsya /
2.7.17.m.d: परापावम् अविवेकम्̐ सकृत् फलीकरोति दक्षिणाग्नौ जीवतण्डुलम् इव चरुम्̐ श्रपयित्वोत्पूतेन नवनीतेनानुत्पूतेनाज्येन वाभिघार्योद्वास्य ।
2.7.17.m.m: He husks it once, without winnowing away and without separating; having cooked the boiled rice-mash on the dakṣiṇāgni fire as if with living grains, and having basted it with purified butter or unpurified clarified butter, and taken it off [the fire]—

2.7.17.n.m: having taken [a portion] of the pot-cooked mess with the stirring stick—

2.7.17.o.s: somāya pitṛpītāya svadhā namas \\ iti prathamām āhutiṃ juhoti yamāyāṅgirasvate pitṛmate svadhā namas \\ iti dvitīyām agnaye kavyavāhanāya sviṣṭakṛte svadhā namas \\ iti ye mekṣaṇe taṇḍulās tāñ juhoti //
2.7.17.o.d: सोमाय पितृपीताय स्वधा नमस् \\ इति प्रथमाम् आहुतिं जुहोति यमायाङ्गिरस्वते पितृमते स्वधा नमस् \\ इति द्वितीयाम् अग्नये कव्यवाहनाय स्विष्टकृते स्वधा नमस् \\ इति ये मेक्षणे तण्डुलास् ताञ् जुहोति ॥
2.7.17.o.m: he makes the first offering with: "To Soma accompanied by the fathers, svadhā! Homage!", the second with: "To Yama accompanied by the Aṅgirases and the fathers, svadhā! Homage!", and with: "To Agni Kavyavāhana, Sviṣṭakṛt, svadhā! Homage!", he offers the grains that are on the stirring stick.

2.7.19.a.m: He places the stirring stick [on the fire] silently.

2.7.19.b.s: ye rūpāṇi pratimuñcamānās \\ asurāḥ santaḥ svadhayā caranti / \ parāpuro nipuro ye bharanti \\ agniṣ ṭān asmāt praṇunoktu lokāt \\ iti dakṣiṇāgner ekolmukaṃ dhūpāyat parācīnam̐ hṛtvā dakṣiṇenaikasphyādeśe nidadhāti /
2.7.19.b.d: ये रूपाणि प्रतिमुञ्चमानास् \\ असुराः सन्तः स्वधया चरन्ति । \ परापुरो निपुरो ये भरन्ति \\ अग्निष् टान् अस्मात् प्रणुनोक्तु लोकात् \\ इति दक्षिणाग्नेर् एकोल्मुकं धूपायत् पराचीनम्̐ हृत्वा दक्षिणेनैकस्फ्यादेशे निदधाति ।
2.7.19.b.m: With: "Those who, assuming forms, being Asuras, wander with the svadhā, who bring the far-off and near citadels—may Agni drive them from this realm!", having taken a smoking firebrand backwards from the dakṣiṇāgni fire, he places it to the south on the area of a single wooden sword.

2.7.19.c.s: apahatā asurā rakṣāṃsi vediṣadas \\ ity avahananadeśe dakṣiṇāṃ dakṣiṇāprācīṃ vā sphyenaikasphyāṃ vedim ullikhya /
2.7.19.c.d: अपहता असुरा रक्षांसि वेदिषदस् \\ इत्य् अवहननदेशे दक्षिणां दक्षिणाप्राचीं वा स्फ्येनैकस्फ्यां वेदिम् उल्लिख्य ।
2.7.19.c.m: With: "Smitten away are the Asuras, the Rakṣases seated on the altar!", having delineated with the wooden sword an altar of the size of a single wooden sword towards the south or towards the south-east in the pounding place,

2.7.19.d.s: ud īratām avare \\ ity adbhir avokṣati /
2.7.19.d.d: उद् ईरताम् अवरे \\ इत्य् अद्भिर् अवोक्षति ।
2.7.19.d.m: he sprinkles it with water with: "Let the lower ones arise!"

2.7.19.e.s: sakṛdācchinnaṃ barhir urṇāmṛdu \ syonaṃ pitṛbhyas tvā bharāmy aham / \ asmin sīdantu me pitaraḥ somyāḥ \ pitāmahāḥ prapitāmahāś cānugaiḥ saha \\ iti sakṛdācchinnena barhiṣaikasphyām̐ stṛṇāti /
2.7.19.e.d: सकृदाच्छिन्नं बर्हिर् उर्णामृदु \ स्योनं पितृभ्यस् त्वा भराम्य् अहम् । \ अस्मिन् सीदन्तु मे पितरः सोम्याः \ पितामहाः प्रपितामहाश् चानुगैः सह \\ इति सकृदाच्छिन्नेन बर्हिषैकस्फ्याम्̐ स्तृणाति ।
2.7.19.e.m: With: "Grass cut once, soft as wool, pleasant for the fathers, I bring you; upon this let my fathers seated with Soma, grandfathers, and great-grandfathers sit together with their followers!", he strews the altar of a single wooden sword with the grass cut once.

2.7.19.f.m: Upon it, he sets down the pot-cooked mess.

2.7.19.g.s: dakṣiṇata āñjanam abhyañjanaṃ kaśīpūpabarhaṇam udakumbhaṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpayati /
2.7.19.g.d: दक्षिणत आञ्जनम् अभ्यञ्जनं कशीपूपबर्हणम् उदकुम्भं च प्रतिष्ठापयति ।
2.7.19.g.m: To the south, he sets down eye-ointment, unguent, a cushion and headrest, and a water pitcher.

2.7.19.h.s: yajamānāḥ prācīnāvīti savyaṃ jānv ācya sakṛdācchinne 'vācīnapāṇir dakṣiṇāpavargām̐s trīn udakāñjalīn ninayati /
2.7.19.h.d: यजमानाः प्राचीनावीति सव्यं जान्व् आच्य सकृदाच्छिन्ने ऽवाचीनपाणिर् दक्षिणापवर्गाम्̐स् त्रीन् उदकाञ्जलीन् निनयति ।
2.7.19.h.m: Wearing the sacred cord over the right shoulder, bending his left knee, with his hand turned downwards, the sacrificer pours out three handfuls of water upon the grass cut in a single stroke, ending towards the south:

2.7.19.i.s: mārjayantāṃ pitaraḥ somyāsas \\ mārjayantāṃ pitāmahāḥ somyāsas \\ mārjayantāṃ prapitāmahāḥ somyāsas \\ iti \\ asāv avaneniṅkṣva \\ asāv avaneniṅkṣva \\ iti vā /
2.7.19.i.d: मार्जयन्तां पितरः सोम्यासस् \\ मार्जयन्तां पितामहाः सोम्यासस् \\ मार्जयन्तां प्रपितामहाः सोम्यासस् \\ इति \\ असाव् अवनेनिङ्क्ष्व \\ असाव् अवनेनिङ्क्ष्व \\ इति वा ।
2.7.19.i.m: "May the fathers purify themselves, rich in soma; may the grandfathers purify themselves, rich in soma; may the great-grandfathers purify themselves, rich in soma"; or with: "O [Name], wash yourself! O [Name], wash yourself!"

2.7.19.j.s: teṣv avācīnapāṇir dakṣiṇāpavargām̐s trīn piṇḍān dadāti /
2.7.19.j.d: तेष्व् अवाचीनपाणिर् दक्षिणापवर्गाम्̐स् त्रीन् पिण्डान् ददाति ।
2.7.19.j.m: Upon these, with his hand turned downwards, he presents three rice-balls, ending towards the south.

2.7.19.k.s: etat te tatāsau \\ viti pitre piṇḍaṃ dadāti /
2.7.19.k.d: एतत् ते ततासौ \\ विति पित्रे पिण्डं ददाति ।
2.7.19.k.m: He presents a rice-ball to his father with: "This for you, father, O [Name]!"

2.7.19.l.s: etat te pitāmahāsau \\ iti pitāmahāya \\ etat te prapitāmahāsau \\ iti prapitāmahāya /
2.7.19.l.d: एतत् ते पितामहासौ \\ इति पितामहाय \\ एतत् ते प्रपितामहासौ \\ इति प्रपितामहाय ।
2.7.19.l.m: To the grandfather with: "This for you, grandfather, O [Name]!"; to the great-grandfather with: "This for you, great-grandfather, O [Name]!"

2.7.19.o.s: atha yadi nāmadheyāni na vindyāt svadhā pitṛbhyaḥ pṛthiviṣadbhyas \\ iti pitre piṇḍaṃ dadyāt svadhā pitṛbhyo 'ntarikṣasadbhyas \\ iti pitāmahāya svadhā pitṛbhyo diviṣadbhyas \\ iti prapitāmahāya /
2.7.19.o.d: अथ यदि नामधेयानि न विन्द्यात् स्वधा पितृभ्यः पृथिविषद्भ्यस् \\ इति पित्रे पिण्डं दद्यात् स्वधा पितृभ्यो ऽन्तरिक्षसद्भ्यस् \\ इति पितामहाय स्वधा पितृभ्यो दिविषद्भ्यस् \\ इति प्रपितामहाय ।
2.7.19.o.m: Now, if he should not know the names, he should give a rice-ball to the father with: "Svadhā to the fathers dwelling on the earth!"; to the grandfather with: "Svadhā to the fathers dwelling in the intermediate space!"; to the great-grandfather with: "Svadhā to the fathers dwelling in the sky!"

2.7.19.p.m: If he has two fathers, he should designate two for each rice-ball.

2.7.19.q.m: One whose father is living should give [the balls] to the grandfather and to the great-grandfather.

2.7.19.r.m: "He does not offer past a living person," according to some.

2.7.19.t.m: For one whose father is living, the subsequent [rite] beginning from the presentation of the rice-balls is omitted.

2.7.19.v.s: āpo devīḥ svadhayā vandamānās \ tā vo gacchantu pitaraḥ syonāḥ / \ ūrjaṃ vahantīḥ satam akṣitodakāḥ kṣīram udakaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu payaḥ kīlālaṃ parisrutam \ svadhā stha \ tarpayata me pitṝn iti trīn udapātrān ninayati /
2.7.19.v.d: आपो देवीः स्वधया वन्दमानास् \ ता वो गच्छन्तु पितरः स्योनाः । \ ऊर्जं वहन्तीः सतम् अक्षितोदकाः क्षीरम् उदकं घृतं मधु पयः कीलालं परिस्रुतम् \ स्वधा स्थ \ तर्पयत मे पितॄन् इति त्रीन् उदपात्रान् निनयति ।
2.7.19.v.m: he pours out three vessels of water with: "May the divine waters, reverencing with svadhā, / pleasant, approach you, O fathers! / Bringing strength, being inexhaustible waters, milk, water, clarified butter, honey, sap, foaming liquor, surā, / you are svadhā; satisfy my fathers!"

2.7.19.w.s: atra pitaro yathābhāgaṃ mandadhvam anusvadham āvṛṣāyadhvam ity uktvā parāṅ āvartate /
2.7.19.w.d: अत्र पितरो यथाभागं मन्दध्वम् अनुस्वधम् आवृषायध्वम् इत्य् उक्त्वा पराङ् आवर्तते ।
2.7.19.w.m: Having said: "Here, O fathers, rejoice according to your shares; become vigorous according to svadhā!", he turns away.

2.7.19.x.s: oṣmaṇo vyāvṛtta upāste svāhoṣmaṇo vyathiṣyai \\ ity ūṣmāṇam udyantam anumantrayate /
2.7.19.x.d: ओष्मणो व्यावृत्त उपास्ते स्वाहोष्मणो व्यथिष्यै \\ इत्य् ऊष्माणम् उद्यन्तम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
2.7.19.x.m: He sits waiting until the steam has ceased; with "Svāhā to the dispersion of steam!" he recites over the rising steam.

2.7.19.y.s: vyāvṛtta ūṣmaṇy avyāvṛtte vā \\ amīmadanta pitaro 'nusvadham āvṛṣāyīṣata \\ ity uktvopaparyāvartate /
2.7.19.y.d: व्यावृत्त ऊष्मण्य् अव्यावृत्ते वा \\ अमीमदन्त पितरो ऽनुस्वधम् आवृषायीषत \\ इत्य् उक्त्वोपपर्यावर्तते ।
2.7.19.y.m: Whether the steam has ceased or has not ceased, having said: "The fathers have rejoiced; they have become vigorous according to svadhā," he turns back.

2.7.19.z.s: yaḥ sthālyām̐ śeṣas tam avaghreṇa bhakṣayati /
2.7.19.z.d: यः स्थाल्याम्̐ शेषस् तम् अवघ्रेण भक्षयति ।
2.7.19.z.m: Whatever remains in the pot, that he consumes by smelling.

2.7.19.ab.s: āmayāvy annādyakāmo vā prāśnīyād yo vālam annādyāya san nānnam adyāt tena prāśya /
2.7.19.ab.d: आमयाव्य् अन्नाद्यकामो वा प्राश्नीयाद् यो वालम् अन्नाद्याय सन् नान्नम् अद्यात् तेन प्राश्य ।
2.7.19.ab.m: One who is sick or one desirous of proper food should eat it; or one who, being fit for proper food, does not eat food, having eaten [of it] with that [mantra].

2.7.19.ac.m: Then, alongside each rice-ball, he gives eye-ointment, unguent, and a garment.

2.7.19.ad.s: āṅkṣvāsau \\ āṅkṣvāsau \\ iti trir āñjanam abhyaṅkṣvāsau \\ abhyaṅkṣvāsau \\ iti trir abhyañjanam /
2.7.19.ad.d: आङ्क्ष्वासौ \\ आङ्क्ष्वासौ \\ इति त्रिर् आञ्जनम् अभ्यङ्क्ष्वासौ \\ अभ्यङ्क्ष्वासौ \\ इति त्रिर् अभ्यञ्जनम् ।
2.7.19.ad.m: "Anoint your eyes, O [Name]! Anoint your eyes, O [Name]!"—thus thrice eye-ointment; "Anoint your limbs, O [Name]! Anoint your limbs, O [Name]!"—thus thrice unguent.

2.7.19.ae.s: etāni vaḥ pitaro vāsām̐si \\ ato no 'nyat pitaro mā yūḍhvam iti daśām ūrṇāstukāṃ vā chittvā nyasyati pūrve vayasi /
2.7.19.ae.d: एतानि वः पितरो वासाम्̐सि \\ अतो नो ऽन्यत् पितरो मा यूढ्वम् इति दशाम् ऊर्णास्तुकां वा छित्त्वा न्यस्यति पूर्वे वयसि ।
2.7.19.ae.m: In early life, having torn off a fringe or a tuft of wool, he throws it down with: "These are your garments, O fathers; / do not take anything else of ours, O fathers!"

2.7.19.af.m: In later life, having plucked a hair of his own.

2.7.19.ag.s: namo vaḥ pitaro rasāya \\ iti namaskārair upatiṣṭhate /
2.7.19.ag.d: नमो वः पितरो रसाय \\ इति नमस्कारैर् उपतिष्ठते ।
2.7.19.ag.m: With: "Homage to you, O fathers, for the sap..." he worships with reverences.

2.7.19.ah.s: ūrjasvatīḥ svadhayā vandamānās \ tā vo gacchantu pitaraḥ syonāḥ / \ ūrjaṃ vahantīḥ satam akṣitodakāḥ kṣīram udakaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu payaḥ kīlālaṃ parisrutam \\ svadhā stha \ tarpayat me pitṝn iti trīn udapātān ninayati yathā purastāt //
2.7.19.ah.d: ऊर्जस्वतीः स्वधया वन्दमानास् \ ता वो गच्छन्तु पितरः स्योनाः । \ ऊर्जं वहन्तीः सतम् अक्षितोदकाः क्षीरम् उदकं घृतं मधु पयः कीलालं परिस्रुतम् \\ स्वधा स्थ \ तर्पयत् मे पितॄन् इति त्रीन् उदपातान् निनयति यथा पुरस्तात् ॥
2.7.19.ah.m: As before, he pours out three vessels of water with: "May the energetic waters, reverencing with svadhā, / pleasant, approach you, O fathers! / Bringing strength, being inexhaustible waters, milk, water, clarified butter, honey, sap, foaming liquor, surā, / you are svadhā; satisfy my fathers!"

2.7.20.a.s: uttiṣṭhata pitaraḥ preta pūrve \ yamasya panthām anuyātā purāṇam / \ dhattād asmāsu draviṇaṃ yac ca bhadram \\ pra ṇo brūtād bhāgadhān devatāsu \\ iti pitṝn utthāpayati /
2.7.20.a.d: उत्तिष्ठत पितरः प्रेत पूर्वे \ यमस्य पन्थाम् अनुयाता पुराणम् । \ धत्ताद् अस्मासु द्रविणं यच् च भद्रम् \\ प्र णो ब्रूताद् भागधान् देवतासु \\ इति पितॄन् उत्थापयति ।
2.7.20.a.m: He bids the fathers arise with: "Arise, O fathers, go forth, former ones, / follow the ancient path of Yama! / Grant unto us wealth and what is auspicious; / proclaim our portion among the deities!"

2.7.20.b.m: With: "Depart, O fathers!" he sends them away.

2.7.20.c.s: yantu pitaro manasā javena \\ iti pitṝn sam̐sādhayati /
2.7.20.c.d: यन्तु पितरो मनसा जवेन \\ इति पितॄन् सम्̐साधयति ।
2.7.20.c.m: With: "May the fathers go with swiftness of mind," he speeds the fathers.

2.7.20.d.s: mano nv ā huvāmahe \\ iti tisṛbhir manasvatībhir upatiṣṭhate /
2.7.20.d.d: मनो न्व् आ हुवामहे \\ इति तिसृभिर् मनस्वतीभिर् उपतिष्ठते ।
2.7.20.d.m: He worships with the three mind-verses beginning with: "We invoke the mind..."

2.7.20.e.s: akṣann amīmadanta prajāpate \\ iti paṅktiprājāpatyābhyāṃ pratyeti /
2.7.20.e.d: अक्षन्न् अमीमदन्त प्रजापते \\ इति पङ्क्तिप्राजापत्याभ्यां प्रत्येति ।
2.7.20.e.m: He returns with the two paṅkti- and Prajāpati-verses beginning with: "They have eaten, they have rejoiced... O Prajāpati..."

2.7.20.f.s: yad antarikṣam iti paṅktyā gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate /
2.7.20.f.d: यद् अन्तरिक्षम् इति पङ्क्त्या गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते ।
2.7.20.f.m: With the paṅkti-verse: "Whatever intermediate space...", he worships the gārhapatya fire.

2.7.20.g.s: abhūn no dūto haviṣo jātavedās \\ avāḍ ḍhavyāni surabhīṇi kṛtvā / \ prādāḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhayā te akṣan \ prajānann agne punar apyehi devān ity ekolmukaṃ pratyapisṛjya /
2.7.20.g.d: अभून् नो दूतो हविषो जातवेदास् \\ अवाड् ढव्यानि सुरभीणि कृत्वा । \ प्रादाः पितृभ्यः स्वधया ते अक्षन् \ प्रजानन्न् अग्ने पुनर् अप्येहि देवान् इत्य् एकोल्मुकं प्रत्यपिसृज्य ।
2.7.20.g.m: Having thrown back the single firebrand with: "Jātavedas has become our messenger for the havis; / having made the offerings fragrant, he has carried them; / you have given them to the fathers; with svadhā they have eaten; / knowing, O Agni, go back again to the gods!"

2.7.20.h.m: Having sprinkled them, he removes the vessels in pairs.

2.7.20.i.m: He puts the rice-balls back into the cooking pot.

2.7.20.j.s: apāṃ tvauṣadhīnām̐ rasaṃ prāśayāmi \ bhūtakṛtaṃ garbhaṃ dhatsva \\ iti madhyamaṃ piṇḍaṃ patnyai prayacchati /
2.7.20.j.d: अपां त्वौषधीनाम्̐ रसं प्राशयामि \ भूतकृतं गर्भं धत्स्व \\ इति मध्यमं पिण्डं पत्न्यै प्रयच्छति ।
2.7.20.j.m: He presents the middle rice-ball to the sacrificer's wife with: "I cause you to eat the sap of waters and plants; / bear an embryo that brings welfare!"
